Read the article for full context. Report any errors . After a long and hard day at work, many people look forward to a good meal, preferably comfort food. In Philippines, that arguably equates to home-grown Jollibee, which has become synonymous to Filipino identity, especially abroad. That was apparently the train of thought of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. when United States President Donald Trump was in town for a brief state visit. In his opening remarks during his bilateral meeting with Trump on Wednesday, November 18, Marcos acknowledged the US leader’s tight schedule in the Philippines. Trump arrived late Tuesday afternoon, November 17, and headed straight to the Philippine International Convention Center to attend the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue meeting , the ASEAN-US Special Summit , and other meetings after the conclusion of the 49th ASEAN Summit. “Your schedule has been packed to the hilt, which is not exactly a surprise because we know how hard you work,” Marcos told Trump. The Philippine leader said this was why he decided to at least give Trump and his delegation a “taste of Manila” and had Jollibee snacks delivered to them. “Jollibee is a very very popular chain, and one of their main products is fried chicken, and we are very proud to say that we have surpassed KFC in the United States in terms of popularity,” Marcos said. “You have been working very hard, Mr. President….So just think of it as providing extra energy for all the work that you have to do, that you have done, and continue to do, and that is in front of you,” Marcos said. Diplomacy via Jollibee is nothing new. In July, Marcos and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney paid a visit to a Jollibee store in Vancouver following their bilateral meeting. The company is operating over 100 stores in North America and plans to reach 500 stores by 2030. (READ: How Jollibee became Filipino food’s biggest ambassador in the US ) In the recently concluded 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits, the Jollibee mascot, wearing a barong, made an appearance at the International Media Center , located at the World Trade Center in Pasay City on Tuesday. That’s days after Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese sampled Chickenjoy and announced that the food chain will also open its doors across New South Wales and Victoria . “Its establishment in Australia will answer the diaspora’s calls to make home-style Filipino dishes more accessible and provide an opportunity for Australians to experience Filipino cuisine and culture firsthand,” according to a news release from Albanese’s website. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 大邱市长朱京浩于周三获判无罪。检方指控他在2024年末担任当时执政的国民力量党（PPP）院内leader时，曾阻挠国民议会投票解除前总统尹锡悦的戒严令。2024年12月3日，尹锡悦宣布戒严后，朱京浩试图阻止议员参加终结紧急状态的议会投票。当时，PPP的108名议员中有90人无法参加解除戒严令的投票。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho was acquitted Wednesday of charges of obstructing a National Assembly vote to lift former President Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law declaration in late 2024, when he was the floor leader of the then ruling People Power Party (PPP). The Seoul Central District Court delivered the verdict in the case against Choo, who stood trial on charges of playing a key role in Yoon's alleged insurrection. Choo was accused of changing the venue of an emergency party meeting three times on Dec. 3, 2024, after Yoon declared martial law, in an attempt to prevent lawmakers from taking part in a parliamentary vote on ending the emergency decree. Of the 108 PPP lawmakers, 90 were unable to attend the vote to lift the martial law at the time. Special counsel Cho Eun-suk's team had requested a 20-year prison term for Choo. Choo, however, maintained his innocence, saying he had no prior knowledge of the martial law imposition and had received no request from Yoon to block the National Assembly vote. The court said it was difficult to conclude that Yoon had asked the defendant to block the vote to lift martial law. Even if Yoon had made such a request, the evidence presented by the special counsel was insufficient to establish that the defendant had agreed to it, the court noted

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — President Lee Jae Myung asked China to play a constructive role on the issues facing the Korean Peninsula during a summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping Wednesday, underscoring that its peace and stability are key to building a more mature partnership between Seoul and Beijing. In response, Xi voiced support for all efforts to ease tensions on the peninsula, including dialogue between the United States and North Korea, according to Cheong Wa Dae. Their talks on the North Korea issue took place on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. “Lee stressed that issues concerning the peninsula are of vital interest to South Korea and that his government has actively sought to ease inter-Korean tensions and achieve peaceful coexistence,” National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said in a written briefing after the summit. “He asked China to play a constructive role on peninsula issues. And Xi acknowledged Seoul’s efforts and said China would continue to play a constructive role in resolving those issues,” he added. Wi explained that Xi briefed Lee on recent developments in China-North Korea relations and expressed support for efforts to reduce tensions on the Korean Peninsula, citing dialogue between Pyongyang and Washington as one example. Lee and Xi’s remarks came as security in Northeast Asia draws renewed attention ahead of the first three-way summit among U.S. President Donald Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the APEC sidelines on Thursday. The North Korea issue is said to be on the agenda for their talks, although neither Seoul nor Pyongyang is part of the meeting. Trump, who expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his Asia tour, is keeping the door open even though no progress on talks has been reported yet. He said whether Kim comes to Shenzhen is “up to President Xi,” calling on Xi to play a mediator role. Lee himself also expressed his hope for Xi to play a role in resolving North Korea issues during their earlier summit in January. It was the third summit between Lee and Xi. They first met on the sidelines of the APEC leaders’ meeting in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, in October 2025 and held their second summit in January during Lee’s state visit to Beijing. Looking ahead to the 35th anniversary of diplomatic ties, the two nations concluded negotiations on services and investment under a bilateral free trade agreement, Wi said. Negotiations for the sectors began in 2018 and Seoul and Beijing virtually reached agreements for this summit, with only minor documentation issues remaining. “The president noted that conclusion would lay the groundwork for more balanced and mutually beneficial economic cooperation,” Wi said. Lee also urged South Korea and China to capitalize on next year’s milestone by building on the progress the two leaders have made over the past year. “I hope we can work together to make this milestone a new driving force for the development of our bilateral ties,” he told Xi. Lee cited a nearly 50 percent year-on-year increase in bilateral trade in the first half of 2026 and said travel between the two countries was expected to surpass 10 million trips this year for the first time since 2019. He also called for expanding cultural and people-to-people exchanges, citing the possibility of bringing pandas to Korea as a way to foster goodwill. Xi pointed to the 35th anniversary as an opportunity to put relations on a steadier footing. “Both sides will use this opportunity to reflect on our experience, plan for the future together and promote the healthy and stable development of China-South Korea relations so that our people can benefit more,” Xi said. He stressed that China will work with South Korea to strengthen communication and coordination, keep global trade and supply chains stable and running smoothly, and work more closely together to build a system of global governance

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 中国深圳——李在明总统周三在中国国家主席习近平举行的一次峰会期间，呼吁中国在朝鲜半岛面临的问题上发挥建设性作用，强调朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定是首尔与北京建立更成熟伙伴关系的关键。 据青瓦台消息，习近平对此表示支持为缓解半岛紧张局势而作出的各项努力，包括美国与朝鲜之间的对话。 双方有关朝鲜半岛问题的会谈是在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）经济领导人会议期间进行的。 韩国国家安全 Adviser Wi Sung-lac在峰会后的书面情况说明中说：“李总统强调，有关半岛的问题关系到韩国的重大利益，其政府一直积极寻求缓解朝韩紧张局势、实现和平共处。”“他请中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。习近平对首尔方面作出的努力予以肯定，并表示中国将继续在解决这些问题方面发挥建设性作用。” 他补充说。 Wi表示，习近平向李在明介绍了近期中朝关系的发展情况，并表示支持为降低朝鲜半岛紧张局势而作出的努力，同时以平壤与华盛顿之间的对话为例。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于周四在APEC会议期间举行首次三方峰会之际，李在明和习近平的上述表态正值东北亚安全局势再次受到关注之际。 据称，朝鲜半岛问题在他们的会谈议程之列，尽管首尔和平壤均不是这次会议的参与方。 特朗普在亚洲之行期间表达了会见朝鲜领导人金正恩的兴趣，尽管目前尚未报道会谈取得进展，但他仍为接触保留着大门。 他表示，金正恩是否来到深圳“取决于习近平主席”，并呼吁习近平发挥斡旋作用。 实际上，李在明在今年1月两人早些时候举行的峰会上，也希望习近平在解决朝鲜半岛问题上发挥作用。 这是李在明与习近平之间的第三次峰会。 两人于2025年10月在庆尚北道京畿举行的APEC领导人会议期间首次会面，并在李在明今年1月对北京进行国事访问期间举行了第二次峰会。 Wi表示，展望两国建交35周年，双方已经完成双边自由贸易协定下服务和投资领域的谈判。 这些领域的谈判始于2018年，首尔与北京实际上已为本次峰会达成协议，仅剩少量文件处理问题。 Wi说：“总统指出，达成协议将为更加平衡和互利的经济合作奠定基础。” 李在明还敦促韩国和中国把握明年的里程碑，在两国领导人过去一年取得进展的基础上继续前行。 他对习近平说：“我希望我们能够携手合作，把这一里程碑变成推动我们双边关系发展的新动力。” 李在明提到，2026年上半年双边贸易额同比增长近50%，并称预计今年两国人员往来将首次突破1000万人次，这是自2019年以来的首次。 他还呼吁扩大文化和民间交流，并提到可以将大熊猫引入韩国，以促进友好关系。 习近平指出，35周年是推动两国关系走上更稳健发展轨道的机会。 习近平说：“双方将利用这一机会总结经验、共同规划未来，推动中韩关系健康稳定发展，让两国人民从中获得更多实惠。” 他强调，中国将同韩国加强沟通协调，保持全球贸易和供应链稳定畅通，并更加紧密地合作，共同构建全球治理体系

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Lotte Biologics completed construction of its biomanufacturing facility in Incheon, just west of Seoul, on Wednesday, marking a major step in its efforts to become a leading player in the global biopharmaceutical market. A completion ceremony for Plant 1, located at the company's Songdo Bio Campus in Incheon, was attended by the company's co-chief executive officers, James Park and Shin Yoo-yeol, as well as Lotte Group Chairman Shin Dong-bin. "The bio business is Lotte Group's future growth engine and a next-generation industry that will lead Korea's next generation," Chairman Shin said at the event. The production plant, spanning nearly 100,000 square meters, is equipped with key facilities, including a production building and a wastewater treatment facility. It has an annual production capacity of 120,000 liters and is scheduled to begin commercial operations by 2028, according to the company. The facility is expected to provide the company with a large-scale production base in Korea, complementing its manufacturing facility in Syracuse, New York, which it acquired in 2023, the company added. "It will mark an important starting point for Lotte Biologics to prepare its new leap in the global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) market," James Park, the company's co-CEO, said at a press event following the completion ceremony. Earlier this week, the Lotte Group subsidiary announced its first major contract manufacturing agreement with a global pharmaceutical company, without disclosing further details. Lotte Biologics is widely seen as a key test of Shin Yoo-yeol's leadership, as the eldest son of the group's chairman and the conglomerate's third-generation heir apparent. Shin was promoted to group president earlier this week and is expected to oversee the conglomerate's new growth engines, including its bio business

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) on Wednesday welcomed a lower court's decision to acquit Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho of charges related to the 2024 martial law bid, while the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) called for an immediate appeal. Choo was accused of obstructing a National Assembly vote to lift former President Yoon Suk Yeol's martial law declaration in late 2024, when he was the PPP's floor leader. He was suspected of deliberately changing the venue of an emergency party meeting three times on Dec. 3 in an attempt to block lawmakers from taking part in the parliamentary vote. "I express my respect to the judiciary for its just decision," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok wrote on Facebook, shortly after the Seoul Central District Court delivered the verdict. He also claimed the acquittal marked an end to what he described as the government's attempt to frame his party as insurrectionists. PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sig echoed Jang's criticism, calling the court's acquittal a "completely expected" ruling. Rep. Jeong said the party will consider filing a criminal complaint against special counsel Cho Eun-suk for alleged distortion of the law. The special counsel team had sought a 20-year prison term for Choo. The ruling party strongly criticized the court's decision, calling on the special counsel to immediately file for an appeal. "The court's acquittal is an affront to history," DPK chief spokesperson Park Sung-joon said during a briefing at the National Assembly. "It is a completely unacceptable verdict." "If the floor leader who had blocked the vote to lift martial law is innocent, what does that make of the citizens who risked their lives to protect the National Assembly?" he said. The spokesperson urged the higher court to hold accountable those responsible for obstructing the parliamentary vote. "Absurdly, the court did not recognize Choo's involvement in the insurrection," Kim wrote on Facebook. "The court is taking the lead in dismantling the freedom and democracy that the people of Korea have fought so hard to protect." Only 18 of the PPP's 108 lawmakers participated in the parliamentary vote to lift martial law following Yoon's declaration
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 主要反对党欢迎大邱市长在戒严案中被判无罪；执政党要求上诉
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）周三欢迎下级法院作出无罪判决，解除大邱市长秋庆皓与2024年戒严案有关的指控；执政的朝鲜民主劳动党（DPK）则呼吁立即上诉。秋庆皓被控在2024年末担任PPP院内领袖时，阻挠国会投票解除前总统尹锡悦的戒严令。他被怀疑在12月3日三次故意更改紧急党内会议地点，试图阻止议员参加议会投票。首尔中央地方法院作出裁决后不久，PPP党首张东赫在Facebook上写道：“我对司法机关作出公正裁决表示敬意。”他还声称，无罪判决标志着政府试图将他的政党描绘成叛乱分子一事宣告结束。PPP院内领袖郑哉锡赞同张东赫的批评，称法院的无罪判决是“完全在预料之中”的裁决。郑议员表示，该党将考虑就特别检察官赵恩淑涉嫌扭曲法律提出刑事控告。特别检察官团队此前寻求对秋庆皓判处20年监禁。执政党强烈批评法院裁决，敦促特别检察官立即提出上诉。朝鲜民主劳动党首席发言人朴成埈在国民议会简会上说：“法院的无罪判决是对历史的亵渎。”“这一裁决完全不可接受。”他说：“如果阻挠解除戒严案投票的院内领袖是无罪的，那么那些冒险保护国民议会而置生命于不顾的公民又该作何理解？”发言人敦促上级法院追究阻挠议会投票者的责任。金在Facebook上写道：“荒谬的是，法院没有认定秋参与叛乱。”“法院正在带头瓦解韩国人民为捍卫自由与民主而进行艰苦斗争所取得的成果。”尹锡悦宣布戒严后，PPP的108名议员中只有18人参加了解除戒严的议会投票。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Marking the fifth anniversary of its Korean launch, Kim So-youn, managing director of the Walt Disney Company Korea, described the streaming landscape not as an endgame, but as a long game. "The streaming business is not about short-lived wins," Kim said during a press conference in Seoul. "Our goal is not to chase the speed of competitors, but to use our strengths to provide integrated entertainment and achieve healthy, sustainable growth." Since introducing Korean originals in 2022, Disney+ has seen a sharp rise in global viewership. Annual viewing hours for Korean content have surged 27-fold in Central and South America, sevenfold across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and sixfold in the U.S. and Canada, according to the company. To build on that momentum, the platform is pushing a three-part strategy: expanding investment in Korean content, broadening audience access through partnerships and scaling its entertainment offerings, particularly in sports. Choi Yeon-u, head of local content at Walt Disney Company Korea, introduced a four-part content roadmap centered on distinct storytelling, smart curation for global appeal, a growing unscripted slate and new creative formats. The fantasy romance "The Remarried Empress" recently became the most-viewed Disney+ local content globally within its first three days on the platform. Reality and variety shows are also taking a bigger role. Following the global success of "Battle of Fates," a survival show featuring fortune tellers and shamans, Disney+ announced a second season of the hit series. The show is already set for a U.K. adaptation, with Mexican and Spanish versions also under review. Disney+ is also expanding its lineup with new concepts, including an anti-romance reality show called "Friend-zoned," which tests friendships between men and women. The platform will also introduce sitcoms, mid-form content and documentaries featuring prominent Korean cultural figures and athletes. While heavy investments in Korean originals have produced global hits, local user numbers have remained a challenge. Addressing questions about domestic market competition, Kim maintained that Korea serves as a vital engine for the broader global business. "We are not increasing our investment in Korean content just for the domestic market," Kim said. "We do it to create a growth engine for our entire global business, which is why we must approach this from a long-term business perspective." Along with its content lineup, Disney+ is expanding viewer access through its ad-supported standard tier and partnerships with platforms such as Gmarket. In sports, the service is expanding live coverage via ESPN, spanning major esports events with the Korea e-Sports Association, Major League Baseball, the National Basketball Association and the upcoming 2027 Formula E season. "By bringing together Disney’s distinctive storytelling and global fandoms with Korea’s exceptional creative talent, we aim to build deeper, lasting connections with audiences and evolve Disney+ into a digital centerpiece that brings fans and stories together,” the managing director said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: Disney+押注长期增长和韩国粉丝群体
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh: 值此华特迪士尼公司韩国业务推出五周年之际，华特迪士尼公司韩国总经理金素允将流媒体市场形容为一场长期博弈，而非终局之战。金素允在首尔举行的新闻发布会上说：“流媒体业务并非追求一时的胜利。我们的目标不是追赶竞争对手的速度，而是发挥自身优势，提供综合娱乐体验，实现健康、可持续的增长。”自2022年推出韩国原创内容以来，Disney+的全球观看人数大幅增长。据该公司介绍，韩国内容的年度观看时长在中南美洲增长至原来的27倍，在欧洲、中东和非洲增长至原来的7倍，在美国和加拿大增长至原来的6倍。为延续这一势头，该平台正推行三部分战略：扩大对韩国内容的投资，通过合作拓展受众渠道，并扩大娱乐内容供给，尤其是体育内容。华特迪士尼公司韩国本地内容主管 Choi Yeon-u 公布了一份四部分内容路线图，重点包括鲜明的叙事风格、面向全球受众的智能内容编排、不断扩充的非脚本内容以及全新创意形式。奇幻爱情剧《The Remarried Empress》最近成为Disney+上线后首三天内全球观看量最高的本地内容。真人秀和综艺节目也正占据更大比重。随着 featuring 算命师和巫师的生存类节目《Battle of Fates》在全球取得成功，Disney+宣布将推出该热门系列的第二季。该节目也已确定制作英国改编版，墨西哥版和西班牙版也在审议中。Disney+还通过新的节目概念扩充内容阵容，其中包括名为《Friend-zoned》的反爱情真人秀，该节目测试男女之间的友谊关系。该平台还将推出情景喜剧、中等篇幅内容和纪录片，主角包括韩国知名文化界人士和运动员。尽管大举投资韩国原创内容已经打造出多部全球热门作品，但本地用户数量仍是一项挑战。在回答有关国内市场竞争的问题时，金素允强调，韩国是更广泛的全球业务的重要增长引擎。金素允说：“我们加大韩国内容投资，并非只是为了韩国国内市场。我们这样做是为了为整个全球业务打造增长引擎，因此必须从长期商业视角看待此事。”在扩充内容阵容的同时，Disney+还通过推出由广告支持的 标准套餐以及与Gmarket等平台合作，扩大观众的观看渠道。在体育方面，该服务正借助ESPN扩大赛事直播范围，涵盖与韩国电子竞技协会合作的大型电子竞技赛事、美国职业棒球大联盟、美国职业篮球联赛以及即将到来的2027年世界电动方程式锦标赛赛季。这位总经理表示：“我们将迪士尼独特的叙事风格和全球粉丝群体与韩国杰出的创意人才汇聚在一起，旨在与受众建立更深、更持久的联系，并将Disney+打造成连接粉丝与故事的数字核心平台。”

Korea is seeing a similar trend, with investment concentrated in a handful of chip developers and companies developing foundational AI technologies, while others focusing on AI-powered services struggle to attract funding.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 人工智能已成为吸引投资资本的磁石，但这轮融资热潮只让少数企业受益。韩国也呈现出类似趋势，投资资金集中于少数芯片开发商和开发人工智能基础技术的公司，而其他专注人工智能赋能服务的公司则难以吸引融资。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) has become a magnet for investment capital, but the funding boom is benefiting only a few firms. Korea is seeing a similar trend, with investment concentrated in a handful of chip developers and companies developing foundational AI technologies, while others focusing on AI-powered services struggle to attract funding. According to market tracker The VC, domestic startups and small and medium-sized enterprises attracted 1.02 trillion won ($766 million) in investment last month, but the number of investment deals stood at just 86. Among those deals, the combined value of the five largest deals was 670.7 billion won, accounting for 66 percent of the total. Neural processing unit developer FuriosaAI and physical AI firm Dream Labs led the pack by raising 260 billion won and 120 billion won, respectively. The VC noted that AI and robotics accounted for 53 percent of the total investment in October, with the share remaining at 37 percent even after excluding FuriosaAI. Cumulative investment in the first 10 months of this year reached 11.7 trillion won, up 91 percent year-on-year, but the number of deals fell 28 percent to 1,008. This highlights the tendency of investment capital concentrating among a select group of companies. According to a report by the Software Policy & Research Institute (SPRi), the three companies attracting the largest AI investments in Korea accounted for 55.8 percent of total AI startup funding in the first half of 2026, up from 29.6 percent in 2025. The same report showed that the share of investment going to AI service and application developers fell from 54.3 percent in 2025 to 21 percent in the first half of 2026, while the combined share for AI semiconductor and model developers surged from 25.6 percent to 60.2 percent over the same period. Industry officials attributed the trend to rapid advances in general-purpose AI models, such as OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic's Claude Fable, which are increasingly capable of performing tasks previously handled by specialized applications. A third industry official also pointed to reverse engineering, a technique that involves analyzing the structure and operation of existing software to reproduce its functionality using new code

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: The National Pension Service (NPS), KB Financial Group’s largest shareholder, will vote in favor of Lee Jae-keun’s appointment as chairman, adding to expectations that his nomination will pass without difficulty at an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on Friday. The NPS holds a 9.17 percent stake in the financial group. Its endorsement follows backing from the world’s two largest proxy advisory firms, Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) and Glass Lewis, both of which have recommended that shareholders approve Lee’s appointment. In a voting recommendations report obtained by The Korea Times, ISS said “a vote for this resolution is warranted given the absence of any known issues concerning the nominee and the company’s board dynamics.” Glass Lewis likewise said it had identified “no substantial issues for shareholder concern” regarding the proposed appointment. The endorsements could carry particular weight at KB Financial, where foreign investors held 78.15 percent of shares as of Tuesday, the highest proportion among Korea’s major financial holding companies. If appointed, Lee’s term will run for three years until November 2029. A KB veteran, Lee has spent more than 30 years at the group, holding senior positions in finance, strategy, global operations and wealth management. He became the banking industry’s youngest chief executive in 2022 and has overseen the group’s global business, wealth management and small and medium-sized enterprise operations since last year. His selection nevertheless came as a surprise to many industry observers, given that KB Financial had been posting record earnings under incumbent Chairman Yang Jong-hee. One of the first challenges awaiting Lee as a new chairman will be a round of executive appointments across the group. The terms of several key subsidiary chiefs, including the heads of KB Kookmin Bank, KB Kookmin Card, KB Securities and KB Insurance, are due to expire at the end of this year

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: An estimated 550,000 students will take the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) Thursday. The president said he was determined to prevent any such conduct during the CSAT today. The gravity and direness of the situation are important to understand, but the president's offer of cash rewards should be carefully considered before being put into action.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 据估计，约55万名学生将于周四参加大学学术能力测试（CSAT）。总统表示，他决心阻止任何此类行为在今天举行的CSAT期间发生。理解当前局势的严重性和紧迫性十分重要，但在付诸行动前，应审慎考虑总统提出的现金奖励。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: An estimated 550,000 students will take the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) Thursday. It is often considered a "make-or-break" event for high schoolers on the cusp of adulthood in Korea's highly competitive society. It is an opportunity to use every bit of knowledge and education accrued to advance into higher education. Mentally, students hope to be at the top of their game and overcome their nerves during such an important test. To ensure that students' hard work is not undermined by cheating, President Lee Jae Myung has ordered authorities to reward anyone who reports illicit conduct during the test with 100 million won ($75,000). Lee gave the extraordinary order after discussing the matter with officials from Manila, where he is attending the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit. Cheating using artificial intelligence (AI) has become an alarming trend, especially in the wake of a new admission of cheating by a man who got top scores on the national tax accountant exam. The man, who is under police investigation, reportedly used a method that is still difficult to detect, putting students, proctors and officials on high alert for the national college entrance exam. The president said he was determined to prevent any such conduct during the CSAT today. Following his remote emergency meeting with officials in Seoul on Tuesday evening, the president posted on social media, "Cheating on an exam using advanced technology is tantamount to theft — stealing the hard-earned results of hundreds of thousands of diligent students. We will mobilize all national resources with the same level of urgency as if we were in a state of war, ensuring that such 'theft of academic results' is completely eradicated and that honest, hardworking students are not victimized." Lee's intention to provide a fair and equal platform for test takers is understandable. Still, technology-assisted cheating has been around for a some time in Korea's tech-savvy society. The gravity and direness of the situation are important to understand, but the president's offer of cash rewards should be carefully considered before being put into action. Lee has offered cash in return for reporting inadequate safety measures at industrial sites on several occasions since taking office. Large payouts provide a compelling reason for people to take action, but the best policies provide the right type of incentive for good behavior from the beginning rather than rewards for reporting violations. Public policy can also function by tapping into the good side of people, incentivizing them to act for the good of society rather than tattling on their peers for rewards. The government cannot avoid responsibility for failing to come up with effective anti-cheating measures ahead of the CSAT. AI technology changes our lives at such a fast pace sometimes that it can leave everyone in disarray. It was regrettable to witness Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin say that he does not believe tech-assisted cheating can be 100 percent prevented when he was grilled at the National Assembly on Monday. The ministry attempted to soften the blowback, clarifying that the minister was expressing the difficulties that proctors face. Education authorities and Prime Minister Han Seong-sook have come up with several emergency measures in response to the tax accountant exam case. The government will block public Wi-Fi near test sites. In addition, they will put stickers over the buttons on clothing worn by students sitting for the CSAT, collect all phones from students before they can enter the testing space and send national alert messages to ferret out any phones that students have failed to turn in, as well as conduct hourly screening for AI smart glasses. There will be a 10-year ban on retaking the CSAT — up from the current one-year prohibition — for anyone found cheating. On Wednesday, the government added one more regulation — only pencils with a standard black graphite core will be allowed. We hope that these 11th-hour measures will help provide a fair and safe environment for the test takers, and we wish them the best on this important day
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 1亿韩元悬赏引发对高考安保措施的疑问
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 据估计，将有55万名学生参加周四举行的大学修学能力测试（CSAT）。在韩国竞争激烈的社会中，这项考试常被视为高中生迈入成年的“成败关头”。学生们可以利用积累的全部知识和所学知识，升入高等教育机构。在如此重要的考试中，学生们都希望发挥出最佳水平，克服紧张情绪。为确保学生的辛勤努力不因作弊而付诸东流，李在明总统已指示有关部门，对举报考试期间不当行为的人给予1亿韩元（$75,000）奖励。李在明是在与马尼拉官员讨论此事下达出这项特别命令的，目前他正在那里参加东南亚国家联盟峰会。利用人工智能（AI）作弊已成为一种令人警惕的趋势，尤其是在一名男子承认在全国税务师考试中作弊并取得高分之后。这名男子目前正接受警方调查，据称他采用了一种仍难以侦破的方法，使全国大学入学考试的学生、监考人员和官员都高度警惕。总统表示，他决心阻止今天CSAT期间的任何此类行为。周二晚间与首尔官员远程召开紧急会议后，总统在社交媒体上发帖称：“利用先进技术在考试中作弊无异于盗窃——窃取数十万名勤奋学生辛苦换来的成绩。我们将以战时状态的紧迫程度调动一切国家资源，确保这种‘学业成绩盗窃’得到彻底根除，确保诚实、勤奋的学生不会成为受害者。”李在明希望为考生提供公平、平等的平台，这一意图值得理解。尽管如此，在韩国这个精通科技的社会里，技术辅助作弊已经存在了一段时间。理解局势的严重性和紧迫性十分重要，但在将总统提供的现金奖励付诸实施前，应慎重考虑。自就任以来，李在明曾多次提出以现金奖励换取对工业场所安全措施不足的举报。高额奖金能为人们采取行动提供有力动机，但最佳政策从一开始就是为良好行为提供适当类型的激励，而不是奖励举报违规行为。公共政策也可以通过调动人们积极的一面发挥作用，激励他们为社会公益采取行动，而不是为了奖励而告发同伴。政府无法回避在CSAT前未能制定有效反作弊措施的责任。人工智能技术有时以极快速度改变我们的生活，甚至让所有人都感到无所适从。令人遗憾的是，国会周一质询教育部长崔_accessor-in 时，崔_accessor-in 表示他不认为技术辅助作弊能够被100 percent防止。该部试图减轻反弹，澄清部长只是在说明监考人员面临的困难。教育当局和韩升 sufficiency 总理已针对税务师考试案制定了数项紧急措施。政府将屏蔽考点附近的公共无线网络。此外，他们会在参加CSAT的学生所穿服装的纽扣上贴上封条，在学生进入考场前收走所有手机，并发送全国警报信息，查出学生未上交的每一部手机，同时每小时对AI智能眼镜进行一次检查。任何被发现作弊的人都将被处以10年不得重考CSAT的处罚，而现行禁令只有1年。周三，政府又增加了一项规定——只准使用采用标准黑色石墨芯的铅笔。我们希望这些最后时刻出台的措施能帮助考生获得公平、安全的考试环境，并祝愿他们在这一重要日子取得最好的成绩。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: As he had remained single longer than many of his peers, his parents began to worry that he might never marry. “People may be more skeptical about marriage these days, but I’ve never thought I’d stay single,” he said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Data leaks worry 61% despite improved perceptions of public safety Kim, a 41-year-old office worker in Seoul, is getting married this month. As he had remained single longer than many of his peers, his parents began to worry that he might never marry. But Kim had never thought of marriage as something he would forgo. “People may be more skeptical about marriage these days, but I’ve never thought I’d stay single,” he said. “I wanted an ordinary life with a spouse and children, and I wanted that sense of stability. To me, an ordinary life is happiness.” With Seoul home prices out of reach, Kim and his partner opted for a jeonse rental, which requires a large upfront deposit. Even then, they barely managed to cover the deposit with help from both sets of parents. “Housing takes up most of what it costs to get married,” Kim said. “We cut back on the dress, the suit and the jewelry to put more toward housing. Even after all that, we’re still nowhere near being able to buy a place.” The 2026 Social Survey, released Wednesday by the Ministry of Data and Statistics, found that 55 percent of respondents aged 13 and older said marriage was either advisable or essential. The figure was up 2.5 percentage points from two years earlier and was the highest since 2014, when it stood at 56.8 percent. Overall, 60.2 percent of men and 49.8 percent of women said people should marry, a gap of 10.4 percentage points. Among those who had never married, the figures were 43.9 percent for men and 29.9 percent for women, up 2.3 and 3.9 percentage points, respectively, from two years earlier. The gap narrowed by 1.6 percentage points to 14 points. The share of respondents who said married couples should have children rose 1.8 percentage points to 70.2 percent, while the average number of children respondents considered ideal remained at 1.89. Some 67.8 percent said it was acceptable for couples to live together without marrying, and 38.1 percent said it was acceptable to have children outside marriage. Both figures have risen steadily since 2012. Financial constraints remained the most commonly cited reason for not marrying, at 29 percent. The share citing job insecurity rose from 12.9 percent to 15.5 percent, overtaking the burden of having and raising children, which was cited by 12.5 percent. Asked which policy would be most effective in addressing Korea’s low birthrate, 32 percent chose housing assistance and 25.7 percent chose job creation and employment support for young people. Compared with two years earlier, the share choosing housing assistance fell 1.4 percentage points, while the share choosing job measures rose 4.9 points. Housing and job support drew nearly equal backing among respondents in their 20s, at 31.3 percent and 30.6 percent, respectively. Among those in their 30s, housing assistance drew more than twice as much support as job measures, at 37.4 percent versus 18.2 percent. The survey also found that 37.8 percent of respondents considered Korean society safe, up 8.9 percentage points from 2024 and nearly triple the 13.2 percent recorded in 2016. The share who considered society unsafe fell from 25.6 percent in 2024 to 18.8 percent. Asked to assess safety in specific areas, 61 percent said they felt unsafe with regard to personal data leaks, 42.1 percent said the same about cybersecurity threats such as hacking and computer viruses and 39.5 percent about crime. Crime was the most commonly cited threat to public safety, chosen by 22.4 percent of respondents, up 4.5 percentage points from 2024. National security ranked second at 17.6 percent, followed by economic risks at 15.7 percent
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 更多韩国人认为人们应该结婚，但资金不足仍是首要障碍
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 尽管公众安全观感有所改善，61%的人仍担忧数据泄露。现年41岁的首尔办公室职员Kim本月即将结婚。由于他单身的时间比许多同龄人都长，父母开始担心他可能终身不婚。但Kim从未想过要放弃婚姻。他说：“如今人们对婚姻或许更加怀疑，但我从没想过自己会一直单身。我想过上和配偶、孩子一起生活的普通日子，也想要那种稳定感。对我来说，普通生活就是幸福。”首尔房价高不可攀，Kim和伴侣便选择全租房，这需要支付一大笔 upfront 押金。即便如此，他们也是在双方父母帮助下才勉强凑齐押金。Kim说：“住房几乎占据了结婚所需开支的大部分。我们缩减了礼服、西装和珠宝的开销，把更多资金用于住房。即便如此，我们离买房还差得很远。”韩国数据与统计部周三发布的《2026年社会调查》显示，55%的13岁及以上受访者认为结婚是可取的或必不可少的。这一比例较两年前上升2.5个百分点，为2014年以来的最高水平，当时为56.8%。总体而言，60.2%的男性和49.8%的女性认为人们应当结婚，两者相差10.4个百分点。在从未结婚者中，男性和女性持此看法的比例分别为43.9%和29.9%，较两年前分别上升2.3个和3.9个百分点，差距缩小1.6个百分点至14个百分点。认为已婚夫妇应当生育子女的受访者比例上升1.8个百分点，达到70.2%；受访者认为理想的子女数量仍为1.89个。67.8%的人认为情侣同居而不结婚可以接受，38.1%的人认为婚外生育可以接受。这两项比例自2012年以来均持续上升。经济条件仍是不结婚最常被提及的原因，占29%。以工作不稳定为由的比例从12.9%上升至15.5%，超过了生育和抚养子女负担这一原因，后者占12.5%。当被问及哪项政策最有助于应对韩国低生育率时，32%的受访者选择住房援助，25.7%选择为年轻人创造就业和提供就业支持。与两年前相比，选择住房援助的比例下降1.4个百分点，选择就业措施的比例上升4.9个百分点。在20多岁受访者中，住房支持和就业措施的支持率几乎持平，分别为31.3%和30.6%。在30多岁受访者中，住房援助获得的支持超过就业措施的两倍，分别为37.4%和18.2%。调查还发现，37.8%的受访者认为韩国社会安全，较2024年上升8.9个百分点，接近2016年13.2%的三倍。认为社会不安全的比例从2024年的25.6%降至18.8%。在评价具体领域的安全状况时，61%的人表示对个人数据泄露感到不安全，42.1%的人对黑客攻击和计算机病毒等网络安全威胁表示同样担忧，39.5%的人则对犯罪感到不安全。犯罪是公众安全面临的最常见威胁，占受访者选择的22.4%，较2024年上升4.5个百分点。国家安全以17.6%位居第二，其次是经济风险，占15.7%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: JB Financial, Ant Group team up on AI credit scoring for foreign customers

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: JB Financial Group has teamed up with China's Ant Group to improve credit assessment systems using artificial intelligence (AI) technology and expand access to financial services for foreign residents in Korea, the group said Wednesday. The group signed a memorandum of understanding with Ant Digital Technologies (Ant DT), Ant Group's digital technology subsidiary, Tuesday at the latter's office in Singapore. The signing took place on the sidelines of the Singapore Fintech Festival 2026. The ceremony was attended by Park Jong-choon, vice president of JB Financial's AX Future Growth Division, and Leo Li, president of international business at Ant DT. Under the partnership, the two companies will explore ways to upgrade credit assessment models and financial services offered by JB Financial's affiliates, including Jeonbuk Bank, Kwangju Bank and JB Woori Capital. The collaboration will draw on Ant DT's AI capabilities and alternative credit assessment data to develop more sophisticated models, with the aim of making financial services more accessible to foreign residents in Korea. The partnership will focus in particular on Chinese nationals, who account for the largest share of foreign residents in Korea, the financial group said. JB Financial plans to leverage Ant DT's expertise in feature engineering — the process of identifying patterns and variables in large datasets — to develop alternative credit assessment methods for this customer group. The group also said the initiative reflects Chairman Kim Ki-hong's strategy of making financial services for foreign residents a key growth area. It has previously pursued cross-border credit information sharing with credit agencies in countries including Cambodia, Vietnam and the Philippines. "By leveraging Ant Group's AI technology and alternative credit assessment data, we will further strengthen JB Financial Group's digital competitiveness. We will work with Ant DT to build a more sophisticated risk management system and improve foreign customers' access to financial services," Kim said. Ant Group is best known as the operator of Alipay, one of China's major mobile payment platforms. Its technology arm, Ant DT, specializes in areas including AI and blockchain. It works with more than 300 partners worldwide and provides services to around 30,000 corporate clients
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: JB Financial与蚂蚁集团合作，为海外客户提供人工智能信用评分服务
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: JB Financial Group周三表示，该集团已与中国蚂蚁集团携手合作，利用人工智能技术改进信用评估体系，并扩大韩国外国居民获得金融服务的渠道。该集团周二在蚂蚁集团数字技术子公司Ant Digital Technologies（Ant DT）位于新加坡的办公室与其签署了一份谅解备忘录。签署仪式在2026年新加坡金融科技博览会上举行。JB Financial旗下AX Future Growth Division副总裁朴钟俊和Ant DT国际业务总裁Leo Li出席了仪式。根据合作协议，两家公司将探索升级信用评估模型以及JB Financial关联机构所提供金融服务的办法，其中包括全北银行、光州银行和JB Woori Capital。此次合作将利用Ant DT的人工智能能力和替代信用评估数据，开发更完善的模型，目标是让韩国外国居民更容易获得金融服务。该集团表示，合作将重点关注在韩外国居民中占比最大的中国公民。JB Financial计划利用Ant DT在特征工程方面的专长——即从大型数据集中识别模式和变量——为这一客户群体开发替代信用评估方法。该集团还表示，这项举措反映了董事长金基洪将面向外国居民的金融服务打造为关键增长领域的战略。此前，该集团已推动与包括柬埔寨、越南和菲律宾在内的国家的征信机构共享跨境信用信息。金基洪说：“通过利用蚂蚁集团的人工智能技术和替代信用评估数据，我们将进一步增强JB Financial Group的数字化竞争力。我们将与Ant DT合作，构建更完善的风险管理系统，并改善外国客户获得金融服务的机会。”蚂蚁集团最为人熟知的是运营中国主要移动支付平台之一支付宝。其技术部门Ant DT专注于人工智能、区块链等领域，与全球300多家合作伙伴开展业务，并为约30,000家企业客户提供服务

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korean listed firms posted record earnings during the third quarter of this year, driven by a surge in exports of semiconductors amid global investment for artificial intelligence (AI), data showed Wednesday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: University leaders call for practical AI training, commercialization
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Higher education leaders from Korea, the United States and Vietnam urged campuses on Wednesday to push artificial intelligence (AI) out of the lab and into the marketplace, calling for hands-on training and incentives that reward real-world impact over academic papers. The three panelists spoke during a session on AI commercialization at the Innovation & Impact Summit 2026, hosted by Korea University in Seoul and organized by Times Higher Education, the London-based publisher behind the World University Rankings.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 来自韩国、美国和越南的高等教育领导人周三呼吁高校将人工智能（AI）从实验室推向市场，并提供实践培训及激励机制，奖励人工智能在现实世界中的影响，而非学术论文。三名嘉宾在2026创新与影响力峰会关于人工智能商业化的讨论环节中发言。该峰会由首尔的高丽大学主办，总部位于伦敦的世界大学排名出版商Times Higher Education承办。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Higher education leaders from Korea, the United States and Vietnam urged campuses on Wednesday to push artificial intelligence (AI) out of the lab and into the marketplace, calling for hands-on training and incentives that reward real-world impact over academic papers. The three panelists spoke during a session on AI commercialization at the Innovation & Impact Summit 2026, hosted by Korea University in Seoul and organized by Times Higher Education, the London-based publisher behind the World University Rankings. Taejae University opened in Seoul in 2023 and teaches its classes online in English. Its students spend semesters abroad in cities including Tokyo and New York, then return to Korea in their fourth year for a final project. Yeom said he tells professors, “Don’t teach anything at all,” and has them lead discussions instead. An AI platform tracks how long faculty members speak and how students show skills such as critical thinking. Sanmay Das, professor and associate director of AI for social impact at Virginia Tech’s Sanghani Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics, described a project with the World Bank and the Kenyan judiciary. Kenya requires many civil cases to go through mediation before they reach a judge. Das’ team built an algorithm called SMaRT, short for “Selecting Mediators that are Right for the Task,” which assigns mediators to cases based on their skill, their licenses and how many cases they already have. He said the team is preparing a randomized controlled trial of the algorithm in the courts. He added that the trial would have been impossible without the World Bank’s infrastructure. “It’s because the incentives of academia have not sustained projects like this,” Das said. He noted that such projects take years, while papers remain the main currency of academic careers. He compared the gap to the “valley of death,” the stretch between discovery and commercialization where many new drugs stall. Yap Peng Tan, provost of VinUniversity, a private university in Hanoi founded by Vietnamese conglomerate Vingroup, cited reports suggesting that 95 percent of organizations have yet to see measurable economic benefits from their AI investments. He noted that the steam engine, electricity and the internet took about 60, 40 and 25 years to deliver meaningful productivity gains, while AI has been in public hands for about four years. The real shortage, he said, is people who combine knowledge of a field with practical AI skills and experience putting AI to work. Tan said VinUniversity is redesigning its courses around real problems from hospitals, companies and communities. It has also launched a program to train 20,000 AI professionals for Vietnam, which ends with six weeks inside a company solving its problems. “AI will keep evolving faster than ever and the university must evolve with it,” Tan said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 大学领导者呼吁加强人工智能实用培训和成果商业化
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国、美国和越南的高等教育领导者周三呼吁各高校推动人工智能（AI）走出实验室、走向市场，提倡实践培训，并设立奖励机制，鼓励人工智能在现实世界产生影响，而非仅仅产出学术论文。三名与会嘉宾在2026年创新与影响力峰会的一场人工智能商业化论坛上发言。该论坛由首尔的高丽大学主办，由《泰晤士高等教育》承办；这家总部位于伦敦的出版机构推出了世界大学排名。太宰大学于2023年在首尔开学，以英语在线授课。学生会在东京和纽约等城市的海外高校学习一个学期，随后在第四学年返回韩国完成毕业项目。Yom说，他会告诉教授们“不要教任何东西”，而是让他们主持讨论。一套人工智能平台会追踪教师发言的时长，以及学生如何展示批判性思维等技能。弗吉尼亚理工大学Sanghani人工智能与数据分析中心教授、人工智能社会影响力副主任Sanmay Das介绍了一个与世界银行和肯尼亚司法机构合作的项目。肯尼亚许多民事案件在交给法官之前必须经过调解。Das的团队开发了一套名为SMaRT的算法，其全称是“Selecting Mediators that are Right for the Task”，即“选择适合任务的调解员”。该算法根据调解员的技能、执业资格以及目前承担的案件数量，为案件分配合适的调解员。他说，团队正在准备在法院开展该算法的随机对照试验。他补充说，如果没有世界银行提供的基础设施，这项试验不可能完成。Das说：“这是因为学术界的激励机制无法持续支持这类项目。”他指出，此类项目需要多年时间，而论文仍是学术生涯的主要“货币”。他把这种差距比作“死亡之谷”，即从研发到商业化之间的阶段，许多新药在进入市场前便停滞不前。VinUniversity教务长Yap Peng Tan引述报告称，95%的组织尚未从人工智能投资中获得可衡量的经济收益。他指出，蒸汽机、电力和互联网分别用了大约60年、40年和25年，才带来显著的生产率提升，而人工智能进入公众视野大约只有4年。他说，真正稀缺的是既掌握某一领域知识，又具备实用人工智能技能和人工智能应用经验的人才。Tan说，VinUniversity正围绕医院、企业和社区面临的实际问题重新设计课程。该校还启动了一项计划，为越南培养2万名人工智能专业人员；课程最后阶段包括在企业内工作6周，解决企业实际问题。Tan说：“人工智能将以比以往更快的速度持续演进，大学必须与之同步演进。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国央行周三公布的数据显示，由于购房需求和相关投资贷款需求减少，韩国家庭信贷增速在今年第三季度放缓。根据韩国央行（BOK）的初步数据，截至9月底，家庭信贷余额创下2,030.5万亿韩元（1.52万亿美元）的纪录，较三个月前增加9.8万亿韩元。家庭信贷是指金融机构向家庭提供的信用购买服务和贷款。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's household credit growth slowed in the third quarter of the year due to less demand for home purchases and investment-related loans, central bank data showed Wednesday. Outstanding household credit stood at a record 2,030.5 trillion won ($ 1.52 trillion) as of end-September, up 9.8 trillion won from three months earlier, according to the preliminary data from the Bank of Korea (BOK). The on-quarter increase marked the slowest since the first quarter of 2025, when the balance rose 2.7 trillion won. Household credit refers to credit purchases and loans extended to households by financial institutions. In detail, household loans stood at 1,896.8 trillion won at the end of September, up 4.7 trillion won from three months earlier, also marking the smallest on-quarter increase since the third quarter of 2025. Of the total, mortgage lending rose 12.2 trillion won to 1,202.3 trillion won, while non-mortgage loans fell 4.9 trillion won to 694.5 trillion won, the latest findings showed. The BOK kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged last month at 3 percent after two consecutive rate hikes to assess economic conditions amid prolonged tensions in the Middle East and robust exports. The rate freeze came after the BOK raised the benchmark rate in its July and August meetings, citing "preemptive action" to curb mounting inflationary pressure and ensure macroeconomic stability
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 市场利率高企，家庭信贷第三季度增速放缓
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国央行数据显示，由于购房需求和投资相关贷款需求减少，韩国家庭信贷增速在今年第三季度放缓。截至9月底，家庭信贷余额创下2,030.5万亿韩元（1.52万亿美元）的纪录，比三个月前增加9.8万亿韩元。这是韩国央行（BOK）初步数据所显示的情况。季度增幅为2025年第一季度以来最低，当时余额增加2.7万亿韩元。家庭信贷是指金融机构向家庭提供的信用购买和贷款。具体而言，截至9月底，家庭贷款余额为1,896.8万亿韩元，比三个月前增加4.7万亿韩元，季度增幅同样是2025年第三季度以来最小。在家庭贷款总额中，抵押贷款增加12.2万亿韩元，达到1,202.3万亿韩元；非抵押贷款则减少4.9万亿韩元，降至694.5万亿韩元。最新调查结果由此显示。韩国央行上月将基准利率维持在3%，此前该行连续两次加息，以评估中东地区持续紧张局势和强劲出口之下的经济状况。冻结利率之前，韩国央行曾在7月和8月的会议上上调基准利率，称此举是采取“预防性行动”，旨在遏制不断上升的通胀压力并确保宏观经济稳定。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea finalizes revised plan for unified military academy, Army college relocation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea announced Wednesday a finalized plan to establish a single military academy for joint education and training while retaining the existing school of each armed service as regional campuses in a bid to ease pushback from opponents. Central to the revision is a plan to relocate the Korea Military Academy, the Army college, from Seoul to a site in the central Chungcheong region, a move fiercely opposed by the academy's alumni and cadets.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国于星期三宣布了一项最终计划，将建立一所统一军事学院，开展联合教育与训练，同时保留各军种现有院校作为地区校区，以缓解反对者施加的压力。修订计划的核心是将韩国陆军学院从首尔迁往忠清地区的某个地点，此举遭到该学院校友和学员的强烈反对。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea announced Wednesday a finalized plan to establish a single military academy for joint education and training while retaining the existing school of each armed service as regional campuses in a bid to ease pushback from opponents. The plan, finalized at a meeting between the government and the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), is seen as a retreat from the original proposal to merge the academies of the Army, Air Force and Navy as Seoul sought to offer a compromise amid strong pushback from alumni groups, cadets and other stakeholders. Central to the revision is a plan to relocate the Korea Military Academy, the Army college, from Seoul to a site in the central Chungcheong region, a move fiercely opposed by the academy's alumni and cadets. The main military academy will be established at the Jaundae military complex in the central city of Daejeon, about 140 kilometers south of the capital. The Navy Academy and the Air Force Academy will stay in their current locations — in the southern coastal county of Jinhae and the central provincial city of Cheongju, respectively, and will be responsible for branch-specific training, along with the new Army school. The revised plan adopts a so-called 1-2-1 model, where cadets complete shared coursework in their first and final years at the joint military academy and spend their second and third years for specialized training at their respective schools. "For specialized training during the second and third years, it is more efficient to keep the Navy and Air Force academies at their current locations, but we needed to find a new location for the Army academy," Rep. Kim Byung-joo told reporters after a policy coordination meeting between party and government officials. The exact relocation site for the Army academy in the Chungcheong region has yet to be decided, Kim added. The new admission system will apply to cadets entering in 2029. Given the construction timelines for the planned joint academy and new Army campus, along with legislative and other required procedures, the government expects to be able to open the new facilities in 2032, a defense ministry official told reporters. This means that Army cadets will take classes at the current academy in northern Seoul until the new facilities open. Under the plan, aspiring cadets will still apply for a specific branch, as they currently do, but will be allowed to switch branches after their first year. The new joint academy will select Marine Corps cadets within the Navy's quota from the start to train them in branch-specific skills, such as amphibious landings, as part of a broader push to elevate the corps' standing on par with the Army, Navy and Air Force, the official said. The revision also includes a plan to establish a new graduate school for master's and doctoral courses at the main campus to offer a path for in-depth military education. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul expressed his commitment to establishing the combined academy to nurture creative talent capable of breaking away from conventional educational frameworks. "By having Army, Navy and Air Force cadets train together and unite as a single warrior community, we will foster them into key leaders of our military capable of prevailing on any battlefield," Kang said during the meeting. Kang also stressed the need to set a "clear and bold direction," while reviewing the implementation process in a "thorough and prudent" manner. The new military academy will operate directly under the ministry, unlike the existing academies that fall under each individual armed service, the ministry said, citing the need for a "consistent and balanced" management and oversight in budget and other related policies. The revision backtracks from an initial July proposal to merge the three service academies into a single institution and close down the existing schools. Amid growing opposition to the plan, Kang, a retired Army general, had signaled an adjustment to the initial framework, highlighting that the move is not aimed at abolishing the three academies. Alumni groups have denounced the planned integration as an attempt to weaken the core identity and capabilities of each military branch. Army college graduates, in particular, have argued that it was a politically driven move by the Lee Jae Myung administration to curb the Army's influence over its involvement in past military coups and the short-lived martial law attempt by former President Yoon Suk Yeol in 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国敲定统一军事学院修订方案及陆军士官学校迁址计划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国周三宣布了一项最终方案，计划设立一所单一军事学院，开展联合教育与训练，同时将各军种现有院校保留为地区校区，以缓解反对者的抵制。该方案是在韩国政府与执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）举行会议后敲定的，被视为对最初合并陆军、空军和海军院校方案的退让。此前，为化解校友团体、学员及其他利益相关方的强烈反对，首尔方面试图提出折中方案。此次修订的核心，是将韩国陆军士官学校从首尔迁至忠清地区的一处地点，此举遭到该校校友和学员的强烈反对。主军事学院将设在大田市中央的允泰军事园区，距离首尔以南约140公里。海军士官学校和空军士官学校将分别保留在原址，即南部沿海的镇海县和中道城市清州市，并与新的陆军学校一道负责各军种专业训练。修订后的方案采用所谓的“1-2-1模式”：学员第一年和最后一年在联合军事学院完成共同课程，第二年和第三年则分别在所属院校接受专业训练。执政党与政府官员举行政策协调会议后，金炳珠议员对记者说：“第二年和第三年的专业训练，让海军和空军士官学校留在原址更有效率，但我们需要为陆军学校寻找新地点。”金补充说，忠清地区陆军学校的具体迁址尚未确定。新招生制度将适用于2029年入学的学员。一名国防部官员对记者表示，考虑到计划中的联合学院和新的陆军校区所需建设时间，以及立法和其他必要程序，政府预计新设施将于2032年启用。这意味着，在新设施开放之前，陆军学员将继续在位于首尔北部的现学院上课。根据该方案，有志入学的学员仍需像现在一样申请具体军种，但第一学年结束后可以申请更换军种。这名官员说，新的联合学院将从一开始就根据海军招生名额选取海军陆战队学员，对其开展两栖登陆等军种专业技能训练，这是提升海军陆战队地位，使其与陆军、海军和空军并列的更广泛举措的一部分。修订方案还包括在主校区设立新研究生院，开设硕士和博士课程，为深入军事教育提供途径。国防部长姜善臼表示，致力于建立综合军事学院，培养能够突破传统教育框架的创造性人才。姜在会议上说：“让陆军、海军和空军学员共同训练，凝聚为一个统一的战士共同体，我们将把他们培养成能够在任何战场上取得胜利的我军重要领导人。”姜还强调，在审视方案实施过程时，需要确立“明确而大胆的方向”，并以“全面而审慎”的方式进行。国防部表示，新军事学院将直接隶属于国防部，而现有院校则分别隶属于各军种；国防部称，此举是为了在预算及其他相关政策上实行“一致和均衡”的管理与监督。修订方案偏离了今年7月最初提出的方案，后者主张将三所军种院校合并为单一机构并关闭现有学校。随着反对该计划的声音不断增加，退役陆军上将姜曾表示需要调整最初框架，并强调此举并非旨在废除三所院校。校友团体谴责计划中的整合是削弱各军种核心认同和能力的企图。陆军士官学校毕业生尤其认为，这是李在明政府出于政治目的采取的行动，意图遏制陆军的影响力，尤其是其与过去军事政变以及前总统尹锡悦2024年短暂戒严事件之间的关系

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea's economy is expected to grow at a faster than earlier expected rate of 3.9 percent in 2027, amid strong global demand driven by the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, a state-run think tank said Wednesday. The 2027 growth estimate by the Korea Development Institute (KDI) is far higher than its earlier projection of 2.2 percent advance in August this year. The KDI also raised its growth estimate for the year by 0.6 percentage point to 3.8 percent over the cited period. The research institute said global demand for semiconductor products continues to remain strong, leading to increased exports and facility investment, which are expected to eventually boost private consumption in 2027. The think tank added that Korean exports are expected to grow 8.1 percent next year after a 10.3 percent-gain for this year, despite U.S. tariff measures and geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East, as AI-related investment around the globe is expected to offset such hurdles. Private spending is expected to rise 2.4 percent next year following this year's estimated 1.8 percent rise. Facility investment is projected to expand 8.1 percent in 2027 after an 8.7 percent advance this year. Consumer prices are expected to rise 2.4 percent next year, following this year's estimated 2.7 percent gain, according to the KDI. The KDI warned that changes in AI infrastructure investment may increase economic volatility, given the Korean economy's heavy reliance on global chip demand. Other potential risks include uncertainties surrounding U.S. tariff policies and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East that could disrupt energy supplies, it added. Earlier, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) said the Korean economy will grow 3.3 percent in 2027, marking growth of more than 3 percent for the second consecutive year

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body: (대전=연합뉴스) 김준호 기자 = 한국철도공사(코레일)는 2027학년도 대학수학능력시험이 실시되는 19일부터 대학별 논술시험이 끝나는 내달 6일까지 수험생 안전 수송을 위한 특별수송대책을 시행한다고 18일 밝혔다. 시험장 입실 마감인 오전 8시 10분까지 열차 운행 상황을 집중적으로 관리해 정시 운행을 확보하고, 장애 발생 시 즉시 비상 수송에 나선다. 전국 주요 역과 차량기지에는 비상대기 열차 28대(전동열차 15대·KTX 5대·일반열차 8대)를 배치한다. 41개 주요 역에는 안내 인력 233명을 추가 투입해 수험생 안내와 맞이방 순회를 강화한다. 코레일은 또 논술·면접 응시생을 위해 21일부터 12월 6일까지 전국 33개 역에서 '수험생을 위한 따뜻한 작은 쉼터'를 운영한다. 주요 대학의 시험 일정과 이동 경로를 고려해 수도권전철역 12곳과 간선철도역 21곳에 수험생 대기 공간을 마련했다. 코레일은 이와 함께 수능 당일 소음 억제와 시설 관리에도 힘쓴다. 시험장 주변에서는 긴급상황이 아니면 경적 사용을 자제하고, 영어 듣기평가 시간에는 인접 선로의 열차가 서행하도록 조치했다. 열차 운행에 지장을 줄 수 있는 공사나 유지보수 작업을 일시 중지하고, 차량·선로·전기 등 철도 시설물 사전 점검도 모두 마쳤다. 김태승 코레일 사장은 "정시 운행과 안전 수송에 한치의 소홀함이 없게 하겠다"며 "기온 급강하 등 이례 사항에 철저히 대비하고 비상시 가용 자원을 총동원해 수험생의 원활한 이동을 지원하겠다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/18 17:57 송고 2026년11월18일 17시57분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.title_zh: 韩国铁路公司将在高考当天增开应急列车并增派引导人员
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body_zh:
（大田＝韩联社）记者金俊浩＝韩国铁道公社（韩国铁道公社）18日宣布，为确保参加2027学年度大学修学能力试验的考生安全 transporting，将从19日大学修学能力试验举行之日起，至下月6日各大学面试考试结束为止，实施特别输送措施。铁道公社将集中管理列车运行情况，确保截至上午8时10分这一考场入场截止时间的列车准时运行；一旦发生故障，将立即启动紧急输送。

铁道公社将在全国主要车站和车辆基地部署28列应急备用列车，其中包括15列电动车、5列KTX高速列车和8列普通列车。

此外，铁道公社将在全国33个车站增设233名引导人员，为参加面试和面试的考生提供休息空间。

为参加面试和面试的考生提供便利，铁道公社还将从21日起至12月6日，在全国33个车站运营“为考生准备的温暖小歇脚处”。

铁道公社考虑了主要大学的考试日程和移动路线，在首都圈地铁车站12处和干线铁路车站21处设置了考生等候空间。

同时，铁道公社还将努力抑制大学修学能力试验当天的噪声并加强设施管理。在考场周边，除紧急情况外将避免使用汽笛；在英语听力评价时间内，将采取措施让相邻线路的列车缓慢行驶。

铁道公社还将暂停可能妨碍列车运行的施工和维护作业，并完成车辆、线路、电气等铁路设施的事前检查。

韩国铁道公社社长金泰胜表示：“我们将确保列车准时运行和安全输送丝毫不出现疏漏，同时彻底应对气温骤降等异常情况，在紧急情况下调动所有可用资源，支持考生顺畅出行。”

https://leadership.ng/lagos-luxury-prope.summary_zh: 这一情况凸显出拉各斯豪华住宅市场日益受到关注的问题：衡量一套房产财务吸引力的指标日益不仅包括其租金收入，还包括维持其运营所需的经常性支出。根据该公司的《拉各斯服务费报告》，在配备服务的奥尼鲁开发项目中，一居室和两居室公寓的年度服务费介于120万尼日利亚奈拉至250万尼日利亚奈拉之间，而三居室公寓的年度服务费则介于200万尼日利亚奈拉至400万尼日利亚奈拉之间。
https://leadership.ng/lagos-luxury-prope.body: The growing disparity between rental income and property maintenance expenses is creating a difficult investment environment, particularly for owners who have invested heavily in high-end apartments but are struggling to achieve returns commensurate with their investments. In some developments, annual service charges covering electricity, water treatment, facility management, estate security, waste disposal and maintenance of common areas have become so substantial that landlords are increasingly reconsidering conventional residential letting. A real estate broker operating in Victoria Island, who requested anonymity, told LEADERSHIP that the financial implications of these charges were making some long-term rental arrangements unattractive. “If service charge is N12 million to N20 million annually and achievable long-let rent is N25 million to N35 million, the landlord’s net is squeezed,” the broker said. The situation highlights a growing concern in Lagos’ luxury residential market, where the financial attractiveness of a property increasingly depends not only on its rental value but also on the recurring expenses required to keep it operational. A Lagos service-charge analysis published by Brick & Click Realty in August 2026 provides an indication of the scale of the maintenance burden across premium residential locations. According to the firm’s Lagos Service Charge Report, annual service charges for one- and two-bedroom apartments in serviced Oniru developments range between N1.2 million and N2.5 million, while three-bedroom apartments attract between N2 million and N4 million. For apartments with four bedrooms and above, the estimated annual charges range between N3.5 million and N6 million. The report puts corresponding annual charges for four-bedroom and larger apartments in serviced Banana Island developments at between N7 million and N12 million. Electricity generation, water treatment, security, cleaning, waste management, lift maintenance, amenities and sinking funds for major repairs were identified as important components of residential service-charge budgets. Although the figures represent indicative market estimates rather than verified invoices for individual developments, they demonstrate how the cost of maintaining premium residential facilities can constitute a substantial recurring expense for property owners and occupants. The pressure is not peculiar to Lagos’ luxury residential market. Facility management professionals say rising costs of energy, labour, imported equipment and maintenance materials are making it increasingly difficult to sustain residential and commercial properties without reviewing service charges. Chief Executive Officer of Solid Foundation Group, Adetoun Otepola, identified diesel as one of the biggest contributors to the rising cost of maintaining properties, explaining that it powers several essential services within residential and commercial developments. Speaking on the pressure of rising operating expenses on facility management, she said diesel was required to power common areas, water treatment plants, security systems and other essential facilities. “The price of diesel has gone up. Diesel comes first in the maintenance costs that you have. We use it to power common areas for electricity, water treatment plants, security systems and other essential services. So, maintenance costs are on the rise,” Otepola said. She added that rising prices of lubricants, spare parts and logistics, alongside increasing wage demands, were further compounding the financial burden on facility managers. Her assessment explains why maintaining luxury residential developments has become increasingly expensive, particularly where residents expect uninterrupted power supply, treated water, functioning elevators and round-the-clock security. The affected properties are concentrated along the stretch linking Ahmadu Bello Way, Oniru, Eko Atlantic City and Bluewater Okunde, an emerging luxury real estate corridor described by Palton Morgan Holdings in its September 2026 Editorial Guide as the New Victoria Island. The corridor has attracted considerable investor attention in recent years, supported by infrastructure developments, luxury residential projects and expectations surrounding the 47.47-kilometre Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway. Land values in the area have also recorded substantial appreciation. A parcel of approximately 2,400 square metres in Bluewater Okunde, which reportedly traded for about N800 million, is now valued at more than N5 billion. However, the appreciation in property values has not necessarily translated into corresponding improvements in rental yields, exposing a growing disconnect between the capital value of waterfront properties and their ability to generate regular rental income. Market data suggest that some of Lagos’ most expensive residential locations do not necessarily offer the strongest rental returns. Rental-yield data compiled by Stears showed that Oniru recorded a rental yield of 4.88 per cent, compared with 4.59 per cent in Victoria Island and 3.09 per cent in Ikoyi. Chevron recorded the highest yield among the locations examined, at 5.85 per cent. Speaking in a media chat, Principal Partner of Ubosi Eleh & Company, an estate surveying and valuation firm, Mr. Chudi Ubosi, explained that residential rents had increased by between 50 and 200 per cent over the preceding 24 months, attributing the increases largely to inflation and the rising cost of building materials, which had pushed up construction expenses. His assessment provides context for the difficulties confronting landlords, as the cost of developing, operating and maintaining residential properties continues to influence the financial calculations of investors. More specifically, Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer of Brick & Click Realty, Oluwaseyi Adaralegbe, highlighted the relatively low rental-yield characteristics of Lagos’ ultra-prime residential market in the firm’s Q3 2026 Lagos Property Market Outlook. The report estimated gross rental yields in the ultra-prime island segment, comprising Banana Island, Eko Atlantic and Old Ikoyi, at between 3.0 and 4.8 per cent, compared with 3.8 to 6.0 per cent for the prime island and waterfront segment, which includes Victoria Island, Parkview and Lekki Phase 1. It explained that ultra-prime locations generally command higher property values but offer relatively lower rental yields, while some outer residential corridors provide stronger income returns. Importantly, these are gross yields calculated before management expenses and applicable taxes, meaning the actual returns available to landlords could be considerably lower after service charges and other operating costs are deducted. Adaralegbe advised owners of ultra-prime properties to prioritise tenant retention rather than maximise rental rates, explaining that the tenant pool in the segment was relatively thin and that the cost of leaving an apartment vacant could outweigh the additional income expected from a rent increase. His position presents a different investment calculation for landlords who would rather keep their properties unoccupied than accept lower rental offers. In a market where the number of prospective tenants capable of paying premium rents is limited, prolonged vacancies could ultimately undermine the returns owners are seeking to protect. The financial challenge is particularly relevant to developments such as Azuri Towers, Eko Pearl Towers and Pan Atlantic Towers, alongside newer projects including Paramount Twin Towers in the Oniru Waterfront and Nautica Rise in Oniru. These developments operate within a high-end property segment where residents expect uninterrupted electricity, treated water, sophisticated security systems and professionally managed facilities. For properties situated on reclaimed waterfront land, maintenance requirements may also extend to specialised infrastructure associated with coastal protection and the management of the surrounding environment, depending on the applicable development and estate arrangements. These facilities come at a cost, and property owners may be required to meet their share of maintenance obligations whether or not their apartments are occupied. In Eko Atlantic City, where luxury apartments are marketed at prices ranging from approximately $659,400 to $5 million, the financial burden of maintaining residential towers has become an important consideration for investors seeking long-term tenants. Facility manager, Musa Ogundimu, said that for prospective tenants, the actual cost of securing accommodation in these developments went beyond the advertised rental price. He noted that once annual service charges and other associated obligations were factored in, the overall cost of occupancy could become prohibitive, particularly for individuals and corporate tenants seeking long-term accommodation. Ogundimu added that the situation had also raised questions about the adequacy of maintenance budgeting and the extent to which property owners and residents participated in decisions concerning service charges. Similarly, Managing Director of West Norwood Realty, Alfred Osagie, said facility managers were finding it increasingly difficult to operate within existing maintenance budgets because of persistent increases in the cost of providing services. According to him, maintenance costs had risen by an average of 30 per cent year-on-year over the preceding three years, making it difficult to sustain facilities where property owners expected operational expenses to remain unchanged. Osagie also identified inadequate consideration of life-cycle maintenance costs during property development as an underlying problem, noting that some owners and developers did not fully appreciate the financial resources required to keep their facilities operational. “Properties and estates are like humans. If somebody is sick and the person goes to the hospital, the doctor will not ask how much is in your account. The challenge is that people go into estates without understanding what it requires, and so there is always pressure to be able to work with a particular amount,” he said. He advocated greater involvement of residents and tenants in preparing maintenance budgets, arguing that transparency would make it easier for occupants to understand the reasons behind service-charge adjustments. “The budget must be done with the residents. They must understand why, where materials are purchased from and what we are using them for. It makes it easier to match the level of service to the quality of the asset, the maintenance demand of the asset and the financial capacity of the facility management companies,” Osagie said. His position highlights an important dimension of the service-charge debate: increasing maintenance costs do not automatically justify every amount demanded from residents. Facility managers also have a responsibility to demonstrate how funds are utilised and whether the services delivered correspond with the charges collected. Former President of the International Facility Management Association (IFMA), Nigeria Chapter, Olalekan Akinwumi, similarly emphasised transparency in managing service charges, urging facility managers to provide tenants with regular maintenance reports. He said rising maintenance costs had made budget compliance increasingly difficult, but argued that residents would be more willing to accommodate necessary adjustments when they understood how the money collected was being spent. “The key word in budgeting is transparency. If people somehow feel that they don’t really understand what you are doing, then you are creating problems. Service charge is something that is a headache. At the same time, when you are transparent with it and you carry them along, they will understand,” Akinwumi said.
https://leadership.ng/lagos-luxury-prope.title_zh: 拉各斯豪宅市场应对不断上涨的服务费和日益严重的空置率
https://leadership.ng/lagos-luxury-prope.body_zh: 租金收入与物业维护费用之间日益扩大的差距，正在造成艰难的投资环境，尤其是对那些在高档公寓上投入大量资金、却难以取得与投资相称回报的业主而言。在一些住宅项目中，涵盖供电、水处理、设施管理、社区安保、废弃物处理和公共区域维护的年度服务费已经变得十分高昂，以至于房东越来越倾向于重新考虑传统的住宅出租模式。一位在Victoria Island开展业务的房地产经纪人在要求匿名后告诉LEADERSHIP，这些费用带来的财务影响正使一些长期出租安排失去吸引力。该经纪人说：“如果服务费每年为N12 million至N20 million，而长租 achievable 租金为N25 million至N35 million，那么房东的净利润就被挤压了。”这一局面凸显了拉各斯豪华住宅市场日益受到关注的问题：衡量一套房产的财务吸引力，越来越不仅取决于其租金价值，还取决于维持其正常运营所需的经常性开支。Brick & Click Realty于2026年8月发布的一份拉各斯服务费分析，展示了优质住宅区维护负担的规模。据该公司的《Lagos Service Charge Report》，在配备完善服务的Oniru项目中，一居室和两居室公寓的年度服务费为N1.2 million至N2.5 million，三居室公寓则为N2 million至N4 million。四居室及以上公寓的年度服务费估算为N3.5 million至N6 million。报告指出，在配备完善服务的Banana Island项目中，四居室及以上公寓的相应年度服务费为N7 million至N12 million。发电、水处理、安保、清洁、废弃物管理、电梯维护、配套设施以及重大维修储备金，被列为住宅服务费预算的重要组成部分。尽管这些数字只是指示性的市场估算，而非各个项目的经核实账单，但它们表明，维持优质住宅设施的成本可能对业主和使用者构成一笔可观的经常性开支。这种压力并非拉各斯豪华住宅市场所独有。设施管理专业人士表示，能源、劳动力、进口设备和维护材料成本不断上涨，使住宅和商业物业越来越难以在不调整服务费的情况下维持运营。Solid Foundation Group首席执行官Adetoun Otepola指出，柴油是推高物业维护成本的最大因素之一，并解释称，柴油为住宅和商业开发项目内的多项基本服务提供动力。谈到运营费用上涨给设施管理带来的压力时，她说，柴油是保障公共区域供电、水处理厂、安保系统及其他基本设施运行所必需的。“柴油价格上涨了。在维护成本中，柴油排在首位。我们用它为公共区域供电、保障水处理厂、安保系统和其他基本服务运行。因此，维护成本正在上升。”Otepola说。她补充称，润滑剂、备件和物流价格上涨，加上工资要求不断提高，进一步加重了设施管理人员的财务负担。她的评估解释了为何维护豪华住宅项目越来越昂贵，尤其是在住户期待不间断供电、净化水、正常运行的电梯和全天候安保的情况下。受影响的物业主要集中在连接Ahmadu Bello Way、Oniru、Eko Atlantic City和Bluewater Okunde的一片区域。Palton Morgan Holdings在其2026年9月《Editorial Guide》中将这一新兴豪华房地产走廊称为“新Victoria Island”。近年来，该走廊吸引了大量投资者关注，这得益于基础设施建设、高端住宅项目，以及市场对47.47公里长的Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway的期待。该地区的土地价值也大幅升值。Bluewater Okunde一块约2,400平方米的土地，据称成交价约为N800 million，如今估值已超过N5 billion。然而，物业价值的升值未必同步转化为租金收益率的改善，凸显出滨水物业资本价值与其创造稳定租金收入能力之间日益严重的脱节。市场数据表明，拉各斯一些最昂贵的住宅区未必能提供最强的租金回报。Stears汇编的租金收益率数据显示，Oniru的租金收益率为4.88 per cent，Victoria Island为4.59 per cent，Ikoyi为3.09 per cent。在受考察的各住宅区中，Chevron的收益率最高，达到5.85 per cent。地产测绘与估值公司Ubosi Eleh & Company首席合伙人Chudi Ubosi先生在接受媒体访谈时解释称，过去24个月住宅租金上涨了50至200 per cent，主要原因是通胀以及建筑材料成本上升，后者推高了建设费用。他的评估为房东面临的困难提供了背景，因为开发、运营和维护住宅物业的成本仍在影响投资者的财务测算。更具体地说，Brick & Click Realty联合创始人兼首席运营官Oluwaseyi Adaralegbe在该公司《Q3 2026 Lagos Property Market Outlook》中强调了拉各斯超高端住宅市场租金收益率相对较低的特点。报告估算，由Banana Island、Eko Atlantic和Old Ikoyi组成的超高端岛屿板块，其总租金收益率为3.0至4.8 per cent；相比之下，涵盖Victoria Island、Parkview和Lekki Phase 1的优质岛屿及滨水板块，总租金收益率为3.8至6.0 per cent。报告解释称，超高端地区的物业价值通常更高，但租金收益率相对较低，而一些外围住宅走廊能提供更强的收益回报。重要的是，这些总收益率是在扣除管理费用和适用税费之前计算的，因此扣除服务费及其他运营成本后，房东实际可获得的回报可能低得多。Adaralegbe建议超高端物业业主应优先考虑留住租户，而非设法将租金提高到最高水平；他解释道，该板块的潜在租户群体相对有限，而让公寓空置的成本可能超过涨价预期能够带来的额外收入。他的观点为那些宁愿让物业空置、也不愿接受较低租金报价的房东提供了另一种投资测算方式。在能够支付高端租金的潜在租户数量有限的市场中，长期空置最终可能侵蚀业主试图维护的回报。财务挑战对于Azuri Towers、Eko Pearl Towers和Pan Atlantic Towers等项目尤其 Relevant，也包括Oniru Waterfront的Paramount Twin Towers和Oniru的Nautica Rise等较新项目。这些项目均处于高端物业板块，住户期待不间断供电、净化水、先进的安保系统以及专业管理的设施。对于位于填海滨水土地上的物业，维护要求还可能包括与海岸防护和周边环境管理有关的专业基础设施，具体取决于适用的开发和社区安排。这些设施需要付出成本，无论公寓是否有人入住，业主都可能需要承担其应尽的维护义务。在Eko Atlantic City，豪华公寓的营销价格约为$659,400至$5 million，维持住宅高楼的财务负担，已成为希望获得长期租户的投资者必须考虑的重要因素。设施经理Musa Ogundimu表示，对潜在租户而言，在这些开发项目中获得住所的实际成本超出了宣传的租金价格。他指出，一旦计入年度服务费及其他相关义务，整体入住成本可能高得令人望而却步，尤其是对于寻求长期住所的个人和企业租户而言。Ogundimu还表示，这一局面也引发了人们对维护预算是否充足，以及业主和住户在服务费相关决策中参与程度的质疑。同样，West Norwood Realty董事总经理Alfred Osagie表示，由于提供服务的成本持续上涨，设施管理人员越来越难以在现有维护预算内运营。据他称，过去三年维护成本平均同比上涨30 per cent，使得在业主预期运营费用保持不变的情况下，设施更难维持。Osagie还指出，物业开发过程中未能充分考虑全生命周期维护成本，是一个潜在问题；一些业主和开发商并未充分认识到维持其设施正常运营所需的财务资源。他说：“物业和社区就像人一样。如果有人生病住院，医生不会先问你账户里有多少钱。问题在于，人们入住社区时并不了解需要付出什么，因此总是有压力，必须想办法用特定的资金数额维持运营。”他主张让住户和租户更多参与维护预算的编制，认为提高透明度将使住户更容易理解服务费调整背后的原因。Osagie说：“预算必须与住户共同制定。他们必须了解为什么要调整、材料从哪里采购，以及我们用它们做什么。这样更容易让服务水平与资产质量、资产的维护需求以及设施管理公司的财务能力相匹配。”他的观点凸显了服务费争议的一个重要层面：维护成本上升并不会自动使向住户收取的任何金额都合理。设施管理人员也有责任说明资金如何使用，以及所提供的服务是否与收取的费用相符。国际设施管理协会（IFMA）尼日利亚分会前会长Olalekan Akinwumi同样强调，服务费管理必须保持透明，并敦促设施管理人员定期向租户提供维护报告。他说，维护成本上涨使预算合规变得越来越困难，但住户在了解所收资金的用途后，会更愿意接受必要调整。Akinwumi说：“预算编制的关键词是透明。如果人们觉得他们并不真正了解你在做什么，你就会制造问题。服务费是个令人头疼的问题。但与此同时，只要对它保持透明，并让住户参与其中，他们就会理解。”

https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.summary_zh: 政府表示，扩大普及托育服务并弥合该国的照护服务缺口，将释放重要的经济机会，尤其是对女性而言，因为女性预计将占新增就业岗位的57%至67%。
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.body: The government said expanding access to universal childcare and closing the country’s care gaps would unlock significant economic opportunities, particularly for women, who account for between 57 and 67 per cent of the projected jobs. Speaking at the National Care Forum, themed, ‘Advancing Nigeria’s Care Economy: Jobs, Growth & Productivity’, held on Tuesday in Lagos, the Director of Child Development, Federal Ministry of Women Affairs, Mr. Ali Madugu, who represented the Minister, Hajia Iman Sulaiman-Ibrahim, disclosed that the Federal Executive Council (FEC) approved the National Care Policy and Implementation Plan 2026-2030 on October 28. He said the policy was designed to address the country’s care deficit, create employment opportunities and improve women’s participation in the economy. Madugu added that every $1 invested in childcare could generate $3 in economic returns. Earlier, the Head of Office, Nigeria, International Finance Corporation (IFC), Mr. Christian Mulamula, said Nigeria could unlock up to $22.9 billion in annual GDP by closing its gender gap in care. Describing care as economic infrastructure rather than merely a family responsibility, Mulamula said Nigerian women spend approximately three times as much time on unpaid care work as men, a situation that pushes many out of the workforce. He said about 67 per cent of working parents believed they would be more productive if they had better access to quality childcare. “How do we build a care economy that works for our children, for our families, for our businesses, and for Nigeria’s growth?” he asked. He said investment in quality early childhood programmes could yield returns of up to 13 per cent annually and raise Nigeria’s total factor productivity by as much as two per cent. According to him, 92 per cent of childcare facilities in Nigeria are small and independently owned, while 76 per cent of childcare entrepreneurs lack access to formal financing. Representing the Lagos State Governor, Babajide Sanwo-Olu, the Commissioner for Finance, Mr. Abayomi Oluyomi, said the state had identified care as a priority under its Women Economic Empowerment Policy Roadmap and was developing an investment-oriented care policy framework. He said the state government was working towards building a care economy where families could access reliable and affordable services, care providers could operate viable businesses, and workers in the sector could earn decent livelihoods. Oluyomi, however, warned that government funding alone would not be sufficient to meet the growing demand for care services. Citing Lagos State’s infrastructure financing gap of over N10 trillion against a budget of N4.4 trillion, he said the government needed to establish appropriate regulations, standards and an enabling business environment to attract private investors while ensuring affordability. Also speaking, the Director, Special Duties, Federal Ministry of Budget and Economic Planning, Dr. Gloria Ahmed, said care must be integrated into national and state development plans and budgets. She stressed the need for clear responsibilities, effective coordination and accountability to ensure that the National Care Policy did not become another well-articulated policy without adequate funding. On workforce development and professional standards, the Director, National Board for Technical Education (NBTE), Engineer Sulaiman Yusuf, said the care sector must move beyond its largely informal structure. He disclosed that Nigeria had developed National Occupational Standards for childcare workers, adding that more than 4,500 caregivers, 90 per cent of them women, were already undergoing training. Yusuf called for the establishment of a strong sectoral body to professionalise the workforce without excluding existing informal care workers. Similarly, the UN Women Representative, Ms. Beatrice Eyong, said while unpaid care work was largely undertaken by women, the paid care economy remained dominated by men, with women-led care businesses facing informality and limited access to finance. She called for the provision of labour-saving devices for rural women, improved financial inclusion for women entrepreneurs and greater involvement of men in sharing household care responsibilities. https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.title_zh: 尼日利亚护理经济将创造1700万个就业岗位，并带来93亿美元国内生产总值
https://leadership.ng/nigerias-care-econ.body_zh: 政府表示，扩大普及型托育服务的可及性并弥合全国照护服务缺口，将释放重要的经济机会，尤其有利于女性，因为预计新增岗位中有57%至67%将由女性承担。联邦妇女事务部儿童发展主任阿里·马杜古先生周二在拉各斯举行的全国照护论坛上发言。该论坛主题为“推进尼日利亚照护经济：就业、增长与生产力”。马杜古代表部长哈贾·伊曼·苏莱曼-易卜拉欣出席活动，并透露，联邦执行委员会已于10月28日批准《2026—2030年国家照护政策及实施计划》。他说，该政策旨在应对全国照护服务短缺、创造就业机会并提高女性参与经济活动的程度。马杜古补充说，每投入1美元用于托育服务，就可能带来3美元的经济回报。尼日利亚国际金融公司驻尼日利亚办公室负责人克里斯蒂安·穆拉穆拉先生此前表示，通过弥合照护领域的性别差距，尼日利亚每年可释放高达229亿美元的经济增加值。穆拉穆拉将照护服务视为经济基础设施，而非仅仅是家庭责任。他表示，尼日利亚女性在无偿照护劳动上花费的时间约为男性的三倍，这导致许多人退出劳动力市场。他说，约67%的在职父母认为，如果能更好地获得优质托育服务，他们的工作效率会更高。他问道：“我们如何建设一个对我们的孩子、家庭、企业以及尼日利亚增长都行之有效的照护经济？”他说，对优质幼儿教育项目进行投资，每年可带来高达13%的回报，并可使尼日利亚的全要素生产率提高最多2%。据他介绍，尼日利亚92%的托育服务机构规模较小且由个人独立经营，76%的托育创业者无法获得正规融资。拉各斯州州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢的代理人、财政专员阿巴约米·奥卢约米先生表示，该州已在《妇女经济赋权政策路线图》中将照护服务列为优先事项，并正在制定以投资为导向的照护政策框架。他说，州政府正努力建设照护经济，使家庭能够获得可靠且负担得起的服务，使照护服务提供者能够经营可持续的业务，并使该行业从业者获得体面的生计。然而，奥卢约米警告，仅靠政府资金不足以满足不断增长的照护服务需求。他援引数据称，拉各斯州基础设施融资缺口超过10万亿奈拉，而州预算为4.4万亿奈拉，因此政府需要制定适当的法规、标准并营造有利的商业环境，以吸引私人投资者，同时确保服务价格可负担。联邦预算与经济规划部特别事务主任格洛丽亚·艾哈迈德博士也发言说，必须将照护服务纳入国家和各州的发展计划及预算。她强调，需要明确责任、有效协调和问责机制，确保《国家照护政策》不会成为又一项表述完善却缺乏充足资金支持的政策。在劳动力发展和专业标准方面，国家技术教育委员会主任苏莱曼·优素福工程师表示，照护行业必须摆脱目前以非正规经营为主的结构。他透露，尼日利亚已经制定了托育服务人员国家职业标准，目前已有4,500多名照护人员接受培训，其中90%为女性。优素福呼吁建立强有力的行业机构，以推动 workforce 专业化，同时不排斥现有的非正规照护人员。联合国妇女署代表比阿特丽斯·埃永女士同样表示，虽然无偿照护劳动主要由女性承担，但有偿照护经济仍由男性主导，女性经营的照护企业面临非正规经营和融资渠道有限的问题。她呼吁为农村女性提供省力设备，改善女性创业者的金融普惠，并推动男性更多分担家庭照护责任。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《领导力新闻》WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取更新 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.title_zh: 韩国政府向缅甸派遣“大韩航空858号飞机1987年坠落事件”首个现场调查团
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金志宪＝韩国政府将首次赴现场调查1987年因朝鲜炸弹恐怖袭击而坠毁的大韩航空KAL 858航班残骸。18日，据政府当局介绍，由外交部、海洋警察厅等组成的调查组已于上周派往缅甸当地，正在开展调查。调查组正在调查缅甸附近海域，该海域据推测是疑似KAL 858航班的机体沉没地点。據悉，政府此次调查值得关注的是，即使打捞机体较为困难，仍有可能确保获取机内遗留物品等。KAL 858航班于1987年11月29日从伊拉克巴格达出发，飞往首尔途中在印度洋上空消失。机上115名乘客和机组人员全部失踪，当时政府未能发现遗体或遗留物品。事件根据国家安全企划部调查结果及参与政府时期的重新调查结果，最终认定为“朝鲜特工金贤熙实施的空中爆炸恐怖袭击事件”，但家属指出案件除金贤熙的供述外没有其他物证等，要求查明真相。报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo＜版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用＞2026/11/18 17:50发布，2026年11月18日17时50分发稿
