https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body: (부산=연합뉴스) 김주환 기자 = 펄어비스[263750]의 '붉은사막'이 한 해 출시된 최고의 한국 게임에 주어지는 '대한민국 게임대상' 대통령상 수상의 영예를 안았다. 붉은사막은 18일 부산 해운대구 벡스코(BEXCO) 제2전시장에서 열린 2026 대한민국 게임대상 시상식에서 대통령상에 해당하는 대상을 받았다. 붉은사막은 이날 대상을 포함해 기술창작상 기획·시나리오, 사운드, 그래픽, 캐릭터 4개 분야를 모두 석권했고 '글로벌게임상'도 수상했다. 개발사 펄어비스의 조용현 개발 PD는 우수 개발자상, 주인공 '클리프'를 연기한 이현 성우는 인기성우상을 받으며 '붉은사막'은 총 8관왕에 올랐다. 이는 2019년 스마일게이트의 '로스트아크', 2023년 네오위즈[095660]의 'P의 거짓'이 받은 6관왕 기록을 경신하는 수치다. 붉은사막은 높은 자유도와 기술적 완성도, 제작진의 지속적인 게임 업데이트 노력이 좋은 평가를 받으며 출시 80여일만에 전 세계에서 600만 장이 넘게 팔렸다. 허진영 펄어비스 대표는 "펄어비스는 게임 개발자들이 회사의 중심이 되어 이용자들에게는 지금까지 없었던 새로운 재미와, 그리고 잊지 못할 경험을 선사하겠다는 목표 아래 지금까지 달려왔다"라며 "붉은사막이 저희의 그 마음을 조금이나마 전달할 수 있어서 너무 기쁘게 생각한다"라고 소감을 밝혔다. 이어 "앞으로도 펄어비스의 게임을 더욱 기대해 달라"라며 "이용자들의 사랑에 보답할 수 있는 게임으로 계속해서 최선을 다하겠다"라고 덧붙였다. 아이온2는 작년 11월 19일 한국과 대만 시장에 출시됐고, 지난달 출시한 글로벌 버전이 최고 동시 접속자 40만 명 이상을 기록하며 엔씨의 대표 흥행작으로 자리 잡았다. 엔씨에서 '아이온2' 개발을 주도한 백승욱 부사장은 "여러분들의 관심과 사랑, 그리고 응원, 그리고 때로는 따가운 질책이 모두 '아이온2'를 자라게 하는 가장 큰 원동력이 되었다"라며 게임 팬들에게 감사를 전했다. 그러면서 "'아이온2'라는 IP의 가치를 믿고 아낌없이 지원해 주신 김택진·박병무 공동대표 두 분 대표님께도 정말 정말 감사드린다"라고 덧붙였다. 우수상에는 슈퍼캣의 '도깨비의세계', 렐루게임즈의 '미메시스', 에이버튼의 '제우스: 오만의 신'이 각각 선정됐다. 사회적 가치를 담은 '굿게임상'에는 일제 강점기 언론의 역할과 자유의 가치를 조명한 인디 게임 '그날의 신문'이 선정됐다. '그날의 신문'을 만든 정찬영 다이빙스튜디오 대표는 "게임은 글이나 영상 같은 다른 문화 콘텐츠보다도 훨씬 더 좋은 전달감을 가진 매체"라며 "게임을 만들며 아쉬운 부분도 많았는데, 다음 게임을 만들 떄는 더 좋은 게임을 만들 수 있도록 노력하겠다"라고 말했다. 지난해 신설된 '인기성우상'은 '붉은사막'의 주인공 '클리프' 역할을 맡은 성우 이현(본명 이재현)이 작년에 이어 2회 연속으로 수상했다. 이현 성우는 "캐릭터의 여정에 제 목소리나 호흡이 함께할 수 있다면, 그리고 오랜 시간 그 작품과 그 캐릭터들이 사랑받을 수 있다면, 저 또한 사랑받고 있는 게 아닌가라고 생각한다"라며 "'붉은사막'의 클리프를 사랑하고, 함께 그 시간들을 겪어 주셨던 많은 분께 감사하다"라고 소감을 밝혔다. e스포츠발전상에는 '이터널 리턴' e스포츠 대회를 성공적으로 운영하며 한국 e스포츠 생태계 저변을 넓힌 님블뉴런이, 사회공헌우수상에는 장기간 국내 게임 스타트업 지원사업을 주도한 장현영 엔씨 대외협력상무가 수상의 영예를 안았다. 인디게임상에는 'AIXLAB'의 '골목길: 귀흔'이 선정됐다. 한국의 익숙한 골목길을 공포 게임으로 재해석한 작품이다. 최휘영 문화체육관광부 장관은 축사를 통해 "K-게임은 뛰어난 기술력과 창의성을 바탕으로 세계 시장에서 경쟁력을 입증하고 있으며, 전 세계 이용자에게 즐거움과 감동을 선사하고 있다"라고 말했다. 이어 "문화체육관광부도 창의적인 인디 게임, 세계 시장을 선도할 수 있는 대작 게임에 대한 지원을 내년부터 새롭게 추진할 것"이라며 "올해 마련돼 게임산업에 중점적으로 투자하는 1천200억원 규모의 IP 펀드와 함께, 내년에는 콘텐츠 분야에 1조5천억원 규모 펀드와 6천억원 규모의 융자를 기반으로 든든히 뒷받침하겠다"라고 설명했다. 대한민국 게임대상은 매년 문화체육관광부가 주최하고 한국게임산업협회가 주관하는 국내 최고 권위의 게임 시상식이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.title_zh: 韩国电竞项目纳入亚运会后，“红色沙漠”和《ion2》均获奖
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body_zh: （釜山=韩联社）记者金周焕报道：佩尔维斯[263750]的动作冒险游戏《红色沙漠》摘得年度最佳韩国游戏“韩国游戏大奖”总统奖的桂冠。18日，在釜山海云台区贝克斯科（BEXCO）第二展场举行的2026年“韩国游戏大奖”颁奖典礼上，《红色沙漠》获得了与总统奖相当的奖项。《红色沙漠》继当天斩获大奖外，还包揽了技术创作奖的策划与剧本、声音、图像和角色4个领域奖项，并获得“全球游戏奖”。开发商佩尔维斯首席开发商赵炯贤获得优秀开发者奖，饰演主人公“克里夫”的配音演员李贤获得人气配音演员奖，《红色沙漠》由此共获8项大奖。这一成绩刷新了2019年Smilegate《失落的方舟》和2023年Neowiz[095660]《P的谎言》获得的6项大奖纪录。《红色沙漠》凭借较高的自由度、较高的技术完成度以及制作团队持续更新游戏的努力获得良好评价，发行约80天后全球销量已突破600万份。佩尔维斯代表许真英表示：“佩尔维斯始终以游戏开发者为公司核心，在为玩家带来前所未有的全新乐趣和难忘体验的目标下走到了今天。很高兴《红色沙漠》能够多少传递出我们的这份心意。”他补充说：“今后也请大家继续期待佩尔维斯的游戏，我们会继续努力，打造能够回报玩家厚爱的游戏。”《Aion 2》去年11月19日在韩国和台湾市场推出，上个月发布的全球版本最高同时在线人数突破40万，成为NCSoft的代表性热门作品。NCSoft主导《Aion 2》开发的常务副总裁白承旭表示：“各位的关注、喜爱、支持，有时还有严厉的批评，都是推动《Aion 2》成长最大的动力。”他向游戏玩家致谢，并补充道：“也真心感谢始终相信《Aion 2》这一IP的价值并给予无私支持的金泽真和朴炳茂两位共同代表。”优秀奖方面，分别由SuperCat的《鬼魅世界》、Relight Games的《Mimecis》和Aiverton的《宙斯：傲慢之神》获得。强调社会价值的“善意游戏奖”则由独立游戏《那一天的报纸》获得，该作探讨了日本殖民时期媒体的作用和自由的价值。《那一天的报纸》制作方Diving Studio代表郑灿英表示：“游戏是一种比文字和影像等其他文化内容更具良好传达力的媒介。制作游戏时虽有许多遗憾之处，但我们会努力创作下一款游戏，争取做出更优秀的作品。”去年新设的“人气配音演员奖”由《红色沙漠》主人公“克里夫”的配音演员李贤（本名李在贤）获得，他继去年之后连续第二年获奖。李贤表示：“如果能让自己的声音和呼吸伴随角色的旅程，并让作品和角色得到长久喜爱，那么我想我也在被爱着。谨向喜爱《红色沙漠》的克里夫，并陪伴大家度过这段时光的许多人致谢。”电子竞技发展奖授予了成功运营《永恒轮回》电子竞技赛事、拓宽韩国电子竞技生态边界的Nimble Neuron，社会贡献优秀奖则授予了长期主导韩国国内游戏初创企业支持项目的NCSoft对外合作常务理事张贤英。独立游戏奖由AIXLAB的《巷弄：鬼痕》获得，该作以韩国人熟悉的巷弄为背景，将其重新诠释为恐怖游戏。文化体育观光部长崔辉英致辞表示：“K-游戏凭借出色的技术实力和创造力，已在世界市场证明自身竞争力，并为全球玩家带来欢乐与感动。”他接着说：“文化体育观光部也将从明年起重新推进对创意独立游戏以及能够引领世界市场的重大游戏的支援。继今年设立重点投资游戏产业的1200亿韩元规模IP基金后，明年我们将依托1万亿5000亿韩元规模的内容领域基金和6000亿韩元规模的融资，提供坚实支持。”韩国游戏大奖是文化体育观光部每年主办、韩国游戏产业协会承办的国内最高权威游戏颁奖典礼。联系方式：KakaoTalk MANILA, Philippines – US President Donald Trump on Wednesday, November 18, announced what he described as “the biggest trade deal” between the Philippines and the United States during the final activity of his brief state visit to Manila. Trump disclosed this in his remarks at the state luncheon in his honor in Malacañang Palace following his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr ., but gave no details about the deal. “We’ve just consummated a trade deal, the biggest trade deal we’ve ever made by far and it’s a fair deal for both countries. We’re very happy with it. We didn’t know that was going to take place but it took place very quickly. It’s a magnificent deal for both,” Trump said. “So today, under the leadership of President Marcos and myself, I’m proud to say that we’re making the alliance between the United States and the Philippines much stronger than it’s ever been before, especially with the consummation of this deal,” he added. Marcos’ office later said both sides reached an understanding on areas of economic cooperation, but made no mention of a trade deal. Trade representatives of both countries will work closely to translate the commitments into concrete initiatives, it said in a statement. “I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different trade deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark, and, in particular, a deal that will be great for our farmers and those in the business of ‘energy,'” Trump said on Truth Social after his Philippine visit, but gave no further details. Negotiations on a trade deal between the two allies were not mentioned in any schedules released by either country. “The US offered for us to diversify our food supply and energy requirements,” said Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez. Asked whether anything was signed, Romualdez said in a text message, “None.” Trump said in his remarks at the start of his bilateral meeting with Marcos that the US is expanding its defense cooperation with the Philippines. The Philippines and the US are treaty allies through the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty, the core of their ties, signed years after Washington recognized Manila’s independence. The treaty covers possible attacks in the South China Sea . In December 2025, the US Congress passed the Philippines Enhance Resilience Act , which authorizes allocating $500 million annually in foreign military financing to the Philippines, totaling $2.5 billion by 2030. Trump also signaled that the US wants deepened collaboration in energy security, particularly nuclear energy. He added that the US may do “something very big” in the civilian nuclear industry. “And for the Philippines to embrace American technology in its first modern nuclear project would underscore the strength of the important relationship,” he said. In February, the US announced several initiatives to help the Philippines in integrating nuclear power into its energy mix by 2032. This was two years after the enforcement of a landmark civil nuclear cooperation agreement between the two countries in 2024. (READ: A nuclear Philippines in six years? OECD’s nuclear chief isn’t convinced. ) While the Philippines and the US have been strong allies, this alliance was tested during the administration of Marcos’ predecessor, Rodrigo Duterte, who sought a pivot to China, but this foreign policy direction had since been reset under Marcos. The years that followed saw an increase in the intensity of military training exercises, as well as the frequency of joint sails in the West Philippine Sea, including near areas that China claims or de-facto controls. 2026年11月18日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达马拉坎南宫，出席以菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 举行的国事访问午宴。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在访问期间宣布了与菲律宾达成一项重要贸易协议，称这是两国之间规模最大的贸易协议。尽管贸易协议的细节尚未公布，两国代表将着手把各项承诺转化为具体举措，重点推进经济合作。菲律宾官员表示，特朗普国事访问期间并未签署协议。特朗普强调，加强防务关系以及在能源安全、尤其是核能领域的合作，是美菲现有联盟关系的一部分。 本文由人工智能生成。阅读全文以了解完整背景。报告错误。 菲律宾马尼拉——11月18日星期三，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在结束对马尼拉短暂国事访问的最后一项活动期间宣布，他所称为菲律宾与美国之间“最大贸易协议”的协议。特朗普是在马拉坎南宫举行的以其名义举行的国事午宴上，在与总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 举行双边会谈后透露这一消息的，但没有透露协议细节。 特朗普说：“我们刚刚完成了一项贸易协议，这是我们迄今达成过的最大贸易协议，而且对双方都是公平的协议。我们对此非常满意。我们事先不知道会达成协议，但协议推进得很快。这对双方来说都是一项极其出色的协议。” 他补充道：“因此，今天，在马科斯总统和我本人的领导下，我感到自豪地说，随着这项协议的达成，我们正在把美国与菲律宾之间的联盟关系加强到前所未有的程度。” 马科斯办公室后来表示，双方在经济合作领域达成了共识，但未提及贸易协议。办公室在一份声明中说，两国贸易代表将密切合作，把各项承诺转化为具体举措。 特朗普结束对菲律宾的访问后在Truth Social上表示：“我高兴地宣布，我们与菲律宾达成了一项全新且完全不同的贸易协议。这将是一项真正的里程碑，尤其是一项对农民以及能源行业从业者大有裨益的协议。”但他没有透露进一步细节。 两国作为盟友就贸易协议开展的谈判，并未出现在任一国家发布的任何日程安排中。 菲律宾驻美国大使何塞·曼努埃尔·罗穆亚尔德斯说：“美国提出要帮助我们实现食品供应和能源需求多元化。”当被问及是否签署了任何文件时，罗穆亚尔德斯在短信中回答：“没有。” 特朗普在与马科斯双边会谈开始时表示，美国正在扩大与菲律宾的防务合作。根据1951年《共同防御条约》，菲律宾与美国是条约盟友。该条约是两国关系的核心，签署时间是在华盛顿承认马尼拉独立多年之后。条约涵盖南海可能发生的袭击。 2025年12月，美国国会通过《菲律宾增强韧性法案》，授权每年向菲律宾拨款5亿美元的外军融资，到2030年累计将达到25亿美元。 特朗普还暗示，美国希望加强在能源安全、尤其是核能领域的合作。他补充称，美国可能在民用核工业领域采取“非常重大的行动”。 他说：“菲律宾在其首个现代核项目中采用美国技术，将凸显这一重要关系的 strength。” 2月，美国宣布多项举措，帮助菲律宾到2032年将核能纳入其能源结构。这是两国于2024年实施一项具有里程碑意义的民用核能合作协议两年后公布的。 （阅读：菲律宾六年后会拥有核能吗？OECD核能负责人并不确信。） 尽管菲律宾与美国一直是Strong盟友，但这段联盟关系在马科斯的前任罗德里戈·杜特尔特执政期间曾受到考验。杜特尔特曾寻求转向中国，但此后这一外交政策方向在马科斯任内得到重新调整。 此后的几年里，军演强度有所提升，在西菲律宾海举行联合巡航的频率也有所增加，其中包括靠近中国声称拥有或实际控制的海域。 加载相关话题 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111816.body_zh: （东京＝韩联社）本报特派记者赵成美＝上月正值史上最多规模演唱会与红叶季重叠，赴日韩国游客人数以10月为准创下历史最高纪录。日本政府观光局（JNTO）18日公布的10月赴日外国游客统计显示，上月访问日本的韩国游客达103万5800人，同比增长19.4%。今年1月访问日本的韩国游客也同比增长21.6%，达到117万6000人，创月度历史最高纪录。自从日本首相高市早苗去年10月暗示可能“介入台海局势”后，中国政府发出提醒敦促国民控制赴日旅行，中国访日游客受此影响减少47.0%，降至37万9500人，连续11个月下滑。10月赴日外国游客人数尽管受到中国游客减少影响，但在秋季出游旺季和日元贬值带动下增长0.4%，达到391万2500人。不过，今年截至10月累计访日游客人数为3464万3000人，同比减少2.5%。请通过KakaoTalk的okjebo投稿（版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、发行及用于人工智能学习和应用）2026/11/18 17:43发稿，2026年11月18日17时43分发稿

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary_zh: 马金德-达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定暂停联邦层面的招聘，并称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境，尤其是求职青年的处境毫不在意。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs. The organisation said the decision contradicted the All Progressives Congress (APC)’s promises on job creation and raised concerns about the government’s commitment to addressing unemployment. In a press statement dated November 17, 2026, and signed by its Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Nnanna Ihediwa, the campaign organisation described the recruitment freeze as an indication of what it called the shortcomings of the Tinubu administration’s economic policies. It also expressed concern that the embargo could precede possible mass retrenchment in the public service under the guise of fiscal discipline, particularly if Tinubu secured re-election in 2027. The organisation cited World Bank estimates that approximately 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, arguing that restricting federal recruitment would further limit employment opportunities for young people. The MDPCO also rejected the Presidency’s explanation that the embargo was intended to consolidate public service reforms and enable the government to properly determine personnel requirements for the 2027 budget. It argued that the government should instead focus on expanding the economy, harnessing the country’s human and natural resources, and creating employment opportunities. The campaign organisation further faulted comments attributed to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, describing Nigerians complaining about hunger and hardship as lazy. According to the statement, the 2027 general election would provide Nigerians an opportunity to assess the economic direction of the country and decide on the leadership they want. It contrasted the Federal Government’s recruitment policy with what it described as employment-generating initiatives under Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde. The organisation said Makinde’s administration had expanded economic opportunities in Oyo State through public and private sector initiatives, particularly in agriculture, infrastructure, education, transportation and other critical sectors. It specifically highlighted the establishment of the Oyo State Agribusiness Development Agency (OYSADA), which it said had transformed traditional farm settlements into modern agro-industrial hubs. Other initiatives cited included investments in power generation, aviation, road infrastructure, water resources, revenue reforms and improvements in the public workforce. The campaign organisation said Makinde’s proposed RESET Nigeria Agenda was anchored on expanding economic opportunities, reducing waste without weakening public institutions, maintaining fiscal discipline without restricting employment, and pursuing economic stability without undermining citizens’ livelihoods. It said the agenda offered an alternative economic direction ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The organisation urged Nigerians to consider Makinde, who is the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election, arguing that his administration’s development approach in Oyo State could be replicated at the national level. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队就联邦招聘禁令指责蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body_zh:
第一层 马金德－达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定禁止联邦政府机构招聘，称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境缺乏体谅，尤其是对正在寻找工作的年轻人。该组织表示，这项决定与进步大会党（APC）关于创造就业岗位的承诺相悖，并引发人们对政府解决失业问题承诺的担忧。

在一份日期为2026年11月17日、由其战略传播主任理查德·恩南纳·伊赫迪瓦签署的新闻声明中，该竞选组织称冻结招聘凸显了其所称的蒂努布政府经济政策的缺陷。它还担忧，这项禁令可能先于公共部门可能发生的大规模裁员，而裁员将以财政纪律为名，尤其是在蒂努布于2027年成功连任的情况下。该组织援引世界银行的估算称，每年约有350万名尼日利亚人进入劳动力市场，并认为限制联邦招聘将进一步减少年轻人的就业机会。

MDPCO还驳斥了总统府关于实施招聘禁令旨在巩固公共服务改革、使政府能够妥善确定2027年预算人员需求的解释。它认为，政府转而应当专注于扩大经济，开发国家的人力和自然资源，并创造就业机会。

该竞选组织还批评了据称出自APC总统竞选委员会主任、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里参议员的言论，称他把抱怨饥饿和困苦的尼日利亚人描述为懒惰。

声明表示，2027年大选将为尼日利亚人提供一次机会，以评估国家经济的发展方向，并决定他们希望由谁领导。该组织将联邦政府的招聘政策与其所称的奥约州州长塞伊·马金德推行的就业创造举措进行了对比。该组织说，马金德政府通过公共和私营部门的举措扩大了奥约州的经济机会，尤其是在农业、基础设施、教育、交通运输及其他关键领域。

该组织特别提到成立奥约州农业综合发展局（OYSADA），并称该机构已把传统农庄转变为现代农工业中心。列举的其他举措包括对发电、航空、道路基础设施、水资源、税收改革和公共 workforce 改善的投资。

该竞选组织表示，马金德提出的“重置尼日利亚议程”以扩大经济机会、在不削弱公共机构的情况下减少浪费、在不限制就业的情况下维持财政纪律，以及在不损害公民生计的情况下追求经济稳定为基础。它称，在2027年总统选举前夕，该议程提供了一条替代性的经济发展道路。

该组织敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选中考虑马金德。他是联盟人民运动（APM）的总统候选人。该组织认为，他在奥约州采用的发展方式可以在全国范围内复制。

MANILA, Philippines – US President Donald Trump ’s arrival in Manila on Tuesday, November 17, is expected to draw protests, with activists preparing to march against the US-led Pax Silica. Protesters have been holding a campout at Liwasang Bonifacio since Sunday, November 15. They plan to march to the Philippine International Convention Center, the venue of the ASEAN-US Special Summit which Trump will attend, ahead of the US leader’s arrival. The protesters are opposing Pax Silica, a US-led initiative that seeks to secure supply chains for critical minerals and semiconductors through partnerships with other countries. Trump is expected to arrive in the Philippines at 5:30 pm. He will conduct a state visit before leaving the country on Wednesday, November 18. Activists have warned that Pax Silica could put indigenous communities and farming areas at risk, particularly amid growing demand for minerals used in advanced technologies. The Philippine National Police has deployed around 20,000 personnel across summit venues and nearby areas. Security forces faced protesters on the summit’s opening day on Sunday, when police arrested around 300 people in Manila and Muntinlupa . 抗议活动。2026年11月15日，武装分子聚集在马尼拉的 Liwasang Bonifacio，抗议拟议中的 Pax Silica 倡议以及美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对第49届东盟峰会的访问。

菲律宾马尼拉——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普预计于11月17日星期二抵达马尼拉，届时将引发抗议活动，活动人士正准备举行游行，反对美国主导的 Pax Silica。

自11月15日星期日起，抗议者一直在 Liwasang Bonifacio 扎营。他们计划在特朗普抵达前游行前往菲律宾国际会议中心；东盟—美国特别峰会将在该中心举行，特朗普将出席。

抗议者反对 Pax Silica。这是一项由美国主导的倡议，旨在通过与其他国家建立伙伴关系，保障关键矿产和半导体的供应链。

特朗普预计于下午5时30分抵达菲律宾。他将进行国事访问，随后于11月18日星期三离开该国。

星期三，特朗普将在 Malacañang 参加与其国事访问有关的活动，抗议者预计将在 Liwasang Bonifacio 聚集，并游行前往 Malacañang 附近的 Mendiola。

通往 Ayala Bridge 和 Recto Avenue、方向为 Mendiola Peace Arch 的道路已对机动车驾驶者和行人封闭。周边已设置围栏和路障。

活动人士警告称，Pax Silica 可能使原住民社区和农业地区面临风险，尤其是在先进技术所需矿产的需求日益增长之际。

菲律宾国家警察已在各峰会会场及周边地区部署约2万名人员。峰会开幕日当天，安全部队与抗议者发生对峙；警方在马尼拉和 Muntinlupa 逮捕约300人。

这些逮捕行动遭到议员和多个团体的谴责。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Army academy will be relocated to the central Chungcheong region, while the Navy and Air Force academies will be kept in place, the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the government said Wednesday, revising an earlier plan to merge them into a unified military college. The revised plan retains the initial proposal to establish a joint academy at the Jaundae military complex in the central city of Daejeon, about 140 kilometers south of Seoul, but each armed service will keep their existing schools as a regional campus. To do so, the Korea Military Academy — the Army college — will move out of Seoul and be relocated to a site in the central-western region of Chungcheong. The Navy Academy and the Air Force Academy will stay in their current locations -- in the southern coastal county of Jinhae and the central provincial city of Cheongju, respectively. "For specialized training during the second and third years, it is more efficient to keep the Navy and Air Force academies at their current locations, but we needed to find a new location for the Army academy," Rep. Kim Byung-joo told reporters after a policy coordination meeting between party and government officials. The exact relocation site for the Army academy in the Chungcheong region has yet to be decided, Kim added. The revised plan will adopt a so-called 1-2-1 model, where cadets complete shared coursework in their first and final years at the joint military academy and spend their second and third years for branch-specific training at their respective schools. The revision also includes a plan to establish a new graduate school for master's and doctoral courses at the main campus to offer a path for in-depth military education, the defense ministry said in release. The government plans to apply the new system to cadets entering in 2029, with each military branch continuing to recruit cadets separately until then to minimize confusion. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul expressed his commitment to establishing the combined academy to nurture creative talent capable of breaking away from conventional educational frameworks. "By having Army, Navy and Air Force cadets train together and unite as a single warrior community, we will foster them into key leaders of our military capable of prevailing on any battlefield," Kang said during the meeting. Kang also stressed the need to set a "clear and bold direction," while reviewing the implementation process in a "thorough and prudent" manner. The new military academy will operate directly under the ministry, unlike the existing academies that fall under each individual armed service, the ministry said, citing the need for a "consistent and balanced" management and oversight in budget and other related policies. The revised plan marks a retreat from an initial July proposal to merge the three service academies into a single institution inside the Jaundae compound and close down the existing schools. Amid growing opposition to the plan, Kang, a retired Army general, had signaled an adjustment to the initial framework, highlighting that the move is not aimed at abolishing the three academies. Alumni groups have denounced the planned integration as an attempt to weaken the core identity and capabilities of each military branch. Army college graduates, in particular, have argued that it was a politically driven move by the Lee Jae Myung administration to curb the Army's influence over its involvement in past military coups and the short-lived martial law attempt by former President Yoon Suk Yeol in 2024

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）和政府周三表示，将把陆军士官学校迁至忠清中部地区，海军和空军士官学校则维持原址，并修改此前将三校合并为统一军校的方案。修订后的方案保留了在位于大田市中心的驻在台军事基地设立联合学校的最初提议；大田位于首尔以南约140公里，但各军种仍将以地区分校区形式保留现有学校。为此，韩国陆军士官学校将迁出首尔，迁至忠清中西部的某个地点。海军士官学校和空军士官学校将分别继续设在南部沿海的镇海和忠清道的省会清州。执政党与政府官员举行政策协调会议后，议员金炳周对记者说：“二、三年级进行专业训练时，让海军和空军士官学校留在现址更为高效，但我们需要为陆军士官学校寻找新地点。”金补充说，陆军士官学校迁往忠清地区的具体地点尚未确定。修订后的方案将采用所谓的“1-2-1模式”：学员在联合军校完成第一学年和最后一学年的共同课程，第二和第三学年则分别在各自学校接受军种专业训练。国防部在一份声明中说，修订方案还包括在主校区设立新的研究生院，开设硕士和博士课程，为深入军事教育提供途径。政府计划从2029年入学的学员开始实施新制度，在此之前，各军种将继续分别招收学员，以尽量减少混乱。国防部长姜善淳表示，他致力于建立综合性军校，培养能够摆脱传统教育框架的创新型人才。姜在会上说：“让陆军、海军和空军学员共同训练，并团结为一个统一的武士共同体，我们将把他们培养成能够在任何战场上取得胜利的军队中坚领导力量。”他还强调，需要确立“明确而大胆的方向”，并以“全面而审慎”的方式审查实施过程。国防部表示，与现有士官学校分别隶属于各军种不同，新军校将由国防部直接管辖；国防部称，此举是为了确保预算及其他相关政策得到“一致且均衡”的管理和监督。修订后的方案意味着放弃7月最初提出的方案，即把三所军种士官学校合并为驻在台园区内的一所机构，并关闭现有学校。随着反对该计划的呼声日益高涨，退役陆军上将姜善淳曾表示将调整最初框架，强调此举并非旨在废除三所士官学校。校友团体谴责拟议中的整合是企图削弱各军种的核心认同和能力。陆军士官学校毕业生尤其认为，这是李在明政府出于政治目的推动的动作，意在遏制陆军的影响力，尤其是其与过去军事政变以及前总统尹锡悦2024年短暂戒严尝试之间的关联。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: SHENZHEN, China — President Lee Jae Myung held bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Wednesday, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders’ meeting. It is their third summit since Lee took office in June 2025, with two previous meetings in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province in November 2025 and Beijing in January. The leaders will review progress in bilateral relations and discuss ways to expand mutually beneficial economic cooperation, including trade and investment, presidential spokesperson Kim Sung-wan said in a written briefing issued ahead of the meeting. Attention is also on whether Lee and Xi will discuss possible U.S.-North Korea talks, as U.S. President Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and referred to a possible role for Xi. With an upcoming U.S.-China-Russia summit drawing international attention, Lee’s message on Northeast Asian security will also be closely watched given South Korea’s direct stake in the region

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook asked for people's understanding Wednesday in connection with disaster alert messages that the government plans to send as part of efforts to prevent cheating during the nationwide college entrance exam this week. Alert messages for the highest level of disasters, which are designed to reach all mobile phones and sound a loud alarm even when the phone is muted, will be sent to detect any hidden mobile phones that can be used to cheat with artificial intelligence (AI) during the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) on Thursday. "We recognize that receiving these messages may cause some inconvenience," Han said during a meeting with the ruling Democratic Party of Korea and the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae. "However, we once again ask for your kind understanding as this is an unavoidable step taken to ensure that our children can take the exam under fair conditions." She vowed again to make utmost efforts to make sure the exam goes fairly. "Even though concerns are high over whether measures to prevent cheating will be effective and if they might only end up heightening anxiety among students, the government, the ruling party and the presidential office will put forth our best efforts to alleviate the worries of honest students and their parents," Han said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首相呼吁民众理解大学入学考试期间发送的警报信息
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总理韩升洙周三就政府计划在本周全国大学入学考试期间发送灾害警报信息一事，请求民众予以理解。这是政府为防止作弊而采取的措施之一。最高级别灾害警报信息将发送至所有手机，即使手机处于静音状态，也会发出响亮警报。此举旨在发现周四大学修学能力试验期间可用于借助人工智能作弊的隐藏手机。韩升洙在同执政的韩国民主党和总统府青瓦台举行的会议上说：“我们认识到，接收这些信息可能会给民众带来一些不便。”“不过，我们再次恳请大家予以体谅，因为这是确保我们的孩子们能在公平条件下参加考试而必须采取的一步。”她再次承诺将尽最大努力确保考试公平进行。韩升洙说：“尽管外界非常担忧防作弊措施是否有效，以及这些措施是否会徒增学生的焦虑，政府、执政党和总统府将尽最大努力，缓解诚信考生及其家长的担忧。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/doll.body: Layer 1 The Nigerian naira opened trading on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, under sustained demand pressure across both the official Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market (NFEM) and the parallel market, with the gap between the two segments widening further. At the official window, data published by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) shows that the naira closed the previous session on Tuesday, November 17, at a volume-weighted NFEM rate of ₦1,358.09 per dollar. During Tuesday’s official trading session, the local currency opened at ₦1,355.80 per dollar and fluctuated between an intraday high of ₦1,354.00 and a low of ₦1,364.50 before settling at ₦1,363.00 at the close. Meanwhile, live international interbank spot tracking early Wednesday morning hovered around ₦1,351.25 per dollar. In the parallel market, commonly referred to as the black market, the naira traded significantly weaker. Street dealers and Bureau de Change (BDC) operators in Lagos and Abuja quoted the US dollar at an average of ₦1,440 per dollar early Wednesday morning, with buying and selling rates ranging between ₦1,435 and ₦1,445 per dollar. Based on the latest official NFEM rate of ₦1,358.09 and the parallel market average of ₦1,440.00, the spread between the official and unofficial markets currently stands at approximately ₦81.91 per dollar. Market analysts note that the persistent divergence between both windows reflects heightened seasonal import demand, corporate foreign exchange obligations, and a slowdown in autonomous dollar inflows. Recent market intelligence indicates that while Nigeria’s external reserves slipped slightly by roughly $390 million from their late-October peak of $55.26 billion due to central bank market interventions, the reserve buffer remains over 26 percent higher than the $43.54 billion recorded during the same period in 2025. Financial analysts expect the Central Bank of Nigeria to maintain liquidity support in the official NFEM window to keep official rates anchored near the ₦1,350 to ₦1,365 band, even as retail and unfulfilled demand continues to exert upward pressure on parallel market quotes. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/doll.title_zh: 今日美元兑奈拉汇率，2026年11月18日
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/doll.body_zh: 第一层 2026年11月18日星期三，尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）奈拉在官方尼日利亚外汇市场（NFEM）和平行市场均承受持续需求压力的情况下开盘，两大市场之间的价差进一步扩大。在官方市场窗口，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）公布的数据显示，奈拉在11月17日星期二上一交易时段收于按交易量加权的NFEM汇率每美元₦1,358.09。星期二官方交易时段内，本币以每美元₦1,355.80开盘，盘中在每美元₦1,354.00的日内高点与每美元₦1,364.50的低点之间波动，收盘时报每美元₦1,363.00。与此同时，周三早间国际银行间即期汇率实时追踪显示，奈拉在每美元₦1,351.25附近徘徊。在通常被称为黑市的平行市场，奈拉走势明显疲软。周三早间，拉各斯和阿布贾的街头交易商及兑换点（BDC）经营者报出美元平均兑换价为每美元₦1,440，买入价和卖出价介于每美元₦1,435至₦1,445之间。根据最新官方NFEM汇率₦1,358.09和平行市场平均汇率₦1,440.00计算，官方与非官方市场之间的价差目前约为每美元₦81.91。市场分析人士指出，两个窗口持续背离，反映出季节性进口需求上升、企业外汇支付责任以及自主美元流入放缓。近期市场情报显示，受中央银行干预外汇市场影响，尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）外汇储备从10月下旬的552.6亿美元高点小幅下降约3.9亿美元，但储备缓冲仍比2025年同期的435.4亿美元高出逾26%。金融分析师预计，尼日利亚中央银行将维持官方NFEM窗口的流动性支持，使官方汇率稳定在每美元₦1,350至₦1,365区间，尽管散户需求和未履约需求持续对平行市场报价形成上行压力。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea's science ministry advised companies Wednesday to carry out emergency security checks and update their systems after vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used Java programming language. The vulnerabilities found in OpenJDK, an open-source implementation of the Java Platform, could allow malicious actors to execute malware on affected systems, the Ministry of Science and ICT said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国科学主管部门周三建议各家公司开展紧急安全检查并更新系统，此前广泛使用的 Java 编程语言被发现存在安全漏洞。韩国科学技术信息通信部表示，在 OpenJDK（Java 平台的一种开源实现）中发现的漏洞，可能使恶意行为者能够在受影响系统上执行恶意软件。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's science ministry advised companies Wednesday to carry out emergency security checks and update their systems after vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used Java programming language. The vulnerabilities found in OpenJDK, an open-source implementation of the Java Platform, could allow malicious actors to execute malware on affected systems, the Ministry of Science and ICT said. Oracle Corp., the company that maintains Java, said it is preparing to release security patches for 11 vulnerabilities, which it evaluates at a CVSS 3.1 severity score of 8.1, the second-highest in its four-tier system. Java is widely used to develop Android applications, banking systems, cloud services and other software. It is also frequently used in the government information systems, with more than 71 percent of such programs created with the Java language as of the end of 2025, according to government data. The latest discovery follows two security vulnerabilities found late last month in PHP, another widely used programming language. Java is more widely used than PHP, raising concerns about the potential impact of the newly discovered vulnerabilities
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国在发现Java平台漏洞后发布网络安全警示
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国科学部周三建议各企业开展紧急安全检查并更新系统，原因是广泛使用的Java编程语言被发现存在漏洞。韩国科学技术与信息通信部表示，在OpenJDK中发现的多项漏洞可能允许恶意行为者在受影响系统上执行恶意软件；OpenJDK是Java平台的一种开源实现。负责维护Java的Oracle Corp.表示，正准备发布安全补丁，以修复11项漏洞；该公司依据CVSS 3.1标准评估这些漏洞的严重性评分为8.1，在其四级评分体系中位居第二高。Java被广泛用于开发安卓应用、银行系统、云服务及其他软件。根据政府数据，截至2025年底，政府信息系统中超过71%的程序使用Java语言编写，Java也经常用于此类系统。此次最新发现此前一个月末PHP被发现的两个安全漏洞之后；PHP是另一种广泛使用的编程语言。Java的使用范围比PHP更广，因此新发现漏洞可能造成的影响引发担忧。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: China’s mounting electric vehicle (EV) overcapacity is driving its automakers to Korea in search of new growth, as fierce domestic competition and tougher trade barriers in Europe narrow their options for expansion. Chinese automakers are no longer treating Korea simply as a market for exporting finished vehicles.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 中国日益严重的电动汽车产能过剩，正促使其汽车制造商赴韩国寻找新的增长空间，因为激烈的国内竞争和欧洲更严格的贸易壁垒压缩了其扩张选择。中国汽车制造商不再仅仅把韩国视为出口成车的市场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: China’s mounting electric vehicle (EV) overcapacity is driving its automakers to Korea in search of new growth, as fierce domestic competition and tougher trade barriers in Europe narrow their options for expansion. Chinese automakers are no longer treating Korea simply as a market for exporting finished vehicles. BYD, Zeekr and XPeng are strengthening their local operations and hiring Korean executives with experience at established foreign automakers — in a push to turn Korea into a more permanent overseas market. The shift comes as China’s EV industry faces fierce price competition and a crowded domestic market, leaving automakers under growing pressure to find additional demand abroad. Europe, once a key destination for Chinese EVs, has also become more difficult to penetrate due to higher tariffs and tighter regulatory scrutiny. Against this backdrop, Korea’s mature automotive market and growing EV demand make it an increasingly attractive destination for Chinese automakers looking to expand overseas. BYD Korea has seen its sales surge since launching its passenger vehicle business early last year. It appointed Cho In-chul, a former head of Mini Korea's passenger vehicle business, to lead its passenger vehicle operations. The Chinese EV maker has since seen robust sales growth due to its price competitiveness. According to the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association, BYD Korea registered 21,731 new vehicles in Korea from January to October this year, ranking fourth among imported auto brands in cumulative sales this year, behind Tesla, BMW and Mercedes-Benz. Zeekr Korea has taken a similar approach, appointing Lim Hyun-ki, a former Audi Korea CEO, as its new chief. XPeng has also hired Lee Man-sik, a former Volvo executive, to lead its Korean operations. Zeekr surpassed 1,500 preorders for its midsize electric SUV, the 7X, about three months after opening preorders in June. Customer deliveries began here in October. The appointments mark a notable change from the way Chinese automakers previously approached Korea. Their presence had largely been concentrated in commercial vehicles, particularly electric buses, with local operations focused mainly on importing and selling vehicles. The latest moves, however, suggest they are now seeking to build the local infrastructure needed to absorb a larger volume of passenger vehicles and compete more directly with established brands here in an era of EVs. Hiring Korean executives could also help Chinese automakers overcome a key obstacle in expanding overseas: understanding local consumers and navigating a market dominated by Hyundai Motor, Kia and established European and Japanese brands. “Chinese automakers are under pressure to find markets that can absorb their growing production, and Korea is becoming one of the markets they cannot afford to overlook, as evidenced by the recent success of BYD Korea,” an industry source said. But Chinese brands still face challenges involving brand recognition, resale values, charging infrastructure, after-sales service and consumer concerns over data security, according to the official
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩国正成为中国电动汽车过剩产能的新出口市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 中国日益严重的电动汽车产能过剩，正推动其汽车制造商赴韩国寻找新的增长空间；国内竞争激烈，加之欧洲贸易壁垒收紧，使其扩张选择日益有限。中国汽车制造商不再仅仅把韩国视为成品汽车出口市场。比亚迪、极氪和小鹏正在加强本地业务，并聘请曾在成熟外资汽车企业任职的韩国高管，努力将韩国打造为更长期 海外市场。这一转变正值中国电动汽车行业面临激烈价格竞争和拥挤国内市场之际，汽车制造商承受着越来越大的压力，需要在海外寻找更多需求。欧洲曾是中国电动汽车的重要目的地，但如今也因更高的关税和更严格的监管审查而更难进入。在此背景下，韩国成熟的汽车市场和不断增长的电动汽车需求，使韩国成为中国汽车制造商海外扩张 increasingly 有吸引力的目的地。比亚迪韩国自去年年初启动乘用车业务以来，销量大幅增长。公司任命曾任 MINI 韩国乘用车业务负责人的赵仁哲 leading 其乘用车业务。此后，凭借价格竞争力，这家中国电动汽车制造商的销量实现强劲增长。据韩国汽车进口商与经销商协会称，比亚迪韩国今年1月至10月在韩国登记了21,731辆新车，按今年累计销量在进口汽车品牌中排名第四，仅次于特斯拉、宝马和梅赛德斯-奔驰。极氪韩国采取了类似做法，任命前奥迪韩国首席执行官林贤基为新任负责人。小鹏也聘请了前沃尔沃高管李万锡 leading 其韩国业务。极氪中型电动SUV 7X在6月开启预订约三个月后，预订量突破1,500辆，并于10月在韩国开始交付客户。这些任命标志着中国汽车制造商对韩策略发生显著变化。此前，它们在韩业务主要集中在商用车，尤其是电动巴士，本地运营也主要侧重于进口和销售汽车。然而，最新举措表明，它们如今正寻求建立本地基础设施，以承接更大规模的乘用车销量，并在电动汽车时代更直接地与韩国成熟品牌竞争。聘请韩国高管还有助于中国汽车制造商克服海外扩张中的一项关键障碍：了解当地消费者，以及在由现代汽车、起亚以及成熟欧洲和日本品牌主导的市场中开展经营。一位行业人士表示：“中国汽车制造商正面临寻找能够消化其不断增长产量的市场的压力，而从比亚迪韩国近期取得的成功来看，韩国正成为它们不容忽视的市场之一。”不过，据该官方人士称，中国品牌仍面临品牌认知度、二手车价值、充电基础设施、售后服务以及消费者对数据安全担忧等挑战

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.title: Senate Threatens Disqualification of Candidates Linked to Electoral Violence
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.summary: The upper chamber urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to enforce the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act against electoral offenders, stressing that political violence must attract appropriate sanctions.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.summary_zh: 参议院敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）依据《2026年选举法》的相关规定惩处选举违法者，并强调政治暴力必须受到适当制裁。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/s.body: •Warns governors against denying opposition access to public facilities The Senate on Tuesday warned that political candidates whose supporters instigate or participate in electoral violence risk disqualification, irrespective of party affiliation, as it moved to check escalating attacks on political leaders and supporters ahead of the 2027 general elections. The upper chamber urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to enforce the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act against electoral offenders, stressing that political violence must attract appropriate sanctions. It also called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to investigate reported attacks on the convoys of President Bola Tinubu, presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, and former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, identify their perpetrators and sponsors, and ensure their prosecution. Leading the debate, Ningi expressed concern that the growing wave of political violence posed serious threats to national security, democratic participation and the peaceful conduct of the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. He recalled the reported attack on Tinubu’s convoy shortly after the president observed Jumu’ah prayers at the Shehu Shagari Central Mosque, Garki, Abuja, on Friday, November 13, when the departing convoy was allegedly pelted with stones and other dangerous objects, damaging vehicles and injuring security operatives. He warned that failure to investigate and prosecute those responsible could embolden further attacks, deepen political divisions and undermine public confidence in the electoral process. Seconding the motion, Senator Ali Ndume (Borno North) described the attack on Tinubu’s convoy as an embarrassment to the country rather than the president. “What happened to Mr. President is not an embarrassment against the president; it is an embarrassment to Nigerians. On a Friday, in a mosque, it is wrong,” he said. Ndume warned that political violence could escalate if decisive measures were not taken, urging the police to prohibit dangerous weapons during campaigns and prosecute anyone caught carrying knives and other harmful objects. He also proposed special courts to ensure speedy prosecution of electoral offenders. However, Senator Kawu Sumaila (Kano South) argued that political candidates should equally be held accountable when their supporters are found carrying dangerous weapons. “It is across all parties. You see candidates with police escorts and thugs. Let the candidates be prosecuted if their supporters are found with dangerous weapons,” he said. Sumaila also proposed reducing the reporting period given to the relevant Senate committees from four weeks to one week. Senator Abba Moro (Benue South) maintained that existing provisions of the Electoral Act were sufficient to address electoral violence if properly enforced. “We have various sections in the Electoral Act to tackle election violence. We need to urge the security agencies to prosecute,” he said. Moro warned that unchecked violence could discourage citizens from participating in the elections. “If this is not nipped in the bud, then certainly, our election and electoral process will be in danger. It will cause voter disenfranchisement; voters will be so scared even to vote. What then will become of our democracy?” he asked. Senator Babangida Hussaini (Jigawa North-west) urged INEC to disqualify candidates linked to political violence, while Senator Binos Yaroe (Adamawa South) called on state governors to guarantee opposition parties access to public facilities for political activities, including campaign rallies. Adopting the motion, Senate President Godswill Akpabio urged the federal government to direct the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, and other security agencies to strengthen security arrangements for political leaders, candidates, supporters and political gatherings nationwide. He also called for effective early-warning and rapid-response mechanisms to prevent attacks before they occur. Akpabio specifically urged INEC to implement the relevant provisions of the 2026 Electoral Act, warning that candidates and supporters found to have instigated violence must face the consequences prescribed by law. He said the provisions should apply without discrimination, regardless of the political party involved. The Senate further urged state governors to stop denying opposition parties access to public facilities, including hotels and stadia under their control, for legitimate political activities, warning that such restrictions could undermine the level playing field required for credible elections. It mandated its Committees on National Security and Intelligence, Police Affairs, and INEC to engage relevant institutions and report to the chamber within four weeks on measures to prevent political violence and safeguard the 2027 general elections. The Senate’s intervention comes amid growing concerns over violence accompanying political campaigns across the country. The National Peace Committee, chaired by former Head of State, General Abdulsalami Abubakar, recently reported 109 breaches of the National Peace Accord across 26 states and the Federal Capital Territory between August 19 and October 27, 2026. Political violence and thuggery accounted for 33 of the reported violations. Similarly, the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project documented more than 30 attacks targeting political campaigns, candidates, supporters, convoys and gatherings since presidential and National Assembly campaigns commenced on August 19, with more than 10 deaths and several injuries recorded. •警告州长不得阻止反对派使用公共设施

参议院周二警告称，无论是哪个政党，其政治候选人的支持者若煽动或参与选举暴力，都可能失去参选资格。目前，参议院正采取行动，遏制2027年大选前针对政治人物和支持者的袭击不断升级之势。

上院敦促独立国家选举委员会（INEC）依据《2026年选举法》的相关规定惩处选举违法者，强调政治暴力必须受到适当制裁。参议院还呼吁尼日利亚警察部队及其他安全机构调查针对以下人员车队的已报告袭击：总统Bola Tinubu、尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）总统候选人Peter Obi，以及前副总统Atiku Abubakar；查明袭击实施者及其指使者，并确保将其起诉。

主导讨论的Ningi表示关切，称日益严重的政治暴力对国家安全、民主参与以及2027年1月16日总统选举和国民议会选举的和平进行构成严重威胁。他提到，据报道，11月13日星期五，总统在阿布贾加尔基Shehu Shagari Central Mosque参加主麻礼拜后不久，Tinubu的车队遭到袭击。离开时，车队据称遭人投掷石块及其他危险物品，车辆受损，安全人员受伤。

他警告称，如果不调查并起诉责任人，可能助长进一步袭击，加深政治分裂，并削弱公众对选举进程的信心。

参议员Ali Ndume（博尔诺州北区）为该动议附议，称袭击Tinubu车队令国家而非总统蒙羞。他说：“发生在总统先生身上的事情不是总统的耻辱，而是尼日利亚人的耻辱。星期五在清真寺里发生这种事是不对的。”

Ndume警告，如果未采取果断措施，政治暴力可能升级，并敦促警方在竞选活动期间禁止携带危险武器，同时起诉任何被抓到携带刀具及其他有害物品的人。他还提议设立特别法庭，以加快对选举违法者的起诉。

不过，参议员Kawu Sumaila（卡诺州南区）认为，如果发现候选人的支持者携带危险武器，候选人同样应承担责任。他说：“这种情况涉及所有政党。你们可以看到一些候选人带着警察护送和打手。如果发现候选人的支持者携带危险武器，就应起诉这些候选人。”

Sumaila还提议，将相关参议院委员会提交报告的期限从4周缩短至1周。

参议员Abba Moro（贝努埃州南区）坚持认为，只要得到适当执行，《选举法》的现有规定已足以应对选举暴力。他说：“《选举法》中有多个条款可用于处理选举暴力。我们需要敦促安全机构予以起诉。”

Moro警告说，暴力若不加遏制，会阻碍公民参与选举。他说：“如果不趁苗头及时制止，我们的选举和选举进程必然处于危险之中。这将造成选民被剥夺投票权；选民会因过度恐惧而不敢投票。那我们的民主又将何去何从？”

参议员Babangida Hussaini（吉加瓦州西北区）敦促INEC取消与政治暴力有关联的候选人的资格；参议员Binos Yaroe（阿达瓦州南区）则呼吁各州州长保障反对党能够使用公共设施开展政治活动，包括竞选集会。

参议院议长Godswill Akpabio在通过动议时，敦促联邦政府指示警察总长Olatunji Disu及其他安全机构，加强针对全国政治人物、候选人、支持者和政治聚会的安全安排。他还呼吁建立有效的早期预警和快速响应机制，防止袭击发生。

Akpabio特别敦促INEC落实《2026年选举法》的相关规定，并警告称，经查实煽动暴力的候选人和支持者必须承担法律规定的后果。他说，这些规定应一视同仁地适用于所有政党，不因涉及不同政党而有所区别。

参议院进一步敦促各州州长停止阻止反对党使用由州政府掌控的公共设施，包括酒店和体育场，以开展正当政治活动。参议院警告称，此类限制可能破坏可信选举所需的公平竞争环境。

参议院责令其国家安全与情报委员会、警务委员会以及INEC委员会与相关机构接洽，并在4周内向议院报告防止政治暴力及保障2027年大选安全的措施。

参议院此次干预之际，全国围绕政治竞选发生的暴力事件日益引发关注。由前国家元首General Abdulsalami Abubakar担任主席的国家和平委员会最近报告称，2026年8月19日至10月27日期间，26个州及联邦首都辖区共发生了109起违反《国家和平协议》的行为。政治暴力和暴徒活动占所报告违规行为的33起。

同样，武装冲突地点与事件数据（ACLED）项目记录，自8月19日总统和国民议会竞选活动启动以来，针对政治竞选、候选人、支持者、车队和聚会的袭击超过30起，并造成10多人死亡及多人受伤。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.title: Tinubu Moves to Decriminalise Attempted Suicide, Seeks Senate’s Approval
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.summary: • Akpabio welcomes proposal, says mentally challenged survivors need support, not punishment President Bola Tinubu has asked the Senate to remove criminal penalties for attempted suicide and provide support for survivors, submitting a proposed amendment to the National Mental Health Act 2021 for legislative consideration.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.summary_zh: • Akpabio 对提案表示欢迎，称心智障碍幸存者需要的是支持，而不是惩罚。总统 Bola Tinubu 已请求参议院取消对企图自杀行为的刑事处罚，并为幸存者提供支持，同时提交了《2021 年国家心理健康法》修正案，供立法审议。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.body: • Akpabio welcomes proposal, says mentally challenged survivors need support, not punishment President Bola Tinubu has asked the Senate to remove criminal penalties for attempted suicide and provide support for survivors, submitting a proposed amendment to the National Mental Health Act 2021 for legislative consideration. The President’s proposal marks a significant intervention in the debate over whether Nigerians who survive suicide attempts should face criminal prosecution or receive medical and psychological assistance. The National Mental Health Amendment Bill 2026 was conveyed to the Senate in a presidential letter read by Senate President Godswill Akpabio during plenary on Tuesday. In the letter, Tinubu invoked Section 58(2) of the 1999 Constitution, as amended, to formally transmit the proposed legislation to the National Assembly, expressing hope that lawmakers would give it expeditious consideration. “Pursuant to Section 58, subsection 2 of the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, as amended, I forward herewith the National Mental Health Amendment Bill 2026 for the kind consideration of the Nigerian Senate,” the President stated. The proposed legislation seeks to amend the existing National Mental Health Act by removing criminal sanctions for attempted suicide and establishing a more supportive framework for people who survive suicide attempts. The President’s intervention comes against the backdrop of growing legislative debate over the continued criminalisation of attempted suicide under Nigeria’s existing criminal laws, despite provisions recognising mental health emergencies. It also follows the Senate’s passage of a separate bill seeking to decriminalise attempted suicide for second reading, sponsored by Senator Asuquo Ekpenyong, representing Cross River South. Presenting the bill, Ekpenyong had drawn attention to what he described as an inconsistency in Nigeria’s legal framework. He had argued that while the National Mental Health Act recognises attempted suicide as a psychiatric emergency requiring immediate intervention, the Criminal Code and Penal Code continue to treat it as a criminal offence. He had challenged lawmakers to reconsider the appropriate response of the state to individuals who survive suicide attempts, stressing the need to choose between prosecution and protection. The debate had attracted considerable attention following Akpabio’s earlier opposition to decriminalising attempted suicide. During deliberations on the separate bill, the Senate President had insisted that attempted suicide should remain a criminal offence, arguing that survivors should face imprisonment. “As far as we are concerned, we are saying that suicide is a crime for now. Therefore, if you attempt it, you better succeed. If you don’t succeed, we will send you to prison,” Akpabio had declared. However, reacting to Tinubu’s proposed amendment on Tuesday, the Senate President welcomed the initiative, explaining that his earlier position distinguished between individuals who were mentally sound and those experiencing mental health challenges. Akpabio maintained that people suffering from mental health conditions should not be treated in the same manner as those considered mentally capable of understanding their actions. “I did not include people who are mentally disturbed because they don’t have a mental balance to know what they are doing,” he said. He added that criminalising the actions of people experiencing mental health challenges would amount to insensitivity rather than addressing the circumstances responsible for their actions. His remarks appeared to underscore the importance of distinguishing between criminal responsibility and mental health emergencies in determining the appropriate treatment of suicide attempt survivors. The Senate subsequently referred the National Mental Health Amendment Bill 2026 to its Committee on Rules and Business for further legislative action. The proposed amendment is expected to provide an opportunity for lawmakers to harmonise the country’s mental health framework with existing criminal laws and reconsider the treatment of people who survive suicide attempts. Meanwhile, the Senate on Tuesday confirmed six nominees for appointment as executive directors of the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority (NMDPRA). The confirmation followed the consideration of a report by the joint committees on Petroleum Downstream and Gas, presented by Senator Kawu Sumaila, representing Kano South. The nominees were confirmed through a voice vote after the Senate considered the committee’s report at the Committee of the Whole, presided over by Akpabio. Those confirmed are Abiodun A. Adeniji, Executive Director, Finance and Accounts; Ogbugo Kalu Ukoh, Executive Director, Distribution Systems, Storage and Retailing Infrastructure; and Mustapha Lamorde, Executive Director, Health, Safety, Environment and Community. Others are Mobolaji Tajudeen Musa, Executive Director, Hydrocarbon Processing Plants, Installation and Partnership and Transportation Infrastructure; Ogechukwu Olufunmilola Modie, Executive Director, Economic Regulation and Strategic Planning; and Said Abutalib, Executive Director, Corporate Services and Administration. Presenting the report, Sumaila disclosed that the nominees appeared before the joint committees on November 12, 2026, for screening, where they responded to questions on the petroleum industry and measures to reposition the sector for improved economic performance. He said the nominees were also asked to explain their understanding of the challenges confronting the midstream and downstream petroleum sectors and how the regulatory authority could be effectively managed. According to him, the committees were satisfied with their performances, describing their responses as intelligent and convincing and demonstrating a sound understanding of the complexities, challenges and opportunities in the petroleum industry. The report further stated that the nominees possessed the requisite technical knowledge, professional experience and expertise to discharge their responsibilities effectively. The committees also confirmed that the appointments complied with Sections 41(2) and 41(3) of the Petroleum Industry Act 2021, adding that no petition was received against any of the nominees. It recommended their confirmation, which the Senate subsequently approved. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.title_zh: Tinubu推动将自杀未遂非刑罪化，并寻求参议院批准
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/18/t.body_zh: 阿克帕比奥欢迎相关提案，称有精神障碍的自杀未遂幸存者需要支持而非惩罚。总统博拉· Tinubu 已请求参议院取消自杀未遂行为的刑事处罚，并为幸存者提供支持，同时提交了对《国家心理健康法（2021年）》的修正案草案，供立法审议。总统的提案介入了一场重要讨论：尼日利亚自杀未遂幸存者究竟应受到刑事起诉，还是应获得医疗和心理援助。参议院议长Godswill Akpabio周二在全体会议上宣读总统信函，将《国家心理健康修正案（2026年）》提交参议院。信函中，Tinubu援引经修订的《1999年宪法》第58条第2款，正式将拟议立法提交国民议会，并希望议员们尽快审议。总统表示：“根据经修订的《尼日利亚联邦共和国1999年宪法》第58条第2款，谨此将《国家心理健康修正案（2026年）》提交尼日利亚参议院审议。”这项拟议立法旨在修改现行《国家心理健康法》，取消对自杀未遂行为的刑事制裁，并为自杀未遂幸存者建立更具支持性的框架。总统的介入之际，尼日利亚立法部门正日益激烈地讨论现行刑法是否应继续将自杀未遂行为入罪，尽管相关法律已承认心理健康紧急情况。此前，参议院已通过一项寻求将自杀未遂行为非刑事化的独立法案，并进入二读阶段；该法案由代表克罗斯里河南区的参议员Asuquo Ekpenyong提出。Ekpenyong在介绍法案时，提请注意他所称的尼日利亚法律框架存在的不一致。他指出，《国家心理健康法》将自杀未遂视为需要立即干预的精神健康紧急情况，而《刑法》和《刑罚法》仍将其视为犯罪行为。他要求议员重新考虑国家应如何对待自杀未遂幸存者，强调必须在起诉与保护之间作出选择。此前Akpabio反对将自杀未遂行为非刑事化，因此相关讨论引起了广泛关注。在审议这项独立法案期间，参议院议长坚持认为自杀未遂仍应构成犯罪，并主张幸存者应面临监禁。Akpabio曾宣称：“就我们目前而言，我们 saying 自杀是犯罪。因此，如果你试图自杀，最好成功。如果没成功，我们就会把你送进监狱。”然而，周二针对Tinubu提出的修正案，参议院议长对这一举措表示欢迎，并解释称，他此前的立场区分了心智健全者与面临心理健康挑战者。Akpabio坚持认为，患有心理健康问题的人不应与被视为有能力理解自身行为的人受到同等对待。他说：“我没有把精神失常的人包括在内，因为他们没有心理平衡来知道自己在做什么。”他补充说，将面临心理健康挑战者的行为刑事化，不仅无助于解决导致其行为的实际情况，反而显得缺乏体谅。他的言论似乎强调，在确定如何适当对待自杀未遂幸存者时，必须区分刑事责任与心理健康紧急情况。随后，参议院将《国家心理健康修正案（2026年）》移交规则与商业委员会采取进一步立法行动。预计这项修正案将为议员提供机会，使该国心理健康框架与现行刑法相协调，并重新审视对自杀未遂幸存者的处理。与此同时，参议院周二确认了六名获委任为尼日利亚中下游石油监管管理局（NMDPRA）执行董事的人选。确认程序在审议由代表卡诺南区的参议员Kawu Sumaila提交的下游石油与天然气联合委员会报告后进行。参议院在Akpabio主持的全体委员会审议委员会报告后，以记名表决方式确认了相关人选。获确认者包括：Abiodun A. Adeniji，财务与账户执行董事；Ogbugo Kalu Ukoh，配送系统、储存与零售基础设施执行董事；Mustapha Lamorde，健康、安全、环境与社区执行董事。其他获确认者包括：Mobolaji Tajudeen Musa，碳氢化合物加工厂、安装与合作及运输基础设施执行董事；Ogechukwu Olufunmilola Modie，经济监管与战略规划执行董事；以及Said Abutalib，企业服务与行政管理执行董事。Sumaila提交报告时透露，获提名人选于2026年11月12日出席下游石油与天然气联合委员会接受审查，并回答了有关石油行业以及如何重塑该行业以改善经济表现的问题。他说，委员会还要求获提名人选说明其对中下游石油行业所面临挑战的理解，以及如何有效管理该监管机构。据他介绍，委员会对他们的表现表示满意，称其回答机智且有说服力，并展现出对石油行业复杂性、挑战与机遇的扎实理解。报告进一步指出，获提名人选具备有效履行职责所需的技术知识、专业经验和专门能力。委员会还确认，这些任命符合《2021年石油行业法》第41条第2款和第41条第3款，并表示未收到针对任何获提名人选的请愿。报告建议确认这些任命，参议院随后予以批准。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地及世界各地设有办公室。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，覆盖所有平台，为政界、商业界、专业人士、外交界精英和更广泛的中产阶层服务，同时充当有志者与千禧一代探索新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等广泛议题，呈现人与社会的交汇点。你可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的“联系我们”页面。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111808.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金智贤＝美国、中国和俄罗斯三国首脑会谈在一天后到来之际，18日，国内舆论的关注点集中在这三位审视全球的人士是否会在谈话中提及朝鲜核问题和朝鲜半岛局势。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于19日在山东曲阜举行中美俄首脑会谈。由于三国及各位领导人各自的利益和当前议题不尽相同，外界首先关注的是，他们将带着哪些共同议程坐到谈判桌前。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111808.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 기자 = 초유의 미국·중국·러시아 정상 간 담판이 하루 앞으로 다가온 18일, 국내의 이목은 지구 전체를 조망하는 이들 세 인물이 북핵과 한반도까지 입에 올릴지에 집중되고 있다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령, 시진핑 중국 국가주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령은 오는 19일 중국 선전 기린산장에서 미중러 정상회담을 개최할 예정이다. 세 나라와 각 정상의 이해관계 및 현안이 판이한 만큼 이들이 어떤 합의된 의제를 가지고 테이블에 앉을 수 있을지부터 관심이 쏠린다. 당면한 국제사회의 현안으로는 이란 전쟁, 우크라이나 전쟁, 핵 군축 및 군비통제, 인공지능(AI)이 꼽히는데, 사안별로 각국의 입장이 갈린다. 이란 전쟁에서 미국은 대(對)이란 압박을 강화하고 이란에 대한 암묵적인 지원을 끊어야 한다는 입장이고, 우크라이나의 경우 러시아가 유리한 협상 고지 선점에 힘을 쏟고 있다. 핵 군축을 두고는 냉전기 형성된 미·러 간 체제에 중국을 편입시키는 것이 미국의 관심사지만, 핵전력 강화를 꾀하는 중국은 피하고 싶은 주제다. 그나마 AI 통제 필요성에는 각국이 원론적으로 동의할 수 있겠으나 이 또한 주도적 지위를 차지하기 위한 미중 경쟁이 치열한 분야다. 미중러 회담 자체를 두고도 삼국의 입장이 미묘하게 다르다. 우크라이나 침공으로 땅에 떨어진 국제 이미지를 회복하려는 러시아가 적극적, 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 개최국으로서 다자외교 영향력 증대를 노리는 중국은 소극적이었다. 이처럼 판이한 입장차를 감안할 때 이번 회담에서 가시적인 결과물이 나오기는 쉽지 않고, 상대적으로 구체적인 사안에 속하는 북핵 문제가 심도 있게 논의될 가능성은 크지 않다는 게 외교가의 중론이다. 그렇기는 하나 북한과 북핵을 자국 입장에서 일종의 레버리지로 활용하려는 각 정상의 이해관계 득실 계산이 중첩되다 보면 논의가 어떤 방향으로 흘러갈지 종잡기 어렵다는 우려 섞인 관측 또한 제기된다. 이번 회담에 적극적으로 임하는 러시아는 미중러 회담에 앞서서 열릴 중러 정상회담에서 한반도 정세가 의제에 포함될 것이라고 예고한 바 있다. 크렘린궁은 또 미중러 회담의 공동성명 문안을 놓고 "집중적인 협의가 진행 중"이라고 밝혔는데, 이를 종합하면 중러의 관점이 투영된 한반도 관련 언급이 미중러 회담에서 거론될 가능성을 배제하기 어렵다는 관측이 나온다. 러시아와 중국은 그간 한미·한미일 훈련이 북한의 안보 불안을 자극하고 한반도 평화와 안정을 저해한다는, 북한의 주장에 동조하는 견해를 내비친 적이 있다. 러시아 출신의 북한·한반도 전문가인 안드레이 란코프 국민대 교수도 "북한과 관련해 타협적 해결책에 대한 논의가 있을 수 있다"고 전망했다. 한국 정부로서는 북한 내지 한반도 비핵화에 대한 의지가 훼손·약화하는 상황이 최악의 시나리오다. 전문가들은 북한의 미국 타격용 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM)만 제한하고 단거리 핵은 용인해 결국 북한이 지역적 수준의 핵보유국으로 암묵적 인정을 받는 상황이 여기에 포함된다고 자주 거론한다. 청와대가 지난 17일 "한반도 문제 등 우리 국익과 직결되는 사안에 대해서는 우리 입장과 이해관계가 충분히 반영돼야 한다"는 입장을 내놓은 것은 그런 상황을 막기 위한 메시지로 읽힌다. 지난 13일 베이징에서 열린 한중 외교장관회담에서도 조현 외교부 장관은 중국 측에 '미중러 회담에서 한반도 문제에 대한 우리 국익이 훼손될 수는 없다'는 입장을 강조해서 전달한 바 있다. 그러나 최근 들어 미중러의 움직임뿐 아니라 북한의 전략적 계산이 미중러 회담에서의 한반도 논의 여부와 방향에 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 분석이 힘을 얻는 상황이 이어지는 점은 외교 당국이 예의주시하는 요소다. 트럼프 대통령은 APEC과 아세안 정상회의 참석차 아시아 순방을 떠나기 전 "김정은과 만날 수도 있다"며 "중국에서"라고 말했고, 필리핀에 도착해서는 김 위원장도 중국에 오느냐는 질문에 "그도 그렇게 하고 싶어 한다"고 말했다. 이번 중국 방문을 계기로 김 위원장과 만나고 싶다는 의지를 강력하게 거듭 표출한 것으로, 북미 대화 성사 여부의 선택권을 북한에 넘긴 것으로 풀이됐다. 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관이 북한은 이란과 달리 팽창주의를 추구하지 않는다고 언급한 것은 대북 유화 메시지로 풀이된다. 루비오 장관은 지난 13일 워싱턴DC에서 열린 한 행사 참석, 이란의 핵무기 보유 저지 필요성을 강조하다가 김 위원장을 거론하면서 "그는 정권을 유지하며 살아남기를 원할 뿐"이라며 팽창주의자는 아니라고 평가했다. 미국의 끈질긴 러브콜 끝에 북한이 결단해 북미대화가 이뤄지는 모습이 연출된다면 이는 북한 입장에서 대화를 통해 얻을 이익에 대한 계산이 도출됐다는 의미가 되며, 그에 따라 북한이 원해 온 핵보유국 인정에 다가서는 첫걸음이 될 수도 있다는 우려가 제기된다. 크렘린궁은 김 위원장과 푸틴 대통령의 APEC 계기 북러 정상회담 가능성에 대해 "김 위원장이 APEC에 참석한다면 물론이다"라는 답을 내놨다. 미 국가정보국 북한 담당 부조정관 출신의 시드니 사일러 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 선임 고문은 이를 두고 북러 간 모종의 협의 가능성을 제기했다. 회담에 대한 양측의 확신이 없었더라면 크렘린궁이 그런 말을 하지는 않았을 것이라는 이유에서다. 김 위원장이 일단 중국행을 선택한다면 푸틴 대통령만 만나고 돌아갈 가능성은 희박한 만큼, 트럼프 대통령과 전격적으로 회동할 가능성을 완전히 배제하기는 어렵다는 평가가 나온다. 김재천 서강대 국제대학원 교수는 "푸틴 대통령 입장에서는 김정은과 만나 중요한 얘기를 하겠다기보다는 그를 불러서 트럼프 대통령과 만나게 해주는 것"을 구상하고 있을 수 있다고 봤다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/18 11:40 송고 2026년11월18일 11시40분 송고 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령(왼쪽부터), 시진핑 중국 국가주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령 [AP=연합뉴스 자료사진. 재판매 및 DB 금지] (선전=연합뉴스) 차병섭 특파원 = 16일(현지시간) 중국 광둥성 선전의 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 행사장 주변에서 시민들이 사진을 찍고 있다. 2026.11.16 bscha@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111808.title_zh: 美中俄首尔会谈临近……朝鲜核问题与半岛局势存在讨论空间
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111808.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金志贤＝史无前例的美国、中国、俄罗斯三国领导人对话即将在一天后到来，18日，国内舆论的目光聚焦于这三位纵观全球的领导人会否在谈话中提及朝鲜核问题和朝鲜半岛局势。唐纳德·特朗普总统、习近平主席和弗拉基米尔·普京总统定于19日在中国广东举行美中俄领导人会晤。由于三国及其领导人各自的利益关系和当前议题错综复杂，各界首先关注他们能带着哪些共同议程坐到谈判桌前。就当前国际社会热点而言，伊朗战争、乌克兰战争、核军备削减及军备控制、人工智能（AI）等问题备受瞩目，各国在这些问题上的立场存在分歧。在伊朗战争问题上，美国主张加大对伊朗的施压力度，并切断对伊朗的暗中支持；在乌克兰问题上，俄罗斯则力图抢在有利时机提出谈判主张。在核军备削减问题上，美国关注将冷战时期形成的美俄体系纳入中国，但中国不愿讨论这一议题，因为这有助于其增强核力量。各国或许原则上都能同意有必要对AI进行管控，但美中竞争在这一领域同样十分激烈，争夺主导地位。三国对美中俄会晤本身的立场也微妙各异。俄罗斯积极谋求挽回因入侵乌克兰而受损的国际形象；中国则相对消极，其立场是作为亚太经合组织（APEC）东道主提高多边外交影响力。鉴于各方立场分歧显著，外交人士普遍认为，本次会晤很难取得实质性成果，而朝鲜核问题等相对具体的议题也不太可能得到深入讨论。不过，也有观察人士指出并担忧，如果三位领导人盘算利用朝鲜及朝鲜核问题作为本国立场的筹码，相互叠加的利益考量将使讨论走向难以预测。俄罗斯积极参加此次会晤，此前已预告，在美中俄会晤前举行的中俄领导人会晤中，朝鲜半岛局势将被纳入议程。克里姆林宫还就美中俄会晤联合声明文本表示，“密集磋商正在进行中”。综合来看，中俄立场投射出的涉朝表述在美中俄会晤中被提及的可能性难以排除。此前，俄罗斯和中国曾表达过与朝鲜一致的看法，即韩美及韩美日联合军演刺激朝鲜security忧虑，损害朝鲜半岛和平与稳定。俄罗斯籍朝鲜及朝鲜半岛专家、国民大学安德烈·兰科夫教授也展望称，“有关朝鲜问题，可能讨论妥协性解决方案。”对韩国政府而言，朝鲜或朝鲜半岛无核化意愿遭到破坏或削弱的局面是最坏情景。专家们经常提及一种可能局面，即仅限制朝鲜用于攻击美国的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM），却容许其保留短程核武器，最终默认朝鲜成为地区级核国家。韩国总统府17日表明立场称，“对于朝鲜半岛问题等直接关系我国利益的议题，我们的立场和利益应得到充分反映。”此举可被视为旨在防止上述局面的信息。13日在北京举行的韩中外交部长会谈中，韩国外交部长赵显也向中方强调并转达了“我们的利益不能因美中俄会晤讨论朝鲜半岛问题而受损”的立场。然而，最近一段时期，不仅美中俄的动向，朝鲜的战略盘算也可能影响美中俄会晤是否讨论朝鲜半岛问题以及讨论方向，相关分析日益受到重视，这是外交当局密切关注的因素。特朗普总统在赴亚洲出席APEC和东盟领导人会议并展开亚洲之行前表示，“也许会见到金正恩”，并强调“在中国”。抵达菲律宾后，当被问及金主席是否也会前往中国时，他表示，“他也想这么做”。这再次有力表达了金主席希望借此次访华之机会晤的意愿，被解读为将能否促成美朝对话的选择权交给朝鲜。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥提及朝鲜与伊朗不同，不寻求扩张主义，这被解读为向朝鲜释放缓和信息。鲁比奥13日在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区出席一场活动时，强调有必要阻止伊朗拥有核武器，随后在谈到金主席时评价称，“他只想在维持政权的同时活下去”，并称其并非扩张主义者。若在美国反复游说之下，最终呈现出朝鲜作出决断、促成美朝对话的场面，这意味着朝鲜已经权衡出通过对话可获得的利益；随之而来的担忧是，这可能成为朝鲜朝着其一直寻求的核国家承认迈出的第一步。克里姆林宫就以APEC为契机举行朝俄领导人会晤的可能性回应称，“如果金主席出席APEC，那当然可以”。曾任美国国家情报局朝鲜负责副局长的战略与国际问题研究中心（CSIS）高级顾问西德尼·塞勒借此提出朝俄之间存在某种协商的可能性。理由是，如果双方对会晤没有信心，克里姆林宫不会说出这样的话。有评估认为，既然金主席选择前往中国，他见完普京总统便返回的可能性极低，因此难以完全排除其与特朗普总统迅速会面的可能。成均馆大学国际研究生院教授 김재천表示，“从普京总统的立场来看，与其说是要见金正恩并商谈重要事项，不如说可能是把他请来与特朗普总统会面”。本报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系。版权所有(c) https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Senate on Tuesday approved President Bola Tinubu’s request to reimburse the Yobe State Government ₦100.5 billion for the construction of the Muhammadu Buhari International Cargo Airport in Damaturu, the state capital. The decision was taken after considering a report of the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts, presented during the plenary by its Chairman, Aliyu Wamakko (APC, Sokoto North). The reimbursement will be made through promissory notes. A promissory note is a written and signed commitment to pay a specified sum of money to a named person or the bearer, either on a specified date or on demand. President Tinubu requested the reimbursement in October after the federal government took control of the airport ownership. Mr Wamakko said committee members met on 27 October to review documents related to the president’s request. He said the committee established that the Federal Ministry of Aviation had confirmed the airport’s construction through a technical audit, which indicated the project was fully completed and complied with international standards. The senator also said the contract was awarded in compliance with Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP) requirements. He added that the airport was fully constructed and operational, with flights already taking off, making it ready for federal takeover. After the presentation, Senate President Godswill Akpabio put the request to a voice vote, and most lawmakers voted in favour

https://www.myjoyonline.com/black-challe.body: Ghana’s Black Challenge have stepped up preparations for their Round of 16 clash against the USA at the Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico, scheduled for Wednesday, November 18. The Black Challenge booked their place in the knockout stage after thrashing Iraq 6-0 in their final Group D match to finish second with four points. Head coach Richard Obeng led the team through a light training session on Tuesday, which included shooting drills, as the players fine-tuned their preparations for Wednesday’s crucial encounter. Fourteen of the 15 players took part in the session, with Richard Ekwam the only absentee after picking up an injury during Ghana’s emphatic victory over Iraq. The Black Challenge will now turn their attention to the USA, knowing that victory will secure a place in the quarter-finals and keep their hopes of winning the tournament alive

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: COP31主席国提议，到2035年将发展中国家的年度气候适应资金至少提高至1200亿美元，同时呼吁加快行动，逐步淘汰化石燃料。根据第73段，主席国提议，到2035年将适应资金增至三倍的行动规模应达到每年至少1200亿美元。然而，2024年发达国家向发展中国家提供的国际公共适应资金为282亿美元至317亿美元。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The COP31 Presidency has proposed increasing annual climate adaptation finance for developing countries to at least $120 billion by 2035, while calling for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels. The proposals are contained in an 18-page draft cover decision released on 16 November as negotiations entered their second week at the ongoing United Nations climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye. The document outlines proposed actions on climate finance, energy transition, health, workers’ rights, oceans and gender equality, among other issues. However, it also highlights gaps in how it addresses agriculture and food systems, which are important to climate adaptation and mitigation. The draft remains an unedited negotiating document and does not represent an agreement among participating countries. Its provisions are subject to further negotiations before the conference concludes on 20 November. Under paragraph 73, the Presidency proposes that efforts to triple adaptation finance by 2035 should reach at least $120 billion annually. It also calls on developed countries to increase their collective financial support to developing countries and provide a roadmap showing how the target will be achieved. The proposal comes amid a significant shortfall in funding available to countries already experiencing the effects of climate change. The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), in its 2026 Adaptation Gap Report released earlier this month, estimated that developing countries would require approximately $305 billion annually by 2035 to meet their adaptation needs. However, international public adaptation finance from developed to developing countries stood at between $28.2 billion and $31.7 billion in 2024. UNEP warned that even if the existing international ambition to triple adaptation finance by 2035 is achieved, it would cover only 20 to 29 per cent of estimated needs. The COP31 proposal also acknowledges the difficulties developing countries face in accessing climate finance, including high borrowing costs, limited fiscal space, unsustainable debt and complicated funding procedures. It consequently encourages greater provision of public, grant-based and highly concessional finance, rather than loans that could further increase the debt burden of vulnerable countries. Another proposed measure is establishing the Antalya-to-Addis Ababa Roadmap on Adaptation and Resilience Finance. The initiative would identify predictable sources of public funding for adaptation and loss and damage, with its findings expected to be presented for consideration at COP32 in 2027. The draft also highlights the disparity between financial requests from countries experiencing climate-related losses and the resources available through the Fund for responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD). Paragraph 84 states that requests submitted under the fund’s Barbados Implementation Modality total about $2.8 billion, compared with available allocations of about $342 million. It further notes that only 50 per cent of the $822 million pledged to the fund has reportedly been converted into contributions. The Presidency is proposing that developed countries announce ambitious financial pledges to the loss and damage fund and other climate funds by the end of 2027. The figures highlight the difference between financial commitments announced by governments and the resources actually made available to affected countries and communities. Beyond climate finance, the document includes proposals accelerating the transition away from fossil fuels, an issue that remains contentious in international climate negotiations. Paragraph 65 reaffirms the commitment made at COP28 in Dubai to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly and equitable manner. Paragraph 66 goes further, calling for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels, including an immediate transition away from their use in energy systems. The proposed language is significant because it moves beyond the broader commitment to transition away from fossil fuels toward more explicit action to phase them out. The draft also proposes increasing electricity’s share of total final energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, alongside efforts to triple global renewable energy capacity and double the annual rate of energy efficiency improvements by 2030. On methane emissions, it encourages improved measurement and reporting, rapid d detection and repair, and the elimination of routine gas flaring and venting. However, the document clarifies that these are global efforts to which countries would contribute according to their national circumstances. They do not establish specific targets or obligations for individual countries. The Presidency also addresses the social and economic implications of moving towards low-emission economies. Paragraphs 111 and 112 call for just transition pathways that would enable developing countries to participate in technology value chains, strengthen industrial capacity and create decent employment. The draft recognises workers’ rights, decent work and quality jobs as central to effective climate action. It also stresses the need to protect workers and their families from the social and economic consequences of technological and industrial changes. However, translating these provisions into practical protections will require more than recognising workers’ rights in a climate agreement. It will also depend on workers’ and trade unions’ participation in decisions affecting their livelihoods, as well as adequate funding for skills development and economic diversification. Despite their importance to climate adaptation, mitigation and livelihoods, agriculture and food systems receive limited attention in the proposed decision. The document contains no dedicated provisions setting out measures for food systems adaptation or mitigation, including specific action on agricultural methane emissions. Although it references food and nutrition insecurity in its discussion of climate-related health impacts, as well as the contribution of forests to food security, these references do not amount to a comprehensive approach to climate-resilient food production and supply systems. This omission is particularly relevant to developing countries, where climate-related disruptions to rainfall, rising temperatures, flooding, d drought threaten agricultural production, food availability, d rural livelihoods. For countries such as Nigeria, where agriculture remains an important source of employment and livelihoods, stronger attention to climate-resilient agriculture and food systems is essential to addressing the wider economic and social consequences of climate change. The draft recognises that climate change is already affecting physical and mental health, particularly in vulnerable communities. It identifies heat stress, malaria, dengue, cholera, maternal health risks, food and nutrition insecurity, and damage to health facilities during extreme weather events among the impacts requiring attention. It consequently calls for countries to integrate health considerations into their national adaptation and climate plans, while strengthening climate information and early warning systems to protect public health. For mountain regions, paragraph 31 proposes a dedicated work programme on climate change, a standing agenda item under the Conference of the Parties and a high-level dialogue at COP32. The document also encourages countries to incorporate sustainable ocean-based measures into their national climate commitments and adaptation plans, supported by predictable finance, technology and capacity-building. On inclusion, it calls for meaningful participation by Indigenous Peoples, women, children, young people, persons with disabilities and local communities in climate action and decision-making. The draft also addresses developing countries’ concerns about unilateral climate-related trade measures. Paragraph 115 expresses concern that such measures could transfer the economic burden of climate action to developing countries, with consequences for market access, competitiveness, investment and industrialisation. It proposes discussions on common guiding principles for climate-related trade measures, including transparency, non-discrimination and interoperability. Paragraph 119 further calls on developed countries to phase out unilateral climate-related trade-restrictive measures and other measures that negatively affect international climate cooperation by the end of 2027. The proposals reflect wider concerns among developing countries that climate policies adopted by wealthier economies should not create additional economic barriers for countries with fewer resources to transition to low-emission industries. The proposals come as countries enter the final stretch of COP31, with major disagreements still to be resolved. COP31 President of Negotiations Chris Bowen said more than 100 agenda items and around 60 significant mandates remained under consideration, covering issues including climate finance, adaptation, mitigation and just transition. COP31 President Murat Kurum said the coming week would be crucial to translating the progress made during the conference into concrete decisions. “We will intensify our ministerial-level consultations and work hard to translate the issues under consideration by countries into common decisions,” Mr Kurum said. Mr Bowen also acknowledged that some provisions in the draft would not receive support from all participating countries, describing the document as an early basis for discussions ahead of further negotiations. As the conference approaches its scheduled conclusion on 20 November, countries will have to resolve differences over climate finance, the future of fossil fuels and support for vulnerable nations
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: COP31将提议设定1200亿美元适应资金目标和淘汰化石燃料
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: COP31主席国提议，到2035年将发展中国家的年度气候适应资金至少增加至1200亿美元，同时呼吁加快行动，逐步淘汰化石燃料。相关提议载于11月16日发布的一份18页决定草案封面文件中；当时，正在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候大会谈判进入第二周。该文件概述了在气候资金、能源转型、健康、工人权利、海洋和性别平等等议题上的拟议行动。不过，文件也指出，其对农业和粮食系统的处理存在不足，而农业和粮食系统对气候适应与减缓十分重要。草案仍是一份未经编辑的谈判文件，并不代表参与国之间已经达成协议。在大会于11月20日闭幕前，相关条款仍需进一步谈判。根据第73段，主席国提议，将到2035年把适应资金增至三倍的努力落实为每年至少1200亿美元。主席国还呼吁发达国家增加对发展中国家的集体资金支持，并提供一份路线图，说明如何实现这一目标。该提议出台之际，已经受到气候变化影响的国家获得的资金仍存在严重缺口。联合国环境规划署在本月早些时候发布的《2026年适应差距报告》中估计，到2035年，发展中国家每年需要约3050亿美元才能满足适应需求。然而，2024年发达国家向发展中国家提供的国际公共适应资金仅为282亿至317亿美元。联合国环境规划署警告称，即使现有的到2035年将适应资金增至三倍的国际雄心得以实现，也只能满足估算需求的20%至29%。COP31的提议还承认，发展中国家在获取气候资金时面临诸多困难，包括借款成本高、财政空间有限、债务不可持续以及资金拨付程序复杂。因此，该提议鼓励增加公共资金、赠款和优惠程度极高的资金，而不是提供可能进一步加重脆弱国家债务负担的贷款。另一项拟议措施是建立“安塔利亚至亚的斯亚贝巴适应与韧性融资路线图”。该倡议将确定适应以及损失与损害领域的可预测公共资金来源，其研究结果预计将提交2027年COP32审议。草案还指出，正在遭受气候相关损失的国家提出的资金申请，与损失与损害应对基金（FRLD）能够提供的资源之间存在差距。第84段称，根据该基金的《巴巴多斯实施模式》提交的申请总额约为28亿美元，而可用拨款约为3.42亿美元。该段进一步指出，据报道，认捐给该基金的8.22亿美元中，只有50%已转化为实际缴款。主席国提议，发达国家应在2027年底前宣布面向损失与损害基金及其他气候基金的雄心勃勃的资金承诺。这些数字凸显了各国政府宣布的资金承诺与实际提供给受影响国家和社区的资源之间的差距。除气候资金外，文件还提出了加快摆脱化石燃料的提议，而这一议题在国际气候谈判中仍存在争议。第65段重申了COP28在迪拜作出的承诺，即以公正、有序和公平的方式推动能源系统摆脱化石燃料。第66段更进一步，呼吁加快行动淘汰化石燃料，包括立即停止在能源系统中使用化石燃料。拟议措辞意义重大，因为它不再仅仅停留于较为宽泛的摆脱化石燃料承诺，而是转向采取更加明确的淘汰行动。草案还提议，到2035年将电力在终端能源消费总量中的占比提高至35%，同时努力到2030年将全球可再生能源装机容量增至三倍，并将能源效率改善速度提高至每年两倍。在甲烷排放方面，草案鼓励改进测量和报告工作，迅速发现和修复泄漏，并停止常规天然气燃烧和放空。不过，文件明确说明，这些都是各国将根据自身国情参与落实的全球行动，不对单个国家设定具体目标或义务。主席国还处理了向低排放经济转型所带来的社会和经济影响。第111和112段呼吁制定公正转型路径，使发展中国家能够参与技术价值链、强化工业能力并创造体面就业。草案将工人权利、体面劳动和高质量就业视为有效气候行动的核心，并强调需要保护工人及其家庭免受技术和产业变化带来的社会与经济后果。然而，要将这些条款转化为切实保护，仅在气候协定中承认工人权利是不够的。相关保护还取决于工人和工会能否参与影响其生计的决策，以及是否有充足资金用于技能发展和经济多元化。尽管农业和粮食系统对气候适应、减缓及生计至关重要，草案决定却仅对其给予有限关注。文件没有专门条款列出粮食系统适应或减缓措施，也没有就农业甲烷排放提出具体行动。尽管文件在讨论气候相关健康影响时提及粮食和营养不安全，并在讨论森林对粮食安全的贡献时作出相关表述，但这些提及不足以构成一套完整的、具有气候韧性的粮食生产和供应体系方案。这一缺失对发展中国家尤其重要，因为在这些国家，与气候有关的降雨变化、气温上升、洪涝和干旱正威胁农业生产、食物供应和农村生计。对尼日利亚等农业仍是重要就业和生计来源的国家而言，更重视具有气候韧性的农业和粮食系统，对于应对气候变化带来的广泛经济和社会后果至关重要。草案承认，气候变化已经对身心健康产生影响，脆弱社区尤其如此。文件列出了需要关注的影响，包括热应激、疟疾、登革热、霍乱、孕产妇健康风险、粮食和营养不安全，以及极端天气事件对医疗设施造成的破坏。因此，草案呼吁各国将健康因素纳入本国适应计划和气候计划，同时加强气候信息和预警系统，以保护公众健康。对于山区，第31段提议制定气候变化专项工作计划，将气候变化列为缔约方大会的常设议程项目，并在COP32期间举行高级别对话。文件还鼓励各国将基于海洋的可持续措施纳入本国气候承诺和适应计划，并由可预测资金、技术和能力建设予以支持。在包容性方面，草案呼吁原住民、妇女、儿童、青年、残障人士和地方社区切实参与气候行动和决策。草案还处理了发展中国家对单边气候相关贸易措施的关切。第115段对这类措施可能将气候行动的经济负担转移给发展中国家表示关切，并指出这会影响市场准入、竞争力、投资和工业化。草案提议就气候相关贸易措施的共同指导原则展开讨论，包括透明度、非歧视性和互操作性。第119段进一步呼吁发达国家在2027年底前取消单边气候相关贸易限制措施，以及其他对国际气候合作产生不利影响的措施。这些提议反映出发展中国家的更广泛关切：较富裕经济体采取的气候政策，不应为资源较少、难以向低排放产业转型的国家设置更多经济壁垒。COP31即将进入最后阶段，但各主要分歧仍待解决。COP31谈判主席Chris Bowen表示，仍有100多项议程项目和约60项重要授权待审议，涉及气候资金、适应、减缓及公正转型等议题。COP31主席Murat Kurum表示，未来一周将是把会议期间取得的进展转化为具体决定的关键一周。Kurum先生说：“我们将加强部长级磋商，并努力将各国正在审议的议题转化为共同决定。”Bowen先生也承认，草案中的某些条款不会得到所有参与国支持，并将该文件称为后续谈判前的初步讨论基础。随着大会临近11月20日预定闭幕日期，各国将必须解决气候资金、化石燃料的未来以及对脆弱国家支持等方面的分歧……

https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.title: New presidential jet purchase was driven by cost concerns, not improved economy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.summary: Minister of State in charge of Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, has rejected suggestions that the purchase of the new presidential jet was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances. According to him, the decision to procure a new presidential aircraft was driven by concerns over the cost of maintaining the existing Falcon 900 and the expense of chartering private jets, not an improvement in the economy.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.summary_zh: 负责政府通信事务的国务部长费利克斯·夸克耶·奥福苏否定了有关购买新总统专机是因为该国经济状况有所改善的说法。他认为，采购新总统飞机的决定主要考虑到维护现有“猎鹰900”机型的成本，以及包租私人飞机的开支，并非出于经济状况改善的原因。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.body: Minister of State in charge of Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, has rejected suggestions that the purchase of the new presidential jet was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances. According to him, the decision to procure a new presidential aircraft was driven by concerns over the cost of maintaining the existing Falcon 900 and the expense of chartering private jets, not an improvement in the economy. Speaking in an interview on Joy FM’s Top Story on Tuesday, November 17, he said the Ghana Air Force had made an urgent request to government for new aircraft following the August 6 disaster, citing frequent breakdowns of its fleet and difficulties obtaining spare parts. Mr Kwakye Ofosu said the Air Force had presented a Cabinet memorandum recommending the purchase of four military transport helicopters and two executive jets. He said the Falcon 900 had become economically unsustainable as the primary aircraft for presidential travel because of its frequent breakdowns and high maintenance costs. Mr Kwakye Ofosu argued that when the cost of maintaining the aircraft and chartering private jets was considered, it exceeded the cost of procuring a replacement. He said government decided to purchase the four military helicopters and only one executive jet, rather than the two recommended by the Air Force. “The government took the decision that we will purchase the four military helicopters and then one executive jet, which is the smaller one they recommended,” he said. Mr Kwakye Ofosu said Parliament approved the procurement on December 4, 2025, after the then Acting Minister of Defence and the Minister of Finance presented the request. He disclosed that the first military helicopter had arrived earlier in the year, while the new Falcon 6X arrived on Monday, November 16. According to him, a second military helicopter was expected within the following two weeks, with two more to complete the Air Force’s requested fleet. While rejecting suggestions that the purchase was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances, he, however, pointed to changes in the country's debt position, saying the previous government had declared that Ghana was unable to meet its debt obligations and had left bondholders without coupon payments for several months. He said the current government was now making bond payments ahead of schedule, which he cited as evidence of an improvement in the economy. His comments follow criticism from the Minority over the government's decision to acquire a new presidential aircraft, with members questioning the need for the purchase amid the country's economic challenges. The debate has also revived comments by the Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, who, while the NDC was in opposition, argued that Ghana could not afford a new presidential jet given the country's economic circumstances
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.title_zh: 购买新总统专机是出于成本考虑，而非经济状况改善
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.body_zh: 负责政府传播事务的国务部长费利克斯·夸克维·奥福苏否定了有关购买新总统专机是因为该国经济状况有所改善才合乎情理的说法。据他表示，决定采购新总统飞机是出于维护现有“猎鹰900”飞机的成本以及租用私人飞机的开支，并非因为经济状况改善。周二11月17日，他接受Joy FM《头条故事》节目采访时说，8月6日事故发生后，加纳空军紧急向政府请求购置新飞机，理由是机队经常发生故障，而且难以获得备件。夸克维·奥福苏先生说，空军向内阁提交了一份备忘录，建议购买4架军用运输直升机和2架行政专机。他说，由于“猎鹰900”经常发生故障且维护费用高昂，作为总统出行主要飞机已经难以在经济上持续运营。夸克维·奥福苏先生认为，计入维护飞机和租用私人飞机的成本后，相关支出超过了采购替代飞机的成本。他说，政府决定购买4架军用直升机和1架行政专机，而不是采纳空军建议的2架。他表示：“政府决定购买4架军用直升机，再购买1架行政专机，也就是他们建议的较小那一架。”夸克维·奥福苏先生说，时任代理国防部长和财政部长提交采购请求后，议会于2025年12月4日批准了这项采购。他透露，第一架军用直升机已于今年早些时候抵达，新的“猎鹰6X”则于11月16日星期一运抵。据他表示，第二架军用直升机预计在接下来的两周内抵达，另有两架也将运抵，以完成空军所请求的机队配置。在否定购买新飞机是因为国家经济状况改善才合乎情理的说法的同时，他仍指出该国债务状况发生了变化，称上一届政府曾宣布加纳无力履行债务义务，并连续数月未向债券持有人支付票息。他说，现届政府目前正提前支付债券款项，并以此作为经济状况改善的证据。此前，少数派批评政府购买新总统专机的决定，议员们质疑该国面临经济挑战时是否有必要进行这项采购。这场争论也再次引发外交事务部长塞缪尔·奥库德佐·阿布瓦卡的评论；国家民主大会党在野时，他曾认为，鉴于加纳的经济状况，该国无力购买新的总统专机

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary: Former Lagos State Governor, Babatunde Fashola, has urged Nigerians to weigh opposition parties’ proposals before rejecting President Bola Tinubu’s reforms, saying the country should not “abort this journey mid-term” without considering the alternatives.
