https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary_zh: 前拉各斯州州长巴巴通德·法什拉呼吁尼日利亚民众在否决总统博拉·蒂努布的改革之前，认真权衡反对党提出的方案。他表示，国家不应在不考虑替代方案的情况下“中途终止这一进程”。前工程部长法什拉在Channels Television接受采访时说，应帮助选民在2027年大选前作出明智选择。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: Former Lagos State Governor, Babatunde Fashola, has urged Nigerians to weigh opposition parties’ proposals before rejecting President Bola Tinubu’s reforms, saying the country should not “abort this journey mid-term” without considering the alternatives. Fashola, a former Minister of Works, spoke on Channels Television, where he said voters should be helped to make informed choices ahead of the 2027 general election. “What are the other parties offering that is different, that is better, that is compelling as a reason to interrupt the process of reform and restructuring that is already underway?” he asked. He acknowledged the hardship many Nigerians face but said the cost-of-living crisis was not unique to Nigeria. “Anybody who is right-thinking will concede that the cost-of-living challenge is now a global challenge,” he said, citing the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and conflicts that disrupted energy and food supplies. On the removal of petrol subsidy, he said a return to the policy would have consequences for government revenue and the funds available to states and local governments. “Subsidy is not just about ‘I said it, I did not say it’. It has to be paid for somewhere. One of the things that suffered because of that was the monthly receipts into the federation account.” Fashola challenged politicians proposing a return to subsidy to explain how they would fund it and what they would do differently. “I want to see rigour, I want to see detail, I want to see numbers,” he said, adding that Nigeria also needed to explain where the crude oil for subsidised supply would come from, given constraints on production. Fashola said the government deserved credit for maintaining the subsidy removal, despite the hardship it had caused. “What this government deserves commendation for is not falling over on the sword and saying because the people like it, let’s bring it back,” he said. He cited the introduction of compressed natural gas, or CNG, as one of the measures aimed at reducing living costs. Defending the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway, Fashola said it had reduced travel time to the Lekki Port. “It took me 40 minutes from Ikoyi to get to that port. Traditionally, when I went to visit that site when I was governor, it used to take me all of one and a half hours. A 90-minute journey is now 40 minutes. “Go and calculate the fuel savings in that corridor, and the relief to people’s disposable income,” he said. Fashola also pointed to jobs created by construction activity along the route, saying: “I wish that somebody will commission a survey about how many people are earning a daily living from the construction activity that is going on there.” Asked about the project’s cost, Fashola said the Bureau of Public Procurement was responsible for reviewing contract prices and issuing certificates of no objection. On questions about Tinubu’s fitness to govern, he said: “Nothing suggests to me that he’s not fit.” He described the president as “much more mature” than when they first worked together and said Tinubu was still reading, giving directives and managing government affairs. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: 2027年：在否决蒂努布的改革前权衡其他选择
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 拉各斯州前州长巴巴通德·法绍拉敦促尼日利亚人在拒绝总统博拉·蒂努布的改革之前，权衡反对党提出的方案，称国家不应在未考虑替代方案的情况下“半途终止这段进程”。法绍拉曾任工程部长。他在Channels Television接受采访时表示，应帮助选民在2027年大选前作出明智选择。他问道：“其他政党提出了什么不同的、更好的方案，有什么足以 compelling 的理由中断已经开展的改革和重组进程？”他承认许多尼日利亚人正面临困难，但表示生活成本危机并非尼日利亚独有。“任何思维正确的人都会承认，生活成本挑战如今已成为全球性挑战。”他说，并列举了新冠疫情以及扰乱能源和食品供应的冲突所造成的影响。谈到取消汽油补贴时，他说恢复该政策将影响政府收入以及各州和地方政府可用的资金。他说：“补贴不只是‘我说了，我没说’的问题。这笔钱总得找地方出。由于这一点而受到影响的事情之一，就是联邦账户每月收到的款项。”法绍拉要求主张恢复补贴的政治人士说明将如何筹措补贴资金，以及他们会采取哪些不同的做法。“我希望看到严谨的态度、具体的细节和确凿的数据，”他说，并补充说，鉴于原油生产受到限制，尼日利亚还需要说明用于补贴供应的原油将从哪里来。法绍拉表示，政府维持取消补贴的做法值得肯定，尽管这一做法造成了困难。“本届政府值得称赞之处，是没有因为人们喜欢这项政策，就自行倒下并说让我们把它恢复回来，”他说。他列举了推广压缩天然气（CNG）作为降低生活成本的措施之一。 defends为拉各斯—卡拉巴尔沿海公路辩护时，法绍拉表示，该公路缩短了前往莱基港的出行时间。“我从伊科伊到那座港口用了40分钟。过去我担任州长、前往考察该地点时，通常要花整整一个半小时。现在90分钟的路程只需40分钟。“你们算算这条线路节省了多少燃油，也算算它给人们可支配收入带来了多大缓解。”他说。法绍拉还提到公路沿线施工活动创造的就业机会，并表示：“我希望有人委托开展一项调查，了解有多少人依靠当地正在进行的施工活动维持日常生计。”当被问及该项目的成本时，法绍拉说，公共采购局负责审查合同价格并出具无异议证明。关于蒂努布是否适合执政的问题，他说：“在我看来，没有任何迹象表明他不适合。”他形容这位总统比两人最初共事时“成熟得多”，并表示蒂努布仍在不断学习、发出指示和管理政府事务。本文所述评论不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的意见

https://leadership.ng/terrorism-group-ur.body: The group’s North-West Coordinator, Dr John Ikpeme, made the call at its end-of-year dinner in Kaduna, saying the government and security agencies were overstretched by persistent terrorist attacks across the country. He said the attacks had resulted in the loss of innocent lives, destruction of property and displacement of communities, forcing many residents to abandon their ancestral homes in search of safety. Ikpeme said Nigeria needed international cooperation, particularly in the area of technical expertise, to effectively confront terrorist groups and other criminal elements. He argued that the country lacked the technical know-how required to adequately address the security challenges, adding that collaboration with developed nations would help strengthen efforts to restore peace. According to him, sustained insecurity has also hindered national development and subjected citizens to hardship, making it necessary for all stakeholders to work towards finding lasting solutions. He said Nigeria was endowed with abundant human and natural resources, stressing that a peaceful environment was necessary for citizens to maximise their potential and improve their living standards. Ikpeme added that the group continued to pray for peace in Nigeria, Israel and other parts of the world, expressing hope for divine intervention to restore peace and unity. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/sena.summary_zh: 参议院党务主管、代表博尔诺州北区的参议员穆罕默德·塔希尔·蒙古诺，与全体进步大会党（APC）的一些资深人士一样，躲过了博科哈姆在该州库卡瓦地方政府区域发动的袭击。消息人士称，包括参议院党务主管在内的一些政治人物从蒙古诺前往库卡瓦拉票，恐怖分子企图在此次拉票活动中迫使当地居民离开。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/sena.body: The Senate Chief Whip and Senator representing Borno North, Mohammed Tahir Monguno, alongside some All Progressives Congress (APC) stalwarts, have escaped Boko Haram’s attempted attack in the Kukawa Local Government Area of the state. Sources said Monguno and a former Governor Senator Maina Maaji Lawan, among others, stormed Kukawa in continuation of their 2027 campaign tour. Earlier, Monguno had joined Governor Babagana Zulum at the official launch of the campaign in Monguno town last Sunday, before the governor disengaged on Monday from Monguno back to Maiduguri via a helicopter, while some of his entourage arrived in Maiduguri the same day by road. Sources said some politicians, including the Senate Chief Whip, proceeded from Monguno to Kukawa to canvass for votes, in which the terrorists attempted to dislodge the community. It was also gathered that, based on intelligence, troops of Operation Hadin Kai swung into action and foiled the attempted attacks by terrorists on the campaign entourage. According to reports by Yerwa News Express, a local online media outlet said, “The terrorists fired three mortar bombs toward Kukawa on Monday while Mr Monguno, former Borno State Governor Maina Maaji Lawan, and other political figures were in the town for campaign activities. “Local sources had earlier reported threats by the terrorists to disrupt the campaign, prompting heightened security measures. “Troops of Operation Hadin Kai detected the movement of the terrorists around Kukawa and swiftly responded, preventing them from carrying out the attack. “The campaign team subsequently returned safely to Monguno without any casualties. In a related development, troops foiled another attempted attack on Kekeno village in the early hours of Tuesday, November 17, 2026. “At about 1:20 a.m., alert troops spotted suspicious movements by suspected terrorists travelling on foot from the general area of Barwati toward Kekeno village. “The troops immediately advanced toward the suspected terrorists and engaged them with heavy gunfire. “Unable to withstand the troops’ firepower, the terrorists reportedly fled into the surrounding bush. “The military said follow-up operations are ongoing in the area to track down the fleeing terrorists. “It added that the situation remained calm, with troops maintaining heightened surveillance.” Sources and Yerwa Express News reported. Due to a lack of telecommunication networks in the zone, the Senate Chief Whip’s phone number was not available at the time our correspondent dialled to confirm the incident. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/sena.title_zh: 参议院党鞭蒙努诺等人在博尔诺州躲过疑似博科圣地袭击
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/sena.body_zh: 参议院首席党鞭、代表博尔诺州北区的参议员穆罕默德·塔希尔·蒙努诺，以及全进步大会党（APC）的几位资深党员，在该州库卡瓦地方政府辖区逃脱了博科圣组织实施的一次袭击。消息人士称，在继续开展2027年竞选活动时，蒙努诺、前州长兼参议员迈纳·马阿吉·拉万等人中的一行人突然前往库卡瓦。此前，上周日蒙努诺曾与州长巴巴加纳·祖卢姆一同参加在蒙努诺镇举行的竞选活动正式启动仪式；周一，州长乘直升机从蒙努诺返回迈杜古里，其随行人员中的部分人员则于当天经陆路抵达迈杜古里。消息人士称，包括参议院首席党鞭在内的一些政治人物从蒙努诺前往库卡瓦拉票，恐怖分子企图驱散当地居民。据《Yerwa News Express》报道，这是一家当地网络媒体，该媒体称：“周一，当蒙努诺先生、博尔诺州前州长迈纳·马阿吉·拉万及其他政治人物在该镇开展竞选活动时，恐怖分子向库卡瓦发射了3枚迫击炮弹。“当地消息人士此前曾报道，恐怖分子威胁要扰乱竞选活动，因此当局加强了安全措施。“Hadin Kai行动的部队发现恐怖分子在库卡瓦周边活动后迅速作出回应，挫败了他们袭击竞选随行人员的企图。“竞选团队随后安全返回蒙努诺，没有人员伤亡。相关消息显示，部队于2026年11月17日星期二凌晨挫败了针对凯凯诺村的另一次袭击。“凌晨约1时20分，警觉的部队发现疑似恐怖分子正徒步从巴尔瓦蒂一带向凯凯诺村移动，行动可疑。“部队立即向疑似恐怖分子逼近，并以密集火力与其交火。“据报道，恐怖分子无法抵挡部队的火力，随即逃入周边丛林。“军方表示，正在该地区开展后续行动，以追捕逃跑的恐怖分子。“军方补充称，该地区局势仍然平静，部队正保持高度戒备。”消息人士和《Yerwa Express News》报道称。由于该地区通信网络瘫痪，我们的记者拨打参议院首席党鞭的电话号码核实事件时，无法接通。此处发表的意见不反映《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点。

https://www.inquirer.net/496079/tarriela.body: “Right now, the international community no longer hesitates to call out who is Voldemort, who is aggressor, who is the victim, and who is the bozo,” Tarriela said during the Manila Dialogue on the South China Sea in Parañaque City. READ: Tarriela rebuffs Chinese scholar’s Ayungin shoal claim Tarriela said the government’s transparency initiative had encouraged foreign governments to openly identify those responsible for aggressive actions at sea, unlike in previous years when they avoided naming the countries involved. He compared their previous reluctance to identify maritime aggressors to the fear of mentioning Voldemort, whose name characters in the Harry Potter series avoided saying. “Voldemort is so powerful that they cannot even mention his name,” he said. Sophie Wushuang Yi of the Beijing-based Grandview Institution challenged Tarriela’s analogy, saying she was saddened by the comparison. READ: Tarriela: Chinese envoy got the wrong Teodoro in oil talks row “I’m really saddened to hear the comparison between Voldemort or you know who,” said Yi, a longtime Harry Potter fan who spent 11 years in the United Kingdom. She argued that countries have different interpretations of justice and fairness, suggesting that a figure considered a villain by one side could be viewed as a hero by another. “One country’s defense is another’s offense. One’s Voldemort is perhaps one’s Dumbledore,” she said. Tarriela, however, clarified that his analogy was not directed exclusively at China but applied to any country violating international law. “Those who violate the international law is Voldemort,” he said. Yi also cited Beijing’s concerns over military exercises involving the US, the Philippines and Japan, saying such activities could be perceived as threatening by China even when participating countries considered them defensive. She warned that intensifying military competition could increase the risk of unintended confrontations in the region. “I sincerely hope that the existing diplomatic channels or the diplomatic dramas will not affect the existing communication channels that we have at the operational level,” Yi said. Tarriela, meanwhile, rejected claims that the transparency initiative had escalated tensions in the South China Sea, saying it aimed to raise public awareness, encourage international support and counter misinformation. “Transparency, it is not intended to provoke anybody,” he said. The initiative began after a Chinese Coast Guard vessel directed a military-grade laser at BRP Malapascua, a Philippine patrol vessel, near Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal in February 2023, shortly after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s state visit to Beijing. https://www.inquirer.net/496079/tarriela.title_zh: 塔里埃拉把海上违法者比作“伏地魔”，中国学者予以反驳
https://www.inquirer.net/496079/tarriela.body_zh: “目前，国际社会已不再犹豫，明确指出谁是Voldemort、谁是侵略者、谁是受害者、谁是笨蛋。”塔里埃拉在帕拉尼亚克市举行的马尼拉南海对话会上说。阅读：塔里埃拉驳斥中国学者有关Ayungin浅滩的说法。塔里埃拉表示，政府的透明度倡议鼓励外国政府公开认定应对海上侵略行为负责者，而往年它们会回避点名涉事国家。他将外国政府过去不愿确定海上侵略者的做法，比作害怕提及Voldemort，因为《哈利·波特》系列中的人物都避免说出这个名字。“Voldemort太强大，以至于他们连他的名字都不敢提。”他说。总部位于北京的远望机构（Grandview Institution）的Sophie Wushuang Yi质疑塔里埃拉所作的类比，称她为这种比较感到难过。阅读：塔里埃拉：中国特使在石油谈判争端中找错了Teodoro。“听到有人把Voldemort，也就是你知道的那位，与别人相比，我真的很难过。”Yi说。她是《哈利·波特》的忠实粉丝，曾在英国生活11年。她认为，各国对正义与公平有不同解读，因此被一方视为反派的人物，在另一方看来可能是英雄。“一个国家的防御就是另一个国家的进攻。一个人的Voldemort或许就是另一个人的Dumbledore。”她说。然而，塔里埃拉澄清，他的类比并非只针对中国，也适用于任何违反国际法的国家。“那些违反国际法的人就是Voldemort。”他说。Yi还提及北京对涉及美国、菲律宾和日本的军事演习的关切，称即使参与国认为这些活动属于防御性质，中国仍可能将其视为威胁。她警告，军事竞争加剧可能提高该地区发生意外对抗的风险。“我真诚希望，现有的外交渠道或外交戏剧不会影响我们在行动层面已有的沟通渠道。”Yi说。与此同时，塔里埃拉否认透明度倡议加剧了南海紧张局势，称其目的是提高公众意识、争取国际支持以及反驳错误信息。“开展透明度工作并不是为了激怒任何人。”他说。这项倡议始于2023年2月，当时菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯二世对北京进行国事访问后不久，中国海警船在Ayungin（Second Thomas）浅滩附近，将一束军用激光照射到菲律宾巡逻舰BRP Malapascua号上。与此同时，Yi呼吁建立“战略同理心”，即在不必然认同另一国立场的情况下，理解对方如何解读自身行动。您的订阅未能保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。她建议，在公开透明度的同时维持海事人员之间的私下沟通渠道，防止海上事件升级为外交危机。/jpv 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们关于西菲律宾海动态的专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点随时了解最新情况

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: U.S. President Donald Trump floated the prospect of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his trip to China this week, but experts said talks are unlikely in the near term and warned that any eventual deal with Pyongyang could leave South Korea facing new security risks. Before departing for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, Trump told reporters, “We may meet with Kim Jong-un also, so that’ll be good. We have a chance to accomplish a lot.” Asked about Kim, he added, “He may come; I don’t know. That’s up to (Chinese) President Xi (Jinping).” On the agenda for a planned three-way summit with Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin, Trump said, “We are going to talk about denuclearization. Tough subject because it is very hard for any of us to say we will get rid of our nukes.” His remarks came amid growing doubts that a Trump-Kim meeting would take place on the sidelines of the APEC summit. A senior U.S. official reportedly told reporters Sunday, “There are no plans at all for engagement with North Korea.” A Cheong Wa Dae official also downplayed the prospect of a summit on Thursday, saying, “North Korea is unlikely to attend a multilateral gathering. While it is difficult to be certain, I doubt a Trump-Kim summit will take place.” South Korean authorities have taken a cautious approach, maintaining that there are no signs of official preparations for a summit while keeping the door open. “Judging by the specific circumstances, the possibility is generally low,” a foreign ministry official said. “However, we cannot rule it out since Trump made such remarks again and we don’t know the background behind them.” A unification ministry official said there was “no information” on any travel by Kim to China, but noted he could reach the country by air or by crossing the border overland. “We haven’t ruled out the possibility of Kim visiting China. We should wait and see,” the official said. Experts said Trump-Kim talks remain possible, though not at APEC, given the lack of signs of working-level exchanges between Pyongyang and Washington. “I think there is a possibility, but not in the immediate future. A meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit seems particularly unlikely,” said Park Won-gon, a professor of North Korean studies at Ewha Womans University, adding that Kim may prefer a bottom-up approach, with working-level negotiations preceding a leaders’ summit, to avoid a repeat of the Hanoi summit in 2019. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University’s Institute for Far Eastern Studies, sees no signs of the preliminary contact and coordination that normally precede a summit with Pyongyang. “It takes several times more effort to get Kim to make a move and there are no signs of such preparations now,” Lim said. “From Kim’s perspective, a meeting would be an opportunity to secure major objectives, such as recognition as a nuclear weapons state or an easing of what North Korea calls hostile policies toward it. These are not easy issues.” He added that Kim currently has nothing to gain from a meeting with Trump. “There would first need to be back-and-forth exchanges, at least at the working level, to coordinate the agenda," he said. "North Korea is closely coordinating various issues with China and Russia and discussing how to develop those relationships, but it is not doing the same with the U.S." They also said formal recognition of North Korea as a nuclear state would be difficult for Trump to pursue, but warned that negotiations could still drift in a direction unfavorable to South Korea. Park noted the issue would be complicated. “Since North Korea refuses to engage in denuclearization talks at all, negotiations could shift toward nuclear arms control, potentially leading to de facto recognition of its nuclear status. But it would be difficult for either the U.S. or China to recognize North Korea as a de facto nuclear weapons state, as doing so would undermine their own nuclear monopoly,” he said. The greater risk for Seoul, Park said, would be a deal in which Washington eases some sanctions in exchange for a halt to long-range missile development with Pyongyang retaining a short-range arsenal. “If Trump achieves that, he could declare victory, saying he has made the U.S. mainland safe, and use that narrative for domestic political purposes," Park said. "That would pose a security challenge for South Korea.” Whang Taehee, a professor of political science and international studies at Yonsei University, also expressed concern. “Trump acknowledges that North Korea possesses nuclear weapons to ensure the regime’s survival,” he said during a YTN broadcast. "But the problem is that recognizing its nuclear status would undermine the Nuclear Nonproliferation Treaty regime and shift negotiations toward nuclear arms control, putting South Korea at a significant disadvantage." However, Lim said the incoming Democratic-controlled U.S. Congress could limit Trump’s room to maneuver. “Trump cannot do this on his authority alone. Congressional approval is necessary. With the makeup of Congress changing completely on Jan. 3, 2027, there will be very little Trump can do,” Lim said. Park stressed that Seoul’s best safeguard is closer coordination with Washington. “Our only option is to strengthen cooperation between South Korea and the United States. Whether it is a summit among the U.S., China and Russia or some other arrangement, there is a risk that South Korea could be sidelined,” Park said. “To avoid that, Seoul and Washington need close communication and cooperation. Relations between the two countries are strained on several fronts at the moment, so it is important to quickly readjust the relationship and get it back on track.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 特朗普试探在中国举行朝美峰会，但专家看不到任何准备迹象
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周赴中国访问期间提出，本周访华期间他可能与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面，但专家表示近期会谈的可能性不大，并警告说，与平壤最终达成的任何协议都可能使韩国面临新的安全风险。在启程前往中国深圳出席亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会之前，特朗普对记者说：“我们也可能与金正恩会面，那样挺好。我们有机会取得很多成果。”被问及金正恩时，他补充说：“他可能会来；我不知道，这要看（中国）习近平主席的安排。”特朗普说，在与习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京计划举行的三方峰会议程中，“我们将讨论无核化。这个议题很棘手，因为我们要让任何一方表态放弃核武器都非常困难。”他的这番讲话正值外界对特朗普与金正恩是否会在APEC峰会期间会面的疑虑日益加深之际。据报道，一名美国高级官员周日对记者表示：“目前完全没有与朝鲜接触的计划。”青瓦台一名官员周四也淡化了举行峰会的可能性，称：“朝鲜不太可能参加多边会议。虽然难以确定，但我怀疑特朗普与金正恩的峰会不会举行。”韩国当局采取谨慎态度，坚持表示没有任何官方筹备峰会的迹象，同时仍为峰会留有余地。一名外 ministry官员表示：“从具体情况判断，可能性总体较低。”“不过，既然特朗普又说了这样的话，我们也不知道他背后的考量，因此不能排除。”统一 ministry一名官员表示，关于金正恩访华“没有任何信息”，但指出他可以乘飞机或经陆路跨境抵达中国。该官员说：“我们尚未排除金正恩访华的可能性。我们应该观望。”专家表示，在缺乏平壤与华盛顿之间工作层接触迹象的情况下，特朗普与金正恩的会谈仍然有可能，只是不会在APEC期间举行。梨花女子大学朝鲜研究教授朴元健说：“我认为存在可能性，但不是近期。在APEC峰会期间会面似乎尤其不太可能。”他补充说，金正恩可能更倾向于自下而上的做法，即先进行工作层谈判，再举行领导人峰会，以避免重演2019年河内峰会的情形。庆南大学远东研究所教授林曰哲认为，目前看不到通常在平壤峰会之前进行的前期接触与协调的迹象。林说：“要促使金正恩采取行动，需要付出数倍的努力，而目前没有任何这类准备的迹象。”“从金正恩的角度看，会面将是一个实现重大目标的机会，例如获得承认其为核武器国家，或缓解朝鲜所称的针对它的敌视政策。这些都不是容易解决的问题。”他补充说，金正恩目前从与特朗普会面中得不到任何好处。他说：“首先需要双方来回交换意见，至少在工作层层面协调议程。朝鲜正在就多项议题与中国和俄罗斯密切协调，讨论如何发展这些关系，但它对美国并没有这样做。”他们还表示，正式承认朝鲜为核国家对特朗普而言将难以推行，但警告谈判仍可能朝对韩国不利的方向漂移。朴指出，这一议题将十分复杂。他说：“由于朝鲜完全拒绝参与无核化谈判，谈判可能转向核军备控制，从而有可能导致事实上的核地位承认。但无论是美国还是中国，都很难承认朝鲜为事实上的核武器国家，因为这样做会破坏自身的核垄断。”朴说，对首尔而言更大的风险，是一种华盛顿放松部分制裁、以换取朝鲜停止发展远程导弹、同时平壤保留短程导弹库的协议。朴说：“如果特朗普实现了这一点，他可以宣布胜利，称自己保障了美国本土的安全，并把这一说法用于国内政治目的。那将给韩国带来安全挑战。”延世大学政治学与国际研究教授黄太熙也表达了担忧。他说，在YTN播出的节目中：“特朗普承认朝鲜拥有核武器，以确保政权生存。”“但问题在于，承认其核地位会削弱《不扩散核武器条约》体系，并使谈判转向核军备控制，使韩国处于非常不利的位置。”不过林表示，即将上任的由民主党掌控的美国国会会限制特朗普的回旋空间。林说：“特朗普无法凭一己之力做成这件事，必须获得国会批准。随着国会构成在2027年1月3日完全改变，特朗普能做的事情将非常有限。”朴强调，首尔最好的保障是与华盛顿加强协调。朴说：“我们唯一的选择是加强韩美合作。无论是美国、中国和俄罗斯之间的峰会，还是其他某种安排，韩国都有被边缘化的风险。”“为避免这种情况，首尔和华盛顿需要密切沟通与合作。目前两国关系在多个方面较为紧张，因此迅速重新调整双边关系、使其重回正轨十分重要。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday upgraded its growth forecast for the South Korean economy to 3.9 percent for this year, up 0.6 percentage point from its earlier projection last month, amid the accelerating global semiconductor supercycle. An IMF delegation, led by mission chief Corinne Delechat, made the forecast after a two-week consultation with key Korean economic and financial institutions, including the Ministry of Finance and Economy.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）周二将韩国经济今年增速预测上调至3.9%，比上月早前的预测高0.6个百分点，原因是全球半导体超级周期正在加速。IMF代表团由团长科琳·德莱沙率领，在与韩国主要经济和金融机构，包括财政部和经济部，进行了为期两周的磋商后作出上述预测。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday upgraded its growth forecast for the South Korean economy to 3.9 percent for this year, up 0.6 percentage point from its earlier projection last month, amid the accelerating global semiconductor supercycle. An IMF delegation, led by mission chief Corinne Delechat, made the forecast after a two-week consultation with key Korean economic and financial institutions, including the Ministry of Finance and Economy. The IMF's World Economic Outlook earlier projected 3.3 percent growth. The team also said the Korean economy will grow 3.3 percent in 2027, marking growth of more than 3 percent for the second consecutive year. "The global AI upcycle is providing an exceptional boost to the Korean economy through record-high semiconductor exports, driving strong corporate earnings and fiscal revenue," it said. It also forecast that inflation will reach 2.7 percent in 2026 and 2.3 percent in 2027 amid strengthening domestic demand. The IMF team, however, pointed out that the benefits of strong growth have been spreading to the broader economy at a slow pace, with the technology sector largely enjoying the gains. It called for a carefully coordinated mix of monetary and fiscal policies to help contain aggregate demand pressures while providing targeted support to vulnerable households and firms. "Sustaining recent gains from the AI upcycle would require addressing longstanding structural headwinds, including rapid population aging, widening regional disparities and uneven productivity growth across firms and workers," the IMF team said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 受芯片业繁荣推动，国际货币基金组织将韩国2026年经济增长预测上调至3.9%
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）周二将韩国今年经济增长预测上调至3.9%，比上月早些时候的预测高出0.6个百分点，原因是全球半导体超级周期正在加速。IMF代表团在访问团团长Corinne Delechat带领下，与韩国主要经济和金融机构（包括财政经济部）进行了为期两周的磋商后作出了这一预测。IMF的《世界经济展望》此前预计经济增长3.3%。代表团还表示，韩国经济将在2027年增长3.3%，这意味着经济增速将连续第二年保持在3%以上。代表团说：“全球人工智能上行周期通过创纪录的半导体出口为韩国经济注入了一股非凡的推动力，带动了强劲的企业盈利和财政收入。”代表团还预测，随着国内需求走强，通货膨胀率将在2026年达到2.7%，2027年达到2.3%。不过，IMF代表团指出强劲增长带来的收益向更广泛经济领域扩散的速度仍然缓慢，收益在很大程度上由科技部门独享。代表团呼吁谨慎协调货币政策与财政政策，在帮助抑制总需求压力的同时，为脆弱家庭和企业提供有针对性的支持。IMF代表团说：“要保持人工智能上行周期带来的近期成果，就必须解决长期存在的结构性阻力，包括人口快速老龄化、地区差距扩大以及企业和劳动者之间生产率增长不均等问题。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 固体矿产开发部长德莱·阿拉基为总统博拉·蒂努布的经济改革辩护，认为这些政策是奠定长期经济繁荣基础的必要条件。阿拉基同时担任进步大会党（APC）总统竞选活动发言人。他表示，执政党将在2027年大选竞选期间重点关注自身的问题和执政记录，而不是参与政治暴力或制造干扰。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dele Alake, has defended President Bola Tinubu’s economic reforms, arguing that the policies are necessary to lay the foundation for long-term economic prosperity. Mr Alake, who is also the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Spokesperson, said the ruling party would focus on issues and its record in government during the 2027 general election campaign, rather than engage in political violence or distractions. The minister spoke during an interview on TVC News’ Politics Tonight, where he discussed the administration’s economic policies, the restructuring of the APC Presidential Campaign Council’s media team and criticisms from opposition politicians. He described the decision to restrict the number of authorised campaign spokespersons to three as an administrative measure designed to improve coordination and ensure consistency in the party’s public communication. According to him, the decision was not intended to diminish the status of those previously appointed as spokespersons. “It was an administrative decision to ensure synergy in messaging and prevent coordination issues. It was not about loss of status for previous members,” he said. On reports of political violence and the use of weapons at campaign rallies, Mr Alake insisted that the APC was committed to an issue-based campaign. He accused opposition supporters of orchestrating acts of violence and using social media to create misleading narratives about the ruling party. He said the APC would concentrate on its policies and achievements, arguing that opposition parties resorted to distractions because they lacked credible alternatives to the administration’s programmes. The minister also defended the removal of petrol subsidy and the unification of the foreign exchange market, describing both policies as necessary to address longstanding distortions in the economy. He argued that the former subsidy regime encouraged fuel smuggling and allowed individuals to benefit from government-subsidised petrol at the expense of the country. He also said the previous multiple exchange rate system created opportunities for individuals with connections at the Central Bank of Nigeria to profit from preferential access to foreign exchange. Mr Alake said the reforms improved foreign exchange liquidity and the ability of businesses, particularly international airlines, to repatriate their earnings. He cited the clearance of a $7 billion backlog of trapped airline funds as evidence of improved access to foreign exchange. He also attributed an increase in non-oil exports to the depreciation of the naira. Acknowledging the hardship associated with the reforms, the minister described the current economic difficulties as temporary adjustments necessary to address deeper structural problems. He said savings from the removal of petrol subsidy were being redirected to agriculture, manufacturing and industrial development. Mr Alake also claimed that the measures had helped reduce inflation from 34 per cent to 14 per cent and increased Nigeria’s foreign reserves from $3 billion to $46 billion within three years. He further argued that the removal of the subsidy had improved the finances of state governments, allowing administrations that previously struggled to pay workers’ salaries to meet their obligations. Mr Alake also dismissed criticisms of the Tinubu administration by opposition politicians, including former Minister of Transportation Rotimi Amaechi, who has accused the government of worsening corruption. He questioned the records of opposition figures who had previously held public office, arguing that their criticisms should be measured against their own achievements in government. He challenged former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar and former Anambra State Governor Peter Obi to identify major legacy projects from their respective tenures. “What legacy projects survived from Atiku Abubakar’s term as vice-president or Peter Obi’s term as governor of Anambra?” he asked. The minister also cited projects such as Eko Atlantic and Awolowo Road in Lagos as examples of Mr Tinubu’s record as governor of the state, arguing that his performance demonstrated his capacity for effective leadership. Mr Alake also highlighted the performance of the Ministry of Solid Minerals Development, attributing improvements in revenue generation to the Tinubu administration’s economic diversification agenda. He said the ministry generated ₦6 billion in revenue, which he attributed to efforts to revitalise the solid minerals sector and implement the administration’s Renewed Hope Agenda. He said the government was pursuing economic diversification by strengthening the mining sector and improving its contribution to national revenue
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 阿拉基为蒂努布的改革辩护，称全进步人民党（APC）将以议题为基础开展竞选
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh:
固体矿产发展部长Dele Alake为总统Bola Tinubu的经济改革辩护，称这些政策是奠定长期经济繁荣基础的必要举措。Alake先生同时担任进步大会党（APC）总统竞选活动发言人，他表示，执政党将在2027年大选竞选期间重点关注各项议题及执政记录，而不是诉诸政治暴力或干扰活动。

这位部长接受了TVC News《今晚政治》节目的采访，讨论了政府的经济政策、APC总统竞选委员会媒体团队的重组，以及反对派政治人物提出的批评。他表示，将获授权的竞选发言人人数限制为3人，是旨在改善协调工作并确保党对外信息传播保持一致性的行政措施。据他称，这项决定并非旨在削弱此前获任发言人的地位。

“这是为确保信息传递形成协同效应并防止协调问题而作出的行政决定，并非意味着前任成员失去地位。”他说。

针对有关政治暴力以及竞选集会上使用武器的报道，Alake先生坚称APC致力于开展以议题为基础的竞选活动。他指责反对派支持者策划暴力行为，并利用社交媒体针对执政党编造误导性叙事。他说，APC将专注于自身的政策和成就，并认为反对党之所以采取干扰手段，是因为它们拿不出可信的替代方案来取代政府的各项计划。

这位部长还为取消汽油补贴和统一外汇市场辩护，称这两项政策都是解决经济中长期扭曲问题的必要措施。他认为，以往的补贴制度助长了燃料走私，使一些人能够以政府补贴的汽油获利，却由国家承担代价。他还指出，过去的多重汇率制度为那些在尼日利亚中央银行有关系的人提供了机会，使他们能够优先获得外汇并从中获利。

Alake先生说，这些改革改善了外汇流动性，也提高了企业，尤其是国际航空公司将收益汇回国内的能力。他列举了清理航空业70亿美元滞留资金作为获取外汇便利度改善的证据。他还把非石油出口增长归因于奈拉贬值。

尽管承认改革带来了困难，这位部长仍称，当前的经济困难是为解决更深层次结构性问题而进行的暂时性调整。他说，取消汽油补贴所节省的资金正被转用于农业、制造业和工业发展。

Alake先生还声称，这些措施帮助将通货膨胀率从34%降至14%，并在3年内将尼日利亚的外汇储备从30亿美元增至460亿美元。他进一步主张，取消补贴改善了各州政府的财政状况，使过去难以支付工作人员工资的政府能够履行义务。

Alake先生还驳斥了反对派政治人物对Tinubu政府的批评，其中包括前交通部长Rotimi Amaechi对政府加剧腐败的指控。他质疑那些曾担任公职的反对派人物的履历，认为评价他们的批评时，应当以其本人在政府任职期间的成就为依据。他要求前副总统Atiku Abubakar和前Anambra州州长Peter Obi各自列明任内留下的重大遗产项目。

“Atiku Abubakar担任副总统期间，或Peter Obi担任Anambra州州长期间，有哪些遗产项目留存至今？”他问道。

这位部长还列举了拉各斯的Eko Atlantic和Awolowo Road等项目，称这些项目是Tinubu先生担任该州州长期间政绩的例证，并认为其施政表现证明了他具备有效领导能力。

Alake先生还强调固体矿产发展部的工作成效，将收入增长归功于Tinubu政府的经济多元化议程。他说，该部创造了60亿奈拉收入，并将这一成果归因于推动固体矿产行业复兴及落实政府的《 renewed hope议程》的努力。他说，政府正在通过加强采矿行业、改善其对国家收入的贡献来推动经济多元化

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: Nigeria’s Minister of Defence, General Christopher Musa, has said the United States is providing real-time intelligence, satellite imagery and training to the Nigerian military to track and target terrorist leaders ahead of the 2027 general elections. According to Reuters, Musa disclosed this on Monday during a briefing with journalists, saying the improved intelligence support had strengthened the military’s ability to identify and strike militant targets. The minister said Nigerian troops had killed several terrorist and bandit leaders in overnight operations in the Northwest and Northeast, adding that the military was conducting almost daily operations with improved intelligence. “We took out a lot of the bandit leaders and the terrorists themselves,” Musa said. He said Nigeria and the United States had continued to expand their security cooperation as the country battles Islamist insurgencies in the North-East, armed banditry in the North-West and kidnapping gangs across the country. Musa also disclosed that Nigeria was expecting additional military helicopters from the United States and Italy to strengthen its operational capacity. On preparations for the 2027 general elections, the defence minister said security agencies were intensifying intelligence-led operations to prevent violence before, during and after the polls. He said authorities were also monitoring the use of Starlink satellite internet services, cryptocurrencies and commercial drones by militant groups, while working with US authorities to disrupt their financing networks. Musa further disclosed that Nigeria had reached a five-kilometre cross-border right-of-pursuit arrangement with Cameroon, Niger and Chad, allowing troops to pursue terrorists and bandits across border areas. The arrangement is aimed at restricting the movement of armed groups that exploit porous borders to escape security operations. The minister also warned that Islamic State Sahel was seeking to recruit criminal gangs in North-West Nigeria, raising concerns that largely profit-driven bandit groups could develop into ideologically driven insurgent organisations similar to the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP). According to him, militants and bandits have continued to exploit dense forests and porous borders with Niger and Benin to evade security forces after carrying out attacks. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 尼日利亚国防部长克里斯托弗·穆萨将军表示，在2027年大选前夕，美国正向尼日利亚军方提供实时情报、卫星图像和培训，以追踪并锁定恐怖组织头目。据路透社报道，穆萨周一在与记者举行简报会时透露了上述情况，称改进后的情报支持增强了军方识别和打击武装分子的能力。部长表示，尼日利亚军队在西北部和东北部开展的夜间行动中击毙了数名恐怖分子和匪徒头目，并称凭借改进后的情报，军方正几乎每日开展行动。穆萨说：“我们消灭了大量匪徒头目以及恐怖分子本人。”他说，面对东北部的伊斯兰主义叛乱、西北部的武装匪徒活动以及全国各地的绑架团伙，尼日利亚和美国持续扩大安全合作。穆萨还透露，尼日利亚正等待美国和意大利提供更多军用直升机，以增强其作战能力。谈及2027年大选筹备工作，国防部长表示，安全机构正在加强以情报为引领的行动，防止投票前、投票期间和投票结束后发生暴力事件。他说，当局还在监测武装组织使用Starlink卫星互联网服务、加密货币和商业无人机的情况，同时与美国当局合作，切断其融资网络。穆萨进一步透露，尼日利亚已与喀麦隆、尼日尔和乍得达成一项允许在5公里范围内跨境追捕的安排，使部队能够追入边境地区追捕恐怖分子和匪徒。该安排旨在限制武装团体利用边境漏洞逃脱安全行动。部长还警告称，伊斯兰国萨赫勒省正试图在尼日利亚西北部招募犯罪团伙，令人担忧的是，以牟利为主要动机的匪徒团体可能发展成由意识形态驱动、类似伊斯兰国西非省（ISWAP）的叛乱组织。据他介绍，武装分子和匪徒在发动袭击后，持续利用茂密森林以及与尼日尔和贝宁之间漏洞较多的边境躲避安全部队。不过，他说，改进后的监视手段增强了军方穿越困难地形追踪武装团体的能力，并限制了他们的行动自由。他说：“我们正在切断他们的后勤保障，并在尼日利亚境内将其消灭。”本文所表达的观点不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的意见

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.body: President Bola Tinubu has said eligible Nigerians can access mortgage loans of up to ₦100 million at a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent under the Federal Government’s ₦1 trillion MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund (MREIF). Tinubu, who disclosed this in a post on his X platform on Tuesday, said the initiative was designed to expand access to affordable, long-term housing finance and help more Nigerians become homeowners. He explained that beneficiaries could repay the loans over a period of up to 20 years, with an initial deposit of 10 per cent. Illustrating the arrangement, the President said a Nigerian seeking to purchase a house worth ₦10 million would need an initial deposit of ₦1 million and could repay approximately ₦85,400 monthly over 20 years. According to him, more than 2,300 Nigerians across 27 states have so far accessed ₦160 billion in mortgages through MREIF. Tinubu said the Federal Government had also strengthened the Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria (FMBN), through which eligible Nigerians could access housing loans of up to ₦50 million at six per cent interest, with repayment periods of up to 30 years. He added that contributors to pension schemes could qualify to use up to 25 per cent of their retirement savings towards the initial deposit, while married applicants could submit joint applications with their spouses to improve their chances of accessing higher loan amounts. The President also highlighted the role of the Family Homes Fund in providing affordable housing for Nigerians who cannot afford mortgage arrangements. He said the fund had delivered more than 53 social homes for vulnerable and underserved households. Tinubu further disclosed that the Renewed Hope Social Housing Programme was targeting 77,400 affordable homes across the country. According to him, 100 free homes had been delivered to widows in Kaduna, while another 50 were provided to wives of fallen military personnel in Ibadan. He added that more than 15,000 housing units were under construction nationwide through the Renewed Hope Cities and Estates Programme. The President stressed that access to the housing initiatives should be based on eligibility rather than political connections or religious affiliation. “You should not need to know a minister, a governor or anybody in the Presidential Villa to apply and benefit from these opportunities,” he said. Tinubu maintained that the programmes were open to Nigerians who met the stipulated requirements, irrespective of their location or beliefs. He said providing opportunities for hardworking Nigerians to own homes and secure their families’ future remained an important objective of his administration’s economic reforms. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.title_zh: 蒂努布：尼日利亚民众可享受利率为9.75%的1亿奈拉抵押贷款
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.body_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布表示，符合条件的尼日利亚人可以根据联邦政府规模达₦1万亿的MOFI房地产投资基金（MREIF），申请利率固定为9.75%的住房贷款，贷款金额最高可达₦1亿。蒂努布周二在X平台发帖透露了这项消息。他说，该计划旨在扩大人们获得可负担、长期住房融资的机会，并帮助更多尼日利亚人成为房主。他解释说，受益人可以在最长20年的期限内偿还贷款，首期付款为10%。总统举例说明这项安排称，一名准备购买价值₦1000万房产的尼日利亚人需先支付₦100万首付款，之后可在20年内每月偿还约₦85,400。他说，截至目前，尼日利亚27个州的2300多人已通过MREIF获得价值₦1600亿的住房贷款。蒂努布表示，联邦政府还加强了尼日利亚联邦抵押银行（FMBN），符合条件的尼日利亚人可通过该机构申请最高₦5000万的住房贷款，年利率为6%，还款期限最长可达30年。他补充说，养老金计划的参与者最多可使用退休储蓄的25%支付首付款，已婚申请人还可与配偶联合提交申请，以提高获得更高贷款金额的机会。总统还强调，Family Homes Fund在为无力承担抵押贷款安排的尼日利亚人提供可负担住房方面发挥着作用。他说，该基金已为弱势群体和服务不足的家庭交付了53套以上社会住房。蒂努布进一步透露，“新希望”社会住房计划正以在全国建设77,400套可负担住房为目标。他说，已向卡杜纳的寡妇交付100套免费住房，并向伊巴丹阵亡军人的妻子提供50套住房。他还补充称，全国各地正通过“新希望”城市与住宅区计划建设1.5万多套住房。总统强调，获得这些住房计划的机会应以资格条件为依据，而非政治关系或宗教信仰。他说：“申请并享受这些机会，不应要求你认识部长、州长或总统府里的任何人。”蒂努布坚持认为，只要符合规定要求，无论居住地点或信仰如何，尼日利亚人都可以使用这些计划。他说，为勤奋的尼日利亚人提供拥有住房、保障家庭未来的机会，仍是其政府经济改革的重要目标。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.title: Coopération Sino-africaine : Opportunités partagées, développement concerté
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.source: Le Sahel（尼日尔官方报·法语）
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.summary: Dans le cadre du séminaire bilatéral Chine-Niger, qui se tient du 10 au 30 novembre à Beijing, les fonctionnaires de l’information et les journalistes nigériens ont suivi, le jeudi 12 novembre, un exposé consacré à la coopération économique et commerciale sino-africaine portée par les institutions.
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.summary_zh: 在11月10日至30日于北京举行的中尼双边研讨会框架下，尼日尔新闻官员和记者于11月12日星期四听取了一场专题报告，介绍由相关机构推动的中非经济与贸易合作。
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.body: Dans le cadre du séminaire bilatéral Chine-Niger, qui se tient du 10 au 30 novembre à Beijing, les fonctionnaires de l’information et les journalistes nigériens ont suivi, le jeudi 12 novembre, un exposé consacré à la coopération économique et commerciale sino-africaine portée par les institutions. La présentation a été assurée par Mme Tian Yilin, chercheuse associée à l’Institut de recherche sur la sécurité du commerce et des investissements de l’Académie chinoise du commerce international et de la coopération économique. Dès l’entame de son exposé, la chercheuse chinoise a souligné le rôle central de cette coopération économique et commerciale, qu’elle a qualifiée de « Lest » qui stabilise le grand navire de la coopération sino-africaine. En effet, a expliqué Mme Tian Yilin, ce navire peut naviguer de manière stable et aller loin, malgré les aléas internationaux, non seulement grâce au soutien politique mutuel, mais surtout grâce à des liens économiques concrets : ports, chemins de fer, usines, plateformes de commerce électronique, emplois et moyens de subsistance. Les chiffres en donnent la mesure. La Chine est le premier partenaire commercial de l’Afrique depuis 17 années consécutives. En 2025, les échanges ont atteint 348,1 milliards de dollars, un record pour la cinquième année consécutive. Le stock des investissements directs chinois en Afrique s’élève à 43,4 milliards de dollars. Plus de 3 500 entreprises chinoises opèrent en Afrique. Pour la chercheuse Tian Yilin, le « Lest » joue quatre rôles à la fois : il stabilise la relation, il propulse l’industrialisation, il relie les intérêts des populations, et il rassure les entreprises en leur garantissant des règles stables et un marché ouvert. Autrement dit, ce ne sont pas les déclarations qui font durer la relation, mais des intérêts partagés et des règles prévisibles. Le FOCAC, précise la présentation, n’est pas une simple réunion, mais un mécanisme évaluable. En septembre 2024, le Sommet de Beijing a élevé les relations au niveau de communauté de destin sino-africaine à toute épreuve pour la nouvelle ère et lancé les « dix actions de partenariat », dont quatre servent directement la coopération économique : prospérité des échanges, coopération industrielle, connectivité, coopération au développement. En juin 2025, la Réunion des coordonnateurs à Changsha a annoncé l’exonération totale des droits de douane sur 100 % des lignes tarifaires pour les 53 pays africains ayant des relations diplomatiques avec la Chine. Elle a publié la Déclaration de Changsha et la liste de mise en œuvre des résultats du Sommet, chaque engagement ayant un responsable et un calendrier précis. La chaîne institutionnelle est ainsi complète. Le FOCAC pour la conception de haut niveau, la franchise de droits de douane pour l’accès au marché, la Voie verte 2.0 pour les règles opérationnelles, et le Partenariat économique pour le développement commun pour les règles durables. Chaque étape prépare la suivante. L’exonération des droits de douane est présentée comme un saut institutionnel, de 33 à 53 pays. Le 1er décembre 2024, elle s’appliquait aux pays les moins avancés ayant des relations diplomatiques avec la Chine, y compris 33 pays africains. À partir du 1er mai 2026, elle est appliquée aux 53 pays africains concernés. Couverture totale des pays, couverture totale des lignes tarifaires, sans quota, sans condition politique. Les effets sont déjà visibles. Au premier semestre 2026, les échanges sino-africains ont atteint 203,5 milliards de dollars, un record pour un premier semestre. La chercheuse en tire une conclusion : l’exonération n’est pas une concession ponctuelle, mais un canal d’ouverture de marché institutionnalisé. On passe d’une faveur qui peut se retirer à un droit qui s’applique. Au-delà des tarifs, la Voie verte 2.0 vise à fluidifier toute la chaîne. Le piment séché africain en a bénéficié en premier, suivi des noix de cajou, du café en grains et des produits aquatiques sauvages. À la douane de l’aéroport de Pudong à Shanghai, les produits frais par fret aérien sont passés de 7 à 14 jours à 2 à 3 jours de dédouanement. Pour les produits périssables, ce délai est déterminant. Car ouvrir un marché ne suffit pas si la marchandise se détériore avant d’y entrer. La chercheuse Tian Yilin insiste sur le passage des « préférences » aux « règles » : inscrire les avantages dans les accords. D’un côté, la Zone pilote de coopération économique et commerciale approfondie Chine-Afrique, qui produit des expériences institutionnelles reproductibles. De l’autre, l’Accord-cadre de partenariat économique pour le développement commun, signé avec 38 pays. En mars 2026, la Chine et le Kenya ont signé les résultats anticipés, le Kenya devenant le deuxième pays africain à conclure ce type de disposition, après le Congo-Brazzaville. Le message est ainsi clair. Ce qui est inscrit dans un accord devient prévisible. Et la prévisibilité, pour une entreprise, est déjà un investissement. Le cas du Niger : hausse de 28,4% des échanges avec la Chine en 2025 En 2025, les échanges Chine-Niger ont atteint 1,074 milliard de dollars, en hausse de 28,4 %. Le Niger vend à la Chine du pétrole brut et des graines oléagineuses. La Chine vend au Niger des machines et équipements, et des céréales. Le sésame illustre cette mise en œuvre. Le Niger est le premier fournisseur de sésame importé par la Chine, avec 31,6 kilotonnes en 2024, soit 26,7 % des importations de sésame africain de la Chine. En mai 2025, quelque 1 120 tonnes de sésame blanc ont été achetées directement par Chengdu Yimin International Trading, dont un premier lot de 246 tonnes arrivé à Qingdao. La franchise de droits supprime les coûts douaniers et offre des perspectives en aval : transformation du sésame, huile de sésame. Le cas du Niger concentre ainsi toute la logique de l’exposé : une règle qui ouvre, une chaîne qui fluidifie, et une opportunité qui peut devenir une valeur ajoutée locale. En définitive, la leçon de cet exposé est simple. La porte est ouverte, les règles sont écrites, les chiffres sont là. Il ne reste plus qu’à transformer cette ouverture en production, en transformation locale et en emplois. Car, le véritable enjeu n’est plus d’exporter vers la Chine, mais de bâtir, à partir de cette ouverture, un développement qui reste en Afrique
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.title_zh: 中非合作：共享机遇，协同发展
https://www.lesahel.org/cooperation-sino.body_zh: 在中尼双边研讨会框架内，研讨会于11月10日至30日在北京举行。11月12日星期四，尼日利亚新闻官员和记者听取了一场专题报告，介绍由相关机构推动的中非经济贸易合作。中国国际贸易经济合作研究院贸易与投资安全研究所副研究员田艺琳女士作了讲解。报告伊始，这位中国研究人员强调，经济贸易合作发挥着核心作用，她将其称为稳定中非合作巨轮的“压舱石”。田艺琳女士解释说，尽管国际局势存在变数，这艘船仍能稳健航行并驶向远方，不仅得益于双方的政治支持，更主要依靠具体的经济联系，包括港口、铁路、工厂、电子商务平台、就业机会和谋生手段。数据充分印证了这一点。中国已连续17年成为非洲第一大贸易伙伴。2025年，中非贸易额达到3481亿美元，连续第五年创下纪录。中国对非洲直接投资存量达到434亿美元。超过3500家中国企业在非洲开展业务。田艺琳研究员认为，“压舱石”同时发挥四项作用：稳定双边关系，推动工业化，连接各国人民的利益，并通过提供稳定的规则和开放的市场让企业安心。换言之，维持双边关系靠的不是各项声明，而是共同利益和可预期的规则。报告指出，中非合作论坛大会并非一次普通会议，而是一套可评估的机制。2024年9月，北京峰会将中非关系提升为新时代全天候中非命运共同体，并启动“十项行动计划”，其中四项直接服务于经济合作：贸易繁荣、产业合作、互联互通、发展合作。2025年6月，长沙协调员会议宣布，对同中国建交的53个非洲国家100%的税目全面免除关税。会议发布《长沙宣言》和峰会成果落实清单，每项承诺均明确责任人和具体时间表。由此，制度链条已形成闭环：中非合作论坛大会负责顶层设计，关税减免保障市场准入，绿色之路2.0负责运行规则，共建发展经济伙伴关系负责长效规则。每个环节都为下一环节作准备。关税减免被视为一次制度性跃升，覆盖范围从33国扩大到53国。2024年12月1日起，该政策适用于同中国建交的最不发达国家，其中包括33个非洲国家。自2026年5月1日起，政策将适用于相关的53个非洲国家，实现国家全面覆盖、税目全面覆盖，不设配额，不附政治条件。其成效已经显现。2026年上半年，中非贸易额达到2035亿美元，创上半年历史新高。该研究人员由此得出结论：关税减免并非一次性让步，而是制度化的市场开放渠道，双边关系正从可能撤销的优惠转变为普遍适用的权利。除关税之外，绿色之路2.0旨在打通整个产业链。非洲干辣椒率先受益，随后是腰果、咖啡豆和野生水产品。在上海浦东机场海关，空运生鲜货物的通关时间从7至14天缩短至2至3天。对易腐产品而言，这一时间至关重要，因为如果商品在进入市场前已经变质，开放市场也没有意义。田艺琳研究员强调，要从“优惠”转向“规则”，把各项利益写入协议。一端是中非深化经贸合作试验区，形成可复制的制度经验；另一端是与38个国家签署的《共建发展经济伙伴关系框架协定》。2026年3月，中国与肯尼亚签署预期成果，肯尼亚继刚果（布）之后成为第二个达成此类安排的非洲国家。由此传递的信息十分明确：写入协议的内容将具有可预期性，而对企业而言，可预期性本身就是一种投资。尼日尔案例：2025年对华贸易增长28.4%。2025年，中尼贸易额达到10.74亿美元，同比增长28.4%。尼日尔向中国出口原油和油籽，中国向尼日尔出口机械设备和谷物。芝麻便是这一机制落实的例证。2024年，尼日尔以31.6千吨成为中国进口芝麻的第一大供应国，占中国从非洲进口芝麻总量的26.7%。2025年5月，成都亿民国际贸易直接采购了约1120吨白芝麻，其中首批246吨已运抵青岛。关税减免消除了关税成本，并为芝麻加工、芝麻油等下游产业带来前景。尼日尔案例集中体现了整场报告的逻辑：一项规则打开市场，一条产业链疏通流通，一个机会则可能转化为本地附加值。归根结底，这场报告传递的教训很简单。大门已经打开，规则已经写明，数据已经摆在眼前。剩下的就是把开放转化为生产、本地加工和就业，因为真正的关键已不再是向中国出口，而是借助这一开放成果，在非洲建设持久的发展模式

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.summary_zh: 时间、范围和方法尚待确定。鉴于《纽约时报》本月早些时候刊登有关青少年偶像歌手工作环境的文章后，社会对相关工作条件的担忧日益加剧，韩国文化、体育和旅游部周二表示，明年将调查未成年艺人的基本权利得到了多大程度的保护。《纽约时报》的这篇5篇报道发现，女子团体NewJeans在成员仍未成年时签订的合同遗漏了针对未成年表演者的关键保障条款。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Timing, scope, methods yet to be decided As concerns grow over the working conditions of teenage K-pop idols after an article on the topic in the New York Times early this month, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said Tuesday that it will look into how well the basic rights of underage entertainers are protected next year. The move comes amid mounting scrutiny of the industry following a Nov. 5 report by The New York Times, which found that the contract girl group NewJeans signed as minors omitted key protections for underage performers. “We plan to conduct a fact-finding survey on the status of underage entertainers in 2027, but its timing, scope and methods have yet to be decided,” Choi Hye-ji, a public relations officer at the ministry, told The Korea Times. The official, however, drew a line between the survey and the controversy, saying that the decision to take the measure was not triggered by the news report alone. The newspaper obtained the exclusive contract the five NewJeans members signed in 2022 with Ador, a label under HYBE, when they were between 14 and 17. According to the report, the contract left out provisions from the government’s standard contract that protect minors’ physical and mental health, education, sleep and rest. The report also cited accounts that the members often practiced until 2 a.m. as trainees, and said four of the five had dropped out of school. HYBE rebutted the report, saying the contract was lawfully concluded and that the members’ rights were sufficiently protected through a supplementary agreement for minors. NewJeans debuted in 2022 to massive success, but became embroiled in a dispute with HYBE after the ouster of subsidiary Ador’s then-CEO Min Hee-jin in 2024. After a court upheld the validity of their contract, four of the members returned to the agency, though the group has yet to resume activities. Under the Popular Culture and Arts Industry Development Act, agencies signing contracts with minors must include measures guaranteeing their health, education, sleep and rest. In principle, minors are barred from working between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. The law’s protections cover a growing number of idols who debut in their early teens, such as the members of rookie girl group A2O LITE, whose average age is just under 15
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: 继《纽约时报》报道NewJeans后，文化部将于明年调查未成年偶像的权利保障情况
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh: 时间、范围和方法尚待确定。继《纽约时报》本月早些时候刊登一篇关于青少年K-pop偶像工作环境的文章、相关担忧日益升温后，韩国文化、体育和旅游部周二表示，将于明年调查未成年艺人的基本权利是否得到充分保护。此前，《纽约时报》11月5日发布的一份报道令该行业承受的审视日益增加。报道发现，女子组合NewJeans成员签约时尚未成年，所签合同遗漏了保护未成年艺人的关键条款。该部公共关系官员崔慧智告诉《韩国时报》：“我们计划于2027年对未成年艺人现状开展实情调查，但调查的时间、范围和方法尚未确定。”不过，这名官员将调查与争议区别开来，称决定采取这一措施并非仅由这篇新闻报道促成。《纽约时报》获得了NewJeans五名成员于2022年以14至17岁之龄与HYBE旗下厂牌Ador签订的独家合同。根据报道，该合同省略了政府标准合同中保护未成年人身心健康、教育、睡眠和休息的条款。报道还援引说法称，这些成员作为练习生时经常练习至凌晨2点，并表示五名成员中有四人已经辍学。HYBE反驳了这份报道，称合同是依法签订的，成员通过未成年人补充协议已获得充分的权利保障。NewJeans于2022年出道并取得巨大成功，但在2024年旗下子公司Ador时任首席执行官闵慧真被免职后，组合陷入与HYBE的纠纷。法院维持其合同效力后，四名成员已返回经纪公司，但该组合尚未恢复活动。根据《大众文化艺术产业发展法》，与未成年人签订合同的经纪公司必须纳入保障其健康、教育、睡眠和休息的措施。原则上，未成年人不得在晚上10点至早上6点期间工作。这项法律的保护涵盖越来越多的十几岁初期出道的偶像，例如新晋女子组合A2O LITE的成员，该组合平均年龄略低于15岁

Unlock these with Subscription P rime Minister Narendra Modi is set to participate in the 23rd ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations)-India summit and the 21st East Asia summit on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) in Manila. Philippines is hosting the summits in its capacity as the current chair of the 11-nation ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations). In a pre-departure statement, PM Modi said India’s relationship with the ASEAN region is at the “heart of India’s Act East Policy”. PM Modi is also expected to meet U.S. President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at the first Quad Summit since 2024 in Manila , on the sidelines of ASEAN summits today (November 17, 2026), sources in New Delhi had confirmed to The Hindu . The meeting would probably take place after Mr. Trump lands in Manila. The confirmation of the Quad Summit in Manila is significant for the Indo-Pacific grouping, and plans to chart out their next course. Mr. Modi is also scheduled to perform a ground-breaking ceremony for a gurdwara in Manila on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and also interact with members of the Indian community in the Filipino capital, he said on social media. U.S. President Donald Trump is scheduled to arrive in China on Wednesday, for an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, following his meeting with the Quad leaders today. This Quad alliance is heavily criticised by China, given that one of its purposes is to support Indo-Pacific nations in strengthening their sovereignty and simultaneously constrain China’s attempts to undermine that capacity-building. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to attend the Quad leaders’ meeting, the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit during his ongoing visit to the Philippines, External Affairs Ministry (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said on Tuesday. This marks the first in-person, leaders-level Quad gathering since September 2024 in Delaware, as well as the first since Donald Trump returned to the White House. U.S. President Donald Trump flies into the Philippines on Tuesday at the tail end of a Southeast Asian summit. There could be protests in Manila against Mr. Trump’s visit, after days of demonstrations that have included the burning of effigies of the President and calls for an end to the West Asia war and the scrapping of the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday visited the oldest gurudwara in the Philippines and led the foundation stone-laying ceremony for its redevelopment. “The Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara has stood as a testament to the vibrant India-Philippines cultural and people-to-people ties for over a century,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said in a social media post. “ASEAN Leaders and their counterparts from ASEAN’s External Partners convene today in Manila, the Philippines, for the final day of the 49th ASEAN Summit,” ASEAN’s X page said. “The meetings provide an opportunity to review progress in regional cooperation, exchange views on regional and international developments, and advance partnerships across ASEAN-led mechanisms,” it added. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body_zh: 订阅可享受高级新闻、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅 Prime 即可解锁。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪定于周二（2026年11月17日）在马尼拉参加第23届东盟（东南亚国家联盟）—印度峰会以及第21届东亚峰会。菲律宾以现任11国东盟（东南亚国家联盟）轮值主席国身份主办这些峰会。莫迪总理在出发前发表声明称，印度与东盟地区的关系处于“印度‘东向政策’的核心”。新德里的消息人士向《印度教徒报》证实，莫迪总理预计还将在今天（2026年11月17日）于马尼拉举行的东盟峰会期间，与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、日本首相高市早苗和澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯会面，这是2024年以来首次举行的四方安全对话峰会。此次会面可能在特朗普先生抵达马尼拉后举行。四方安全对话峰会在马尼拉得到确认，对印太集团而言意义重大，各方还计划勾勒下一步行动方向。莫迪总理还在社交媒体上表示，他定于周二（2026年11月17日）为马尼拉的一座古尔瓦拉举行奠基仪式，并与菲律宾首都的印度社群成员交流。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普定于周三抵达中国，参加亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，此前他今天刚与四方安全对话领导人会面。中国严厉批评这一四方联盟，因为其目的之一是支持印太国家加强主权，同时制约中国削弱这些国家能力建设的企图。印度外交部（MEA）发言人兰比尔·贾伊思瓦尔周二表示，莫迪总理正在访问菲律宾期间，计划出席四方安全对话领导人会议、第23届东盟—印度峰会和第21届东亚峰会。这是自2024年9月在特拉华举行以来首次举行的四方安全对话领导人面对面会议，也是唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫后的首次。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二飞抵菲律宾，参加东南亚峰会的收官活动。菲律宾已经连续数日举行示威活动，期间有人焚烧总统的模拟像，并呼吁结束西亚战争、废除美国主导的“Pax Silica”倡议，因此马尼拉可能出现抗议特朗普先生访菲的活动。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周二参观了菲律宾最古老的古尔瓦拉，并主持了其重建工程的奠基仪式。印度外交部（MEA）在社交媒体帖子中表示：“Khalsa Diwan古尔瓦拉一个多世纪以来一直是印度—菲律宾文化联系和民间友谊蓬勃发展的见证。”东盟的X页面写道：“东盟领导人及其来自东盟外部伙伴的对应官员今天在菲律宾马尼拉齐聚一堂，举行第49届东盟峰会的最后一天。”该页面补充道：“这些会议为各方审查区域合作进展、就地区和国际局势交换意见，以及推动东盟各项机制下的伙伴关系提供了机会。”评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性或针对个人的内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《印度教徒报》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章讨论。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录账户后可以在Vuukle上查看过去的评论

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea will suspend aircraft takeoffs nationwide for 35 minutes Thursday as students sit for the English listening section of the annual college entrance exam, with 130 flights facing schedule changes. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said Tuesday that aircraft will be prohibited from taking off between 1:05 p.m. to 1:40 p.m., when the listening test for the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) will be administered. The measure is intended to eliminate aircraft noise that could interfere with students' concentration during one of the exam's most closely monitored sections. Aircraft already in the air will be required to remain at least 3 kilometers above ground during the restricted period. Emergency and other urgent flights will be exempt. Restrictions will also apply to helicopters, light aircraft and drones. The ministry said 130 flights, including 81 international and 49 domestic flights, would have their departure or arrival times adjusted to accommodate the temporary restrictions. Airlines will notify passengers of the revised schedule in advance to minimize disruption. The entire country will be designated a no-fly zone for drones during the 35-minute period, regardless of whether operators have previously received flight approval. Those who violate the restrictions could face criminal penalties, according to the ministry. The Korea Transportation Safety Authority plans to send text messages to licensed drone operators and individuals who have already obtained flight permits, warning them that all drone operations will be prohibited during the designated period. The restriction will also be announced through the Drone One-Stop civil service portal. The ministry said it would coordinate with air traffic control agencies, Korea Airports Corp., Incheon International Airport Corp. and airlines to ensure the restrictions are implemented smoothly. “We will thoroughly implement necessary measures, including aircraft operation restrictions, so that students can concentrate on their English listening test in a stable environment,” said Jeong Chae-gyo, director general of the ministry's aviation policy office. He also urged airlines and related agencies to cooperate with schedule adjustments and advance notifications, and asked passengers to check revised departure and arrival times before traveling. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国将于周四全国暂停飞机起飞35分钟，届时考生将参加年度大学入学考试英语听力科目考试，130架航班将面临时刻调整。国土交通部周二表示，在下午1:05至1:40期间，将禁止飞机起飞，届时将进行2027年大学修业能力试验（CSAT）听力测试。此举旨在消除飞机噪声，避免其干扰考生在最受严格监考科目之一中的注意力。受限时段内，已经升空的飞机必须保持在距地面至少3公里的高度。紧急及其他紧急航班将获豁免。限制措施还将适用于直升机、轻型飞机和无人机。该部表示，包括81个国际航班和49个国内航班在内的130个航班，将调整出发或抵达时间，以配合临时限制。航空公司将提前通知乘客调整后的航班时刻，尽量减少干扰。在这35分钟期间，全国将被划定为无人机禁飞区，无论运营者此前是否已获得飞行批准。该部称，违反限制规定者可能面临刑事处罚。韩国交通安全 Authority计划向持证无人机运营者及已取得飞行许可的个人发送短信，警告他们在指定时段内禁止一切无人机活动。限制措施还将通过“无人机一站式”政务门户公布。该部表示，将与空中交通管制机构、韩国机场公社、仁川国际机场公社及航空公司协调，确保限制措施顺利实施。国土交通部航空政策室总负责人郑宰教说：“我们将全面落实包括限制飞机运行在内的必要措施，使考生能够在稳定的环境中集中精力参加英语听力考试。”他还敦促航空公司及相关机构配合调整航班时刻并提前通知乘客，同时提醒旅客出行前查看调整后的出发和抵达时间。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A former Seoul city councilor filed a complaint against Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin on Tuesday, accusing him of dereliction of duty after the minister said it would be difficult to catch all forms of cheating using artificial intelligence (AI). Lee Jong-bae, a former Seoul city council member from the main opposition People Power Party, said he submitted the complaint to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency over the remarks Choi made during a plenary session of the National Assembly's education committee the previous day when questioned about AI-assisted cheating. The move came amid heightened public anxiety over such misconduct ahead of Thursday's College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), an annual national college entrance exam, known as Suneung in Korean. Recent high-profile incidents involving AI cheating, including a case where the top scorer on this year's certified tax accountant exam has admitted to have cheated using a miniature camera, have sparked widespread concerns. "Minister Choi consciously abandoned his duty by failing to implement effective countermeasures, such as postponing the Suneung, despite recognizing the limitations of the existing monitoring system," Lee argued. Lee called on police to thoroughly investigate and strictly punish the minister, arguing the government has the means to prevent AI-assisted cheating, including installing radio detectors in test rooms

'움직이는 요새'로 불리는 전용 특별열차를 이용했고, 같은 해 5월에는 전용기 '참매 1호'를 타고 중국 동북 지역 랴오닝성 다롄(大連)을 방문(1박2일)했다. 이어 한 달 뒤인 2018년 6월 베이징 방문(1박2일)에도 '참매 1호'로 하늘길을 택했고, 2019년 1월 베이징 방문(3박4일) 당시에는 특별열차로 육로 이동을 했다. 하노이 북미 회담 결렬과 코로나19 대유행, 북한의 국경 봉쇄 등으로 중단됐던 김 위원장의 방중은 작년 9월 중국의 전승절 열병식을 계기로 재개됐다. 김 위원장은 역대 최장기간인 작년 베이징 방문(4박5일) 때 특별열차를 탔고, 지난달 중국 랴오닝성 단둥(丹東)을 '당일치기'로 찾았을 때는 신의주까지 특별열차로 이동한 뒤 자동차로 북중 국경을 넘은 것으로 추정된다. 중국 동북 지역과 베이징 방문 때 전용기를 한 차례씩 이용한 것을 빼면 특별열차를 탄 사례가 더 많은 셈이다. 2019년 2월 북미 정상이 베트남 하노이에서 만났을 때는 평양부터 베트남 동당까지 66시간 동안 3천800㎞ 거리를 전용열차로 이동하며 중국 대륙 3천500㎞를 종단하기도 했을 정도로 그는 장거리 이동에 열차를 자주 활용해왔다. 외교가에서는 중국 내 북미 정상회담이 실제로 성사될 경우 18∼19일 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의가 열리는 남부 광둥성 선전(深圳)이나 수도 베이징(北京), 단둥 등 북중 국경 지역이 개최 장소로 거론된다. 세계 주요국 정상이 집결한 데다 미중러 정상회담이라는 대형 이벤트까지 예고된 선전에 북한 지도자까지 당도한다면 이번 APEC 개최국인 중국으로서는 국제정치적 영향력을 확고히 다질 계기가 될 가능성이 있다. 중국이 '세계 질서의 수호자'나 '국제 분쟁의 중재자'를 자임해온 만큼 김 위원장이 방중을 결정한다면 전폭적인 지원에 나설 수 있다는 시각도 있다. 트럼프 대통령은 18일 선전에 도착해 APEC 정상회의와 미중러 정상회담 등 일정을 소화한 뒤 19일 미국 워싱턴DC로 복귀할 예정이어서, 트럼프 대통령이 16일(현지시간·한국시간 17일 새벽) 갑작스럽게 제안한 북미 정상회담은 예정된 일정을 따른다면 물리적으로 시간에 쫓긴다. 단둥에서 선전은 열차로 이동할 경우 3천300여㎞를 달려야한다. 2019년 특별열차로 중국을 종단했던 당시 상황을 감안하면 중국 내에서만 60시간 가까이 걸릴 것으로 보인다. 이 때문에 만약 김 위원장이 육로 이동을 택할 경우 북한 전용열차보다 중국 고속열차에 탑승하는 것이 현실적인 대안이 될 수 있다는 분석이 제기된다. 김 위원장이 평양에서 특별열차로 신의주까지 간 뒤 단둥에서 중국 고속열차로 갈아탄다면 중국 내 소요시간은 11∼12시간 안팎이 될 것으로 추정된다. 중국은 또 럼 베트남공산당 서기장이 올해 4월 방중했을 때 2천400㎞ 거리의 베이징-난닝(南寧) 간 10시간 15분 이동에 고속열차 '푸싱(復興)호' 전세편을 제공한 바 있다. 중국 관영매체들은 이를 외국 고위 인사의 중국 고속철도 이용 신기록이라며 대대적으로 홍보하기도 했다. 김 위원장이 항공편을 이용한다면 평양에서 선전까지 2천100여㎞를 직행으로 날아가는 방법과 평양에서 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 가는 2천700여㎞의 여정 등이 선택지가 된다. 평양에서 선전까지 전용기 '참매 1호'를 이용할 수도 있으나, 2018년 싱가포르 북미 정상회담 때처럼 중국이 자국 고위급 전용기인 중국국제항공 소속 보잉 747기를 제공한 적 있어 중국 항공기를 이용할 수 있다는 전망도 제기된다. 그간의 방중 사례를 본다면, 김 위원장이 전용열차편으로 평양에서 베이징까지 이동하는 데는 모두 1천300여㎞(단둥-베이징 1천103㎞)에 20시간 이상이 든다. 김 위원장의 전용열차는 방탄 기능과 무장을 탑재했고 집무실 기능까지 갖춰 일반열차보다 무겁고 느리지만, 베이징까지 운행해본 경험이 이미 있는 만큼 이동에 무리는 없다는 평가가 나온다. 북미 회담이 베이징에서 열린다면 트럼프 대통령은 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 함께 선전에서 베이징으로 이동할 전망이다. 베이징은 북미 정상이 모두 방문한 적 있고 주변 통제가 중국 다른 지역보다 더욱 용이해 '세기의 회담' 개최지로 적합할 수 있다는 관측도 나온다. 랴오닝성 다롄은 김정은 위원장의 조부인 김일성 주석과 부친인 김정일 국방위원장도 찾은 적 있는 북중 역사에서 상징성 있는 도시다. 김정은 위원장도 2018년 2차 방중 때 선대 지도자들처럼 방추이다오(棒槌島)에서 하루를 묵었다. 트럼프 대통령의 북미 회담 제안이 갑작스러운 면이 있었으나 김 위원장으로서는 당일치기 방문이 가능한 지역인 만큼 단둥 회담 가능성도 빼놓을 수 없다는 시각도 있다. 다만 트럼프 대통령의 언급 이후 북한의 반응이 나오지 않았고, 김 위원장이 육로로 이동할 경우 거칠 가능성이 큰 단둥 등 접경 지역에서는 중국의 통제 강화 같은 동향이 아직 감지되지 않고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 한 대북 소식통은 17일 연합뉴스에 "단둥 등 접경지는 현재 평상시와 비슷한 상황이지만, 중국은 김 위원장의 방중에 필요한 절차를 여러 번 겪어봤기 때문에 통제가 언제든 빠르게 이뤄질 수 있다"고 설명했다. 한편, 한국 외교당국은 미중러 정상회담을 앞두고 13∼14일 베이징에서 열린 한중 외교장관 회담 등을 통해 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정한다거나 한반도 평화체제 구축에 반하는 결정이 나와서는 안 된다는 뜻을 중국에 전한 바 있다. 외교 소식통은 이날 "트럼프 대통령의 북미 회담 언급 이후 각지의 육로·항공로 동향을 면밀히 살피고 있다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/17 14:46 송고 2026년11월17일 14시46분 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111710.title_zh: 金正恩与特朗普会晤能否实现……双方讨论宣传、访华及东北接壤地区等议题
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111710.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）郑成浩 特派记者＝唐纳德·特朗普美国总统突然明确表示有意在北京会见朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩，朝鲜最高统帅访华的可能性及访问方式因此受到关注。金正恩首次访华是在2018年3月对北京进行国事访问（停留3晚4天）期间，当时他乘坐了被称为“移动堡垒”的专用特别列车。同年5月，他又乘坐专机“苍迈1号”访问了中国东北辽宁省大连（停留1晚2天）。一个月后的2018年6月访问北京（停留1晚2天）时，他同样乘坐“苍迈1号”走航空路线；2019年1月访问北京（停留3晚4天）时，则乘坐特别列车经陆路出行。金正恩访华曾因河内朝美首脑会谈破裂、新冠疫情大流行以及朝鲜封锁国境等原因中断，直到去年9月借中国举行国庆阅兵之机才恢复。他去年访问北京（停留4晚5天）时乘坐了创历代停留时间最长纪录的特别列车；上个月到访中国辽宁省丹东（停留当天往返）时，据推定先乘特别列车抵达新义州，随后乘车越过中朝边境。除访问中国东北地区和北京时各使用过一次专机外，他乘坐特别列车的次数更多。2019年2月，朝美领导人在越南河内举行会谈时，他从平壤到越南同登乘坐特别列车，历时66小时、行驶3800公里，横穿中国大陆3500公里，可见他经常利用火车进行长距离出行。外交界消息人士称，如果朝美首脑会谈确实在中国举行，举办地可能选在亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议召开地广东省深圳、首都北京以及丹东等中朝边境地区。在各国主要领导人齐聚一堂、且预告将举行美中俄领导人会谈这一大型活动之际，若朝鲜领导人也赴深圳，作为本次APEC举办国，中国可能借机进一步巩固国际政治影响力。由于中国一直以“世界秩序维护者”或“国际争端调解者”自居，也有观点认为，如果金正恩决定访华，中国可能会提供全面支持。特朗普总统预计于18日抵达深圳，完成APEC领导人会议、美中俄领导人会谈等活动后，于19日返回美国华盛顿特区。因此，特朗普总统16日（当地时间，韩国时间17日凌晨）突然提出的朝美首脑会谈，若按既定日程安排，在时间上较为紧迫。从丹东乘火车前往深圳需要行驶约3300公里。考虑到他2019年曾乘特别列车横穿中国，当时仅在中国境内就用了近60小时。正因如此，有分析认为，如果金正恩选择陆路出行，乘坐中国高速列车可能比乘坐朝鲜专用列车更为现实。若金正恩从平壤乘特别列车抵达新义州，再于丹东换乘中国高速列车，预计其在中国境内的行程约为11至12小时。中国此前还曾在越共中央总书记今年4月访华时，为其提供高速列车“复兴号”全车厢包乘服务，用于北京至南宁（相距2400公里）的10小时15分行程。中国官方媒体还大肆宣传此事，称其开创了外国高级官员乘坐中国高速铁路的纪录。若金正恩选择乘坐飞机，可选择从平壤直飞深圳，航程约2100公里，或经北京前往深圳，行程约2700公里。他也可以从平壤乘坐专机“苍迈1号”前往深圳；不过，由于2018年新加坡朝美首脑会谈时，中国曾派出本国高级领导人专用飞机——中国国际航空公司的波音747飞机，因此也有望乘坐中国航空公司的飞机。从历次访华情况看，金正恩乘专列从平壤前往北京均需20多个小时，路程约1300多公里（丹东至北京为1103公里）。金正恩的专用列车具备防弹和武装功能，还设有办公室，重量和速度均不及普通列车；但鉴于它已有开往北京的经验，外界评价认为出行不成问题。如果朝美会谈在北京举行，预计特朗普总统将与习近平主席一道从深圳前往北京。由于北京此前曾接待朝美两国领导人，且周边安保管控比其他中国地区更为便利，因此也有观点认为，北京适合作为“强硬会谈”的举办地。辽宁省大连也是金正恩的外祖父、已故国家主席金日成以及岳父、已故国防委员会 chairman 金正日曾到访的城市，在中朝历史上具有象征意义。2018年金正恩第二次访华时，也曾像历代领导人一样，在棒槌岛停留一天。尽管特朗普总统提出举行朝美会谈来得突然，但由于丹东是可以当天往返的地区，因此也不能排除在丹东举行会谈的可能性。不过，在特朗普总统提及此事后，朝鲜尚未作出回应；据报道，如果金正恩选择陆路出行，在丹东等接壤地区，中国尚未表现出加强管控等动向。一位朝鲜消息人士17日向韩联社表示：“丹东等接壤地区目前状况与平时相近，但中国多次经历接待金正恩委员长访华所需的程序，因此随时都可能迅速实施管控。”另一方面，韩国外交当局通过13日至14日在北京举行的韩中外长会谈等会议，转达了中方不应作出承认朝鲜为核武器持有国或作出有违半岛和平机制建设决定的意思。一位外交消息人士当天表示：“特朗普总统提及朝美会谈后，我们正在密切审视各地的陆路、航空路线动向。”报道附注：禁止利用KakaoTalk账号“okjebo”复制内容。版权所有(c) https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano.body: KANO — Kano State government and the Kwankwasiyyah Movement were, yesterday, locked in a verbal war over alleged attack on the convoy of the vice presidential candidate of Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, in the state, weekend. NDC governorship candidate in Kano, Aminu Gwarzo, had alleged that during a campaign visit to Bichi on Sunday, the convoy of the vice presidential candidate of the party was attacked by thugs allegedly sent by the state government. The spokesperson for Gwarzo’s campaign, Ibrahim Shu’aibu, said the team had earlier visited Tofa, Rimingado, Kabo, Gwarzo, Shanono and Bagwai local government areas without disruption before proceeding to Bichi where they were attcked. But reacting to the attack, yesterday, the Commissioner for Information in Kano State, Sanusi Tofa, dismissed the fact that there was an attack on the convoy of Kwankwaso in Bichi Local Government Area, describing the incident as fictitious. Replying the state government, the Kwankwasiyya Movement said Kano State belonged to all residents, regardless of their political affiliations. The movement said the government had a responsibility to protect everyone in the state and should not allow political differences to affect the safety and rights of citizens. In a statement by its spokesperson, Dr Habibu Mohammed, yesterday, the movement also criticised the state government for dismissing the incident as fictitious and accusing the Kwankwasiyya Movement of making up the allegation to gain public sympathy. The statement specifically faulted the Commissioner for Information, Sanusi Tofa, for demanding pictures and videos of the incident, rather than allowing security agencies to investigate the matter. It questioned why victims should be expected to provide evidence before the government could show concern over their safety. “Kano belongs to all its people, not exclusively to those occupying government offices. Its security, peace and democratic freedoms are collective responsibilities that must never be sacrificed on the altar of partisan politics,” the statement said. The movement argued that the responsibility for investigating allegations of criminal activities rested with security agencies, not the victims, accusing the commissioner of making premature conclusions without presenting the findings of any police investigation. The group called on Kano State police command to investigate the incident, establish what happened in Bichi and ensure that anyone found responsible was brought to justice. It further demanded an investigation into the reported destruction of vehicles and injuries sustained by members of Kwankwaso’s delegation. The movement urged Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf to rise above political considerations and guarantee the safety of all political parties, candidates, campaign officials and supporters across the state. It also warned against political intimidation, insisting that opposition members should be allowed to participate in lawful political activities without fear of harassment or violence. “Political competition is not warfare, and opposition politics is not a criminal offence,” the statement added. The Kwankwasiyya Movement said it would remain committed to peaceful political participation but warned that its commitment to peace should not be mistaken for acceptance of intimidation or impunity. The presidential candidate of the party, Peter Obi, in a post on his X handle yesterday, condemned the attack, describing Kwankwaso as his brother and running mate, expressing sadness over the incident. He said: “I am deeply saddened by reports of the attack on the convoy of my brother and running mate, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, and members of his entourage in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State. “I strongly condemn this unfortunate incident. Reports indicate that several members of the entourage sustained injuries, while about seven vehicles were vandalised. This is unacceptable and must not be allowed to become part of our political culture.” Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano.title_zh: 卡诺州政府与夸恩夸西耶运动因针对夸恩夸索车队的袭击发生冲突
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/kano.body_zh: 卡诺——卡诺州政府和Kwankwasiyyah Movement昨日就据称发生在尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）副总统候选人拉比乌·穆萨·坎克瓦索车队身上的袭击展开口水战。事件据称发生于周末，地点在该州境内。NDC在卡诺的州长候选人阿米努·瓜尔佐指称，该党副总统候选人于周日赴比奇竞选访问时，其车队遭到据称由州政府派来的打手袭击。瓜尔佐竞选团队发言人易卜拉欣·舒阿伊布说，团队此前走访了托法、里明加多、卡博、瓜尔佐、沙诺诺和巴格怀等地方政府辖区，未受干扰，随后前往比奇并在那里遭到袭击。然而，面对这起袭击，尼日利亚卡诺州信息专员萨努西·托法昨日否认坎克瓦索车队在比奇地方政府辖区遭到袭击，称这起事件是虚构的。Kwankwasiyya Movement回应卡诺州政府称，卡诺州属于所有居民，无论其政治立场如何。该运动表示，政府有责任保护州内每个人，不应让政治分歧影响公民的安全和权利。该运动发言人哈比布·穆罕默德博士昨日发表声明，批评州政府将这起事件斥为虚构，并指责Kwankwasiyya Movement编造袭击指控以博取公众同情。声明特别指出，信息专员萨努西·托法要求提供事件照片和视频，而不是让安全机构调查此事。声明质疑，政府为何要等受害者提供证据后才会表现出对受害者安全的关注。声明称：“卡诺属于全体人民，而非仅仅属于占据政府职位的人。州内的安全、和平和民主自由是集体责任，绝不能为了党派政治而牺牲。”该运动认为，调查涉嫌犯罪活动的责任在于安全机构，而非受害者；它指责该专员在未公布警方调查结果的情况下过早作出结论。该团体呼吁卡诺州警察指挥部调查此事，查明比奇发生了什么，并确保任何被认定负有责任的人都被绳之以法。该运动还要求调查有关车辆被毁以及坎克瓦索代表团成员受伤的报道。该运动敦促州长阿巴·卡比尔·优素福超越政治考量，保障全州所有政党、候选人、竞选工作人员和支持者的安全。该运动还警告不要进行政治恐吓，坚持应允许反对派成员在不惧骚扰或暴力的情况下参加合法政治活动。声明补充道：“政治竞争不是战争，反对派政治也不是刑事犯罪。”Kwankwasiyya Movement表示，将继续致力于以和平方式参与政治，但警告外界不应将其对和平的承诺误解为接受恐吓或逍遥法外。该党总统候选人彼得·奥比昨日在其X账号发文谴责这起袭击，称坎克瓦索是自己的兄弟和竞选搭档，并表示对此事深感痛心。他说：“我对我兄弟和竞选搭档、参议员拉比乌·穆萨·坎克瓦索的车队及其随行人员据称在卡诺州比奇地方政府辖区遭到袭击的消息深感悲痛。“我强烈谴责这起不幸事件。报道显示，随行人员中有数人受伤，约七辆车遭破坏。这种情况不可接受，绝不能成为我们政治文化的一部分。”此处发表的评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/oti-regional.body: John Kwadwo Gyapong, Oti Regional Minister, has highlighted development projects being undertaken by the John Dramani Mahama-led government in the region, urging residents to acknowledge efforts to improve infrastructure and social services. He mentioned road projects under the government’s Big Push initiative, including the Dodo-Pepesu-Nkwanta, Nkwanta-Kpassa, Nkwanta-Dambai and Okadjakrom-Kwamekrom roads, describing them as significant interventions expected to improve transportation, connectivity and economic activities across the region. Mr Gyapong made these remarks during a media engagement on the sidelines of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) Oti Regional Executive Elections held at the Bueman Senior High School (BUSEC) in Jasikan on November 14. He also cited the proposed university at Jasikan, the Oti Regional Hospital project, the establishment of 24-Hour Economy Markets across the region, the proposed airport at Dambai and the Dambai Bridge project as other major development initiatives. He said the President was expected to cut the sod for the Oti Regional Hospital project soon, expressing optimism that its construction would improve access to healthcare services and reduce the challenges residents faced in seeking specialised medical attention. The Regional Minister said the projects demonstrated the government’s commitment to fulfilling its development promises, adding that the people of the region had reasons to appreciate the interventions. According to him, the government had moved beyond promises to implementing projects that would address critical infrastructure and development needs in the region. He further disclosed that several other interventions, including the construction of school blocks, Community-based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) compounds and water supply facilities, were being undertaken across the region’s nine districts. Mr Gyapong therefore challenged journalists to visit the various communities to independently assess the projects and report on their implementation and impact on residents. He said media practitioners had an important responsibility to provide accurate information on development initiatives and their benefits to the people. He urged the media to give adequate attention to ongoing development projects in the region to enable residents to appreciate the interventions and hold relevant authorities accountable for their implementation
https://www.myjoyonline.com/oti-regional.title_zh: 奥蒂地区部长介绍政府发展项目
https://www.myjoyonline.com/oti-regional.body_zh: 奥蒂地区部长John Kwadwo Gyapong介绍了由John Dramani Mahama领导的政府在该地区实施的发展项目，敦促居民认可政府为改善基础设施和社会服务所作的努力。他提到政府“大推进”计划下的道路项目，包括Dodo-Pepesu-Nkwanta、Nkwanta-Kpassa、Nkwanta-Dambai和Okadjakrom-Kwamekrom公路，并称这些项目是重大干预措施，有望改善全地区交通、连通性和经济活动。Gyapong先生是在11月14日于Jasikan的Bueman Senior High School（BUSEC）举行的全国民主大会（NDC）奥蒂地区执行委员会选举活动期间，与媒体交流时作出上述表态的。他还列举了其他重大发展举措，包括拟在Jasikan建设的大学、奥蒂地区医院项目、在全地区设立24小时经济市场、拟在Dambai建设的机场以及Dambai大桥项目。他说，预计总统近期将为奥蒂地区医院项目奠基，并乐观表示，项目建成后可改善医疗服务获取条件，减轻居民寻求专科诊疗时面临的困难。地区部长表示，这些项目体现了政府履行发展承诺的决心，并补充说，该地区人民有理由对这些干预措施表示赞赏。据他介绍，政府已经不再停留在承诺阶段，而是着手实施能够满足全地区关键基础设施和发展需求的项目。他进一步透露，包括建设校舍、社区卫生规划与服务（CHPS）园区以及供水设施在内的多项其他干预措施，正在该地区九个县区推进。Gyapong先生因此呼吁记者走访各个社区，独立评估这些项目的实施情况及其对居民的影响，并作出报道。他说，媒体从业人员肩负着重要责任，应就发展举措及其对民众带来的益处提供准确信息。他敦促媒体充分关注该地区正在推进的发展项目，使居民能够了解相关干预措施，并监督有关主管部门对项目实施情况负责。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.summary_zh: 中国实施零关税政策后，加纳对华出口大幅增长，2026年6月自加纳进口额达到2.9亿美元。中国驻加纳大使丛苏宗在阿克拉举行的2026年奖学金校友协会招待会暨中加零关税论坛上宣布了这一消息。该论坛由加纳商务部奖学金校友协会（MOSAAG）主办，是中国面向非洲国家零关税让步全国能力建设计划的一部分。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.body: Ghana’s exports to China rose sharply following the implementation of China’s zero-tariff policy, with imports from Ghana reaching US$290 million in June 2026. The initiative is expected to expand market access for Ghanaian products and create opportunities for local exporters seeking to enter the Chinese market. Mr Cong Song, Chinese Ambassador to Ghana, announced this at the 2026 Scholarship Alumni Association Reception and China-Ghana Zero-Tariff Forum in Accra. He said bilateral trade between Ghana and China reached $14.12 billion in 2025, while Ghana’s exports to China amounted to $2.67 billion, representing a 33.9 per cent increase over previous years. The forum, organised by the MOFCOM Scholars Alumni Association of Ghana (MOSAAG), formed part of a nationwide capacity-building initiative on China’s zero-tariff concession for African countries. Mr Cong said the policy would reduce the cost of African products entering the Chinese market and improve their competitiveness. He said China’s removal of tariffs on African goods would strengthen confidence in Africa’s economic prospects, support international trade and attract new investment. “The zero-tariff policy is offered unilaterally, with no requirement for African countries to open their markets reciprocally. There is no ceiling on the volume of African exports to China. “It comes with no political strings attached…For African countries, this means the door of opportunity to China’s mega-market of 1.4 billion people is wide open,” he said. The Ambassador highlighted ongoing cooperation between Ghana and China across the mining value chain, including geological exploration, local processing, value addition and skills development. He urged Chinese businesses operating in Ghana to comply with local laws and regulations and called for a conducive environment for investment. Mr Cong encouraged MOSAAG to deepen public awareness of the zero-tariff initiative, identify export opportunities and help address implementation challenges. “Let us join hands to harness the momentum of China’s zero-tariff treatment, and use the certainty of high-level bilateral opening-up and cooperation to offset the uncertainties in the global environment, injecting sustained and strong momentum into Africa’s development,” he said. In a speech read on his behalf, Mr Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Minister for Foreign Affairs, said the government remained committed to partnerships that supported industrialisation and economic transformation. “Our interest is not to only to attract investment into the country; we seek partnerships that establish local production facilities, develop domestic supply chains, strengthen the skills of our workforce and create decent and sustainable jobs,” he said. The Minister urged Ghanaian exporters to meet Chinese market requirements to fully benefit from the policy and deepen trade relations between the two countries. He said the government would continue efforts to strengthen domestic production, improve competitiveness and create a business environment conducive to enterprise growth. Mr Leonard Edem Cosmos, President of MOSAAG, said the forum sought to equip producers, agro-processors and small and medium-sized enterprises with the knowledge required to access the Chinese market. “Knowing that duties have been removed is only the first step; knowing how to navigate sanitary and phytosanitary standards, packaging regulations, rules of origin, logistics, and Chinese buyer expectations is where real trade happens,” he said. Mr Cosmos said the association would support capacity-building efforts, connect Ghanaian businesses with credible Chinese partners and promote effective implementation of the zero-tariff policy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.title_zh: 零关税政策推动加纳对华出口激增
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-export.body_zh: 中国实施零关税政策后，加纳对华出口大幅增长，2026年6月从加纳进口的产品价值达到2.9亿美元。外界预计，这项举措将扩大加纳产品进入市场的渠道，为寻求进入中国市场的本地出口商创造机会。中国驻加纳大使丛松在阿克拉举行的2026年奖学金校友协会招待会暨中加零关税论坛上宣布了上述消息。他说，2025年加纳与中国的双边贸易额达到141.2亿美元，其中加纳对华出口额为26.7亿美元，较以往增长33.9%。该论坛由加纳商务部奖学金校友协会（MOSAAG）组织，是围绕中国对非洲国家零关税让步在全国开展能力建设计划的一部分。丛松说，这项政策将降低非洲产品进入中国市场的成本，提高其竞争力。他说，中国取消对非洲商品征收关税，将增强各方对非洲经济前景的信心，支持国际贸易并吸引新的投资。他说：“零关税政策是单方面提供的，不要求非洲国家对等开放市场。非洲商品对华出口量没有上限。‘这项政策不附带任何政治条件……对非洲国家而言，这意味着通往拥有14亿人口的中国超大市场的大门已经敞开。’大使强调，加纳与中国正在矿业价值链各环节持续开展合作，包括地质勘探、本地加工、增值加工和技能开发。他敦促在加纳经营的中国企业遵守当地法律法规，并呼吁营造有利于投资的环境。丛松鼓励MOSAAG加强零关税举措的公众宣传，发现出口机会，并协助解决政策实施中的各项挑战。他说：“让我们携手合作，利用中国零关税待遇带来的势头，以高层双边开放与合作带来的确定性抵消全球环境中的不确定性，为非洲发展注入持续而强劲的动力。”在一篇代其宣读的讲话中，外交部长Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa表示，政府仍致力于支持工业化和经济转型的伙伴关系。他说：“我们的目标不仅是吸引投资流入国内；我们还寻求建立本地生产设施、发展国内供应链、提升劳动力技能并创造体面且可持续就业的合作伙伴关系。”部长敦促加纳出口商满足中国市场要求，充分利用该政策，并深化两国贸易关系。他说，政府将继续努力加强国内生产、提高竞争力，并营造有利于企业发展的商业环境。MOSAAG主席Leonard Edem Cosmos说，该论坛旨在为生产商、农产品加工商以及中小企业配备进入中国市场所需的知识。他说：“知道关税已经取消只是第一步；懂得如何应对卫生与植物卫生标准、包装规定、原产地规则、物流要求以及中国采购商的期望，才是真正开展贸易的关键。”Cosmos说，协会将支持能力建设努力，为加纳企业对接信誉良好的中国合作伙伴，并推动零关税政策有效落实
